Bava Kamma 60a:16-60b:10: Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: en pureanut baa laolam ella bizman sheharshaim baolam, veenah matchelet ella min hatztzaddikim techilla, shenneemar: "ki tetze esh umatza kotzim" – ematay esh yotza? bizman shekkotzim metzuyin lah. veenah matchelet ella min hatztzaddikim techilla, shenneemar: "veneechal gadish"; "veachal gadish" lo neemar, ella "veneechal gadish" – shenneechal gadish kevar.

Tane rav yosef, may dichtiv: "veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker"? kevan shennittan reshut lammashchit, eno mavchin ben tzaddikim lirshaim. velo od, ella shemmatchil min hatztzaddikim techilla, shenneemar: "vehichratti mimmech tzaddik verasha".
Bache rav yosef: kulle hay name leayin domin. amar leh abbaye: tevuta hu legabbayyhu, dichtiv: "ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik".
Leolam yikkanes adam bechi tov" veyetze bechi tov", shenneemar: "veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker".

Tanu rabbanan: dever bair – kannes raglecha, shenneemar: "veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker". veomer: "lech ammi bo vachadarecha, usegor delatcha baadecha". veomer: "michutz teshakkel cherev, umechadarim ema".
May "veomer"? vechi tema: hane mille belelya, aval bimama la; ta shema: "lech ammi bo vachadarecha, usegor delatcha".

Vechi tema: hane mille [hecha] delekka ema miggavvay, aval hecha deikka ema miggavvay – ki nafek yatev bene inashe betzavvta bealma, tefe mealle; ta shema: "michutz teshakkel cherev umechadarim ema" – af al gav demechadarim ema, michutz teshakkel cherev.
Rava, beiddan ritcha hava sachar kavve, dichtiv: "ki ala mavet bechallonenu".
Tanu rabbanan: raav bair – pazzer raglecha, shenneemar: "vayhi raav baaretz, vayyered avram mitzrayma [lagur] (vayyagor) sham". veomer: "im amarnu navo hair veharaav bair, vamatnu sham".
May "veomer"? vechi tema: hane mille hecha delekka sefek nefashot, aval hecha deikka sefek nefashot – la; ta shema: "lechu venippela el machane aram, im yechayyunu nichye".

Tanu rabbanan: dever bair – al yehallech adam beemtza hadderech, mippene shemmalach hammavet mehallech beemtza hadderachim. dechevan dihiva leh reshuta, mesagge lehedya. shalom bair – al yehallech betzidde derachim. dechevan delet leh reshuta, michabbe chabboye umesagge.
Tanu rabbanan: dever bair – al yikkanes adam yachid levet hakkeneset, shemmalach hammavet mafkid sham kelav. vehane mille hecha dela karu beh dardeke, vela metzallu beh asara.
Tanu rabbanan: kelavim bochim – malach hammavet ba lair. kelavim mesachakim – eliyyahu hannavi ba lair. vehane mille delet behu nekeva.
Berakhot 35a:21-35b:8: Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha keillu nehena mikkodshe shamayim, shenneemar: "laAdonai haaretz umeloah". rabbi levi rame: ketiv "laAdonai haaretz umeloah", uchetiv "hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai vehaaretz natan livne adam"! la kashya kan kodem beracha,

Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: kol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha keillu gozel lehakkadosh baruch hu ucheneset yisrael, shenneemar: "gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pasha chaver hu leish mashchit". veen "aviv" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "halo hu avich kanecha", veen "immo" ella keneset yisrael, shenneemar: "shema beni musar avicha veal tittosh torat immecha".
May "chaver hu leish mashchit"? amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: chaver hu leyarovam ben nevat shehishchit et yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim.
Rabbi chanina bar pappa rame: ketiv "velakachti degani beitto vegomer", uchetiv "veasafta deganecha vegomer".
La kashya: kan bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom, kan bizman sheen yisrael osin retzono shel makom.

Tanu rabbanan: "veasafta deganecha" ma talmud lomar? — lefi shenneemar: "lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha" — yachol devarim kichtavan, talmud lomar: "veasafta deganecha" — haneheg bahen minhag derech eretz, divre rabbi yishmael.

Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: efshar adam choresh bishat charisha, vezorea bishat zeria, vekotzer bishat ketzira, vedash bishat disha, vezore bishat haruach, tora ma tehe aleha? ella bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom — melachtan naaset al yede acherim, shenneemar: "veamdu zarim verau tzonchem vegomer", uvizman sheen yisrael osin retzono shel makom — melachtan naaset al yede atzman, shenneemar: "veasafta deganecha". velo od ella shemmelechet acherim naaset al yadan, shenneemar: "veavadta et oyvecha vegomer".
Amar abbaye: harebe asu kerabbi yishmael, vealta beyadan. kerabbi shimon ben yochay, velo alta beyadan.
Malachi 1:1-6: Ahavti etchem amar Adonai vaamartem bamma ahavtanu halo-ach esav leyaakov neum-Adonai vaohav et-yaakov
Veet-esav saneti vaasim et-harav shemama veet-nachalato letannot midbar
Ki-tomar edom rushshashnu venashuv venivne choravot ko amar Adonai tzevaot hemma yivnu vaani eheros vekaru lahem gevul risha vehaam asher-zaam Adonai ad-olam
Veenechem tirena veattem tomru yigdal Adonai meal ligvul yisrael
Ben yechabbed av veeved adonav veim-av ani ayye chevodi veim-adonim ani ayye morai amar ׀ Adonai tzevaot lachem hakkohanim boze shemi vaamartem bamme vazinu et-shemecha
Malachi 1:11-2:1: Ki mimmizrach-shemesh vead-mevoo gadol shemi baggoyim uvechol-makom muktar muggash lishmi umincha tehora ki-gadol shemi baggoyim amar Adonai tzevaot
Veattem mechallelim oto beemorchem shulchan adonay megoal hu venivo nivze ochlo
Vaamartem hinne mattelaa vehippachtem oto amar Adonai tzevaot vahavetem gazul veet-happisseach veet-hachole vahavetem et-hammincha haertze otah miyyedchem amar Adonai {s}
Vearur nochel veyesh beedro zachar venoder vezoveach moshchat ladonay ki melech gadol ani amar Adonai tzevaot ushemi nora vaggoyim
Malachi 1:7-10: Maggishim al-mizbechi lechem megoal vaamartem bamme gealnucha beemorchem shulchan Adonai nivze hu
Vechi-taggishun ivver lizboach en ra vechi taggishu pisseach vechole en ra hakerivehu na lefechatecha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha amar Adonai tzevaot
Veatta challu-na fene-el vichonnenu miyyedchem hayta zot hayissa mikkem panim amar Adonai tzevaot
Mi gam-bachem veyisgor delatayim velo-tairu mizbechi chinnam en-li chefetz bachem amar Adonai tzevaot umincha lo-ertze miyyedchem
Malachi 2:2-7: Im-lo tishmeu veim-lo tasimu al-lev latet kavod lishmi amar Adonai tzevaot veshillachti vachem et-hammeera vearoti et-birchotechem vegam arotiha ki enchem samim al-lev
Hinni goer lachem et-hazzera vezeriti feresh al-penechem peresh chaggechem venasa etchem elav
Vidatem ki shillachti alechem et hammitzva hazzot lihyot beriti et-levi amar Adonai tzevaot
Beriti ׀ hayta itto hachayyim vehashshalom vaettenem-lo mora vayyiraeni umippene shemi nichat hu
Torat emet hayta befihu veavla lo-nimtza visfatav beshalom uvemishor halach itti verabbim heshiv meavon
Ki-sifte chohen yishmeru-daat vetora yevakshu mippihu ki malach Adonai-tzevaot hu
Malachi 2:8-12: Veattem sartem min-hadderech hichshaltem rabbim battora shichattem berit hallevi amar Adonai tzevaot
Vegam-ani natatti etchem nivzim ushefalim lechol-haam kefi asher enchem shomrim et-derachay venosim panim battora {p}
Halo av echad lechullanu halo el echad beraanu maddua nivgad ish beachiv lechallel berit avotenu
Bagda yehuda vetoeva neesta veyisrael uvirushala͏m ki ׀ chillel yehuda kodesh Adonai asher ahev uvaal bat-el nechar
Yachret Adonai laish asher yaasenna er veone meohole yaakov umaggish mincha laAdonai tzevaot {p}
Mishnah Arakhin 1:1: Hakkol maarichin veneerachin, nodrim veniddarim, kohanim uleviyyim veyisreelim, nashim vaavadim. tumtum veanderoginos, nodrim veniddarim umaarichin, aval lo neerachin, sheeno neerach ella zachar vadday unekeva vaddait. cheresh, shote vekatan, niddarin veneerachin, aval lo nodrin velo maarichin, mippene sheen bahem daat. pachut mibben chodesh, niddar aval lo neerach:
Mishnah Arakhin 1:2-2:1:
Hannachri, rabbi meir omer neerach aval lo maarich. rabbi yehuda omer, maarich aval lo neerach. ze vaze modim, shennodrin veniddarin: 
Haggoses, vehayyotze lehareg, lo niddar velo neerach. rabbi chanina ben akavya omer, neerach, mippene sheddamav ketzuvin, aval eno niddar, mippene sheen damav ketzuvin. rabbi yose omer, noder umaarich umakdish. veim hizzik, chayyav battashlumin: 
Haishsha shehi yotza lehareg, en mamtinin lah ad shetteled. yashva al hammashber, mamtinin lah ad shetteled. haishsha shenneherga, nehenin bisarah. behema shenneherga, asura vahanaya: 
En baarachin pachut missela, velo yater al chamishshim sala. ketzad, natan sela veheeshir, eno noten kelum. pachot missela veheeshir, noten chamishshim sala. haya veyadav chamesh selaim, rabbi meir omer, eno noten ella echat. vachachamim omrim, noten et kullam. en baarachin pachut missela, velo yater al chamishshim sela. en petach battoa pachut mishshiva, velo yater al shiva asar. en bannegaim pachut mishshavua echad, velo yater al shelosha shavuot:
Mishnah Arakhin 2:2-5:
En pochatin mearbaa chadashim hameubbarim beshana, velo nire yater al shemona. shete hallechem neechalot en pachut mishshenayim velo yater al shelosha. lechem happanim neechol en pachut mittisha velo yater al achad asar. katan nimmol en pachut mishshemona velo yater al shenem asar: 
En pochatin meesrim veachat tekiot bammikdash velo mosifin al arbaim ushemone. en pochatin mishshene nevalin velo mosifin al shishsha. en pochatin mishshene chalilin velo mosifin al shenem asar. uvishnem asar yom bashshana hechalil makke lifne hammizbeach. bishchitat pesach rishon, uvishchitat pesach sheni, uveyom tov rishon shel pesach, uveyom tov shel atzeret, uvishmonat yeme hechag, velo haya makke beabbuv shel nechoshet ella beabbuv shel kane, mippene shekkolo arev. velo haya machalik ella veabbuv yechidi, mippene shehu machalik yafe: 
Veavde hakkohanim hayu, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, mishpechot bet happegarim uvet tzefarya umeemmaom hayu massiin lakkehunna. rabbi chananya ben antignos omer, leviyyim hayu: 
En pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamevukkarin belishkat hattelaim, keday lashshabbat velishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana, umosifin ad leolam. en pochatin mishshete chatzotzrot, umosifin ad leolam. en pochatin mittisha chinnorot, umosifin ad leolam. vehatztziltzal levad:
Mishnah Bekhorot 8:3-6: Mi shello vikkera ishto veyalda shene zecharim, noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom, haav patur. met haav vehabbanim kayyamim, rabbi meir omer, im natnu ad shello chalku, natanu. veim lav, peturin. rabbi yehuda omer nitchayyevu nechasim. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum:

Shete nashim shello vikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim, noten eser selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom, im lechohen echad natan, yachazir lo chamesh selaim. im lishne chohanim natan, eno yachol lehotzi miyyadam. zachar unekeva o shene zecharim unekeva, noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot, en kan lakkohen kelum. achat bikkera veachat shello vikkera veyaldu shene zecharim. noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom, haav patur. met haav vehabbanim kayyamin, rabbi meir omer, im natnu ad shello chalku, natanu. veim lav, peturin. rabbi yehuda omer, nitchayyevu nechasim. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum:

Shete nashim shel shene anashim shello vikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim, ze noten chamesh selaim lakkohen, veze noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom, im lechohen echad natnu, yachazir lahen chamesh selaim. im lishne chohanim natnu, enan yecholin lehotzi miyyadam. zachar unekeva, haavot peturin, vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo. shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot, en kan lakkohen kelum:

Achat bikkera veachat shello vikkera shel shene anashim, veyaldu shene zecharim, ze shello vikkera ishto, noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum. met habben betoch sheloshim yom, af al pi shennatan lakkohen, yachazir (lo chamesh selaim). leachar sheloshim yom, af al pi shello natan, yitten. met beyom sheloshim, keyom shellefanav. rabbi akiva omer, im natan, lo yittol. veim lo natan, lo yitten. met haav betoch sheloshim yom, bechezkat shello nifda, ad sheyyavi reaya shennifda. leachar sheloshim yom, bechezikat shennifda, ad (sheyyavi reaya) shello nifda. hu lippadot uveno lippadot, hu kodem et beno. rabbi yehuda omer, beno kodmo, shemmitzvato al aviv, umitzvat beno alav:
Mishnah Bekhorot 8:7-10: Chamesh selaim shel ben, bemane tzori. sheloshim shel eved, vachamishshim shel ones veshel mefatte, umea shel motzi shem ra, kullam beshekel hakkodesh, bemane tzori. vechullan nifdin bechesef, uveshave chesef, chutz min hashshekalim:

En podin lo vaavadim, velo vishtarot, velo vekarkaot, velo vehekdeshot. katav lakkohen shehu chayyav lo chamesh selaim, chayyav litten lo uveno eno faduy, lefichach im ratza hakkohen litten lo mattana, rashshay. hammafrish pidyon beno veavad, chayyav beacharayuto, shenneemar (Bamidbar 18), yihye lach ufado tifde:

Habbechor notel pi shenayim benichse haav, veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem. veeno notel pi shenayim bashshevach, velo varauy kevammuchzak. velo haishsha bichtubbatah, velo habbanot bimzonotehen, velo hayyavam. vechullan en notlin bashshevach, velo varauy kevammuchzak:

Ellu sheenan chozrin bayyovel, habbechora, vehayyoresh et ishto, vehameyabbem et eshet achiv, vehammattana, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, mattana kemecher. rabbi eliezer omer, kullan chozrin bayyovel. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, hayyoresh et ishto, yachazir livne mishpacha vinakke lahem min haddamim:
Mishnah Bekhorot 9:1-4: Masar behema noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit, bachullin aval lo vammukdashin. venoheg babbakar uvatztzon, veenan mitasserim mizze al ze. bakkevasim uvaizzim, umitasserin mizze al ze. bechadash, uvayyashan, veenan mitasserin mizze al ze. shehaya baddin, ma im hechadash vehayyashan sheenan kilayim ze vaze, en mitasserin mizze al ze. hakkevasim vehaizzim shehem kilayim ze vaze, eno din shello yitasseru mizze al ze, talmud lomar (Vayikra 27), vatzon, mishma kol tzon, echad:

Masar behema mitztaref kimlo regel behema roa. vechamma hi regel behema roa, shishsha asar mil. haya ben ellu leellu sheloshim ushenayim mil, enan mitztarfin. haya lo vaemtza, mevi umeasseran baemtza. rabbi meir omer, hayyarden mafsik lemasar behema:

Hallakuach o shennittan lo mattana, patur mimmasar behema. haachim hashshuttafin shechayyavin bakkalbon, peturin mimmasar behema. veshechayyavin bemasar behema, peturin min hakkalbon. kanu mittefusat habbayit, chayyavin. veim lav, peturin. chalku vechazru venishtattefu, chayyabbin bakkalbon ufeturin mimmasar behema:

Hakkol nichnas laddir lehitasser, chutz min hakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen, umechussar zeman, veyatom. ezehu yatom, kol shemmeta immo o shennishchata. rabbi yehoshua omer, afillu nishchata immo vehashshelach kayyam, en ze yatom:
Mishnah Bekhorot 9:5-8: Shalosh geranot lemasar behema, bifros happesach, bifros haatzeret, bifros hechag, divre rabbi akiva. ben azzay omer, beesrim vetisha baadar, beechad besivan, beesrim vetisha veav. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon omrim, beechad benisan, beechad besivan, beesrim vetisha veelul. velamma amru beesrim vetisha veelul velo amru beechad betishre, mippene shehu yom tov, vei efshar leasser beyom tov, lefichach hikdimuhu beesrim vetisha veelul. rabbi meir omer, beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema. ben azzay omer, haeluliyyin mitasserin bifne atzman:

Kol hannoladim meechad betishre ad esrim vetisha beelul, hare ellu mitztarfin. chamishsha lifne rosh hashshana vachamishsha leachar rosh hashshana, enan mitztarfin. chamishsha lifne haggoren vachamishsha leachar haggoren, hare ellu mitztarfin. im ken lamma neemar shalosh geranot lemasar behema, shead shello higgia haggoren, muttar limkor velishchot. higgia haggoren, lo yishchot. veim shachat, patur:

Ketzad measseran, konsan laddir veose lahen petach katan kede shello yihyu shenayim yecholin latzet keachat, umone vashshevet, echad, shenayim, shelosha, arbaa, chamishsha, shishsha, shiva, shemona, tisha, vehayotze asiri sokro vesikra veomer hare ze maaser. lo sekaro vesikra velo menaam bashshevet, o shemmenaam revutzim, o omdim, hare ellu meussarim, haya lo mea venatal asara, asara venatal echad, en ze maaser. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer, hare ze maaser, kafatz (echad) min hammenuyin letochan, hare ellu feturin. min hameussarim letochan, kullan yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyeachlu vemuman labbealim:

Yatzu shenayim keechad, mone otan shenayim shenayim. menaan echad, teshii vaasiri mekulkalin. yatzu teshii vaasiri keachat, teshii vaasiri mekulkalin. kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii uleachad asar asiri, shelashtan mekuddashin. hatteshii neechol bemumo, vehaasiri maaser, veachad asar karev shelamim veose temura, divre rabbi meir. amar rabbi yehuda, vechi yesh temura osa temura. amru mishshum rabbi meir, illu haya temura, lo haya karev. kara latteshii asiri velaasiri asiri uleachad asar asiri, en achad asar mekuddash. ze hakkelal, kol shello neekar shem asiri mimmennu, en achad asar mekuddash:
Mishnah Demai 1:4-2:3:
Haddemay, mearvin bo, umishtattefin bo, umevarchin alav, umezammenin alav, umafrishin oto arom, ben hashshemashot. ha im hikdim maaser sheni larishon, en bechach kelum. shemen shehaggardi sach beetzbeotav, chayyav biddemay. veshehassorek noten batztzemer, patur min haddemay: 
Veellu devarim mitasserin demay bechol makom. haddevela, vehattemarim, vehecharuvim, haorez, vehakkammon. haorez shebbechutza laaretz, kol hammishtammesh mimmennu patur: 
Hamekabbel alav lihyot neeman, measser et shehu ochel, veet shehu mocher, veet shehu lokeach, veeno mitareach etzel am haaretz. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammitareach etzel am haaretz neeman. amru lo, al atzmo eno neeman, ketzad yehe neeman al shel acherim: 
Hamekabbel alav lihyot chaver, eno mocher leam haaretz lach veyavesh, veeno lokeach mimmennu lach, veeno mitarech etzel am haaretz, velo mearcho etzlo bichsuto. rabbi yehuda omer, af lo yegaddel behema dakka, velo yehe farutz bindarim uvischok, velo yehe mittamme lemetim, umeshammesh bevet hammidrash. amru lo, lo vau ellu lakkelal:
Mishnah Demai 2:4-3:3:
Hannachtomim, lo chiyyevu otam chachamim lehaferish ella chede terumat maaser vechalla. hachenvanim enan rashshain limkor et haddemay. kol hammashpiin bemidda gassa, rashshain limkor et haddemay. ellu hen hammashpiin bemidda gassa, kegon hassitonot umochre tevua: 
Rabbi meir omer, et sheddarko lehimmaded begassa umedado vedakka, tefela dakka laggassa. et sheddarko lehimmaded bedakka umadad bagassa, tefela gassa laddakka. ezo hi midda gassa, beyavesh, sheloshet kabbin, uvelach, dinar. rabbi yose omer, salle teenim vesalle anavim vekuppot shel yarak, kol zeman shehu mochran achsara, patur: 
Maachilin et haaniyyim demay, veet haachsanya demay. rabban gamliel haya maachil et poalav demay. gabbae tzedaka, bet shammay omrim, notnin et hameussar lesheeno measser, veet sheeno meussar limasser. nimtzeu chol haadam ochlin metukkan. vachachamim omrim, govin setam umechallekin setam, veharotze letakken yetakken: 
Harotze lachazom ale yarak lehakel mimmassao, lo yashlich ad sheyyeasser. hallokeach yarak min hashshuk venimlach lehachazir, lo yachazir ad sheyyeasser, sheeno mechussar ella minyan. haya omed velokeach veraa toan acher yafe mimmennu, muttar lehachazir, mippene shello mashach: 
Hammotze ferot badderech unetalan leachlan, venimlach lehatzenia, lo yatznia ad sheyyeasser. veim mittechilla netalan bishvil shello yovedu, patur. kol davar sheen adam rashshay lemachro demay, lo yishlach lachavero demay. rabbi yose mattir bevadday, uvilvad sheyyodiennu:
Mishnah Demai 3:4-4:1:
Hammolich chittim letochen kuti o letochen am haaretz, bechezkatan lammaasrot velashsheviit. letochen oved kochavim, demay. hammafkid perotav etzel hakkuti o etzel am haaretz, bechezkatan lammaasrot velashsheviit. etzel haoved kochavim, keferotav. rabbi shimon omer, demay: 
Hannoten lefundakit, measser et shehu noten lah, veet shehu notel mimmenna, mippene shechashuda lachalof. amar rabbi yose, en anu acharain larammain, eno measser ella ma shehu notel mimmenna bilvad: 
Hannoten lachamoto, measser et shehu noten lah, veet shehu notel mimmenna, mippene shehi chashuda lachalof et hammitkalkel. amar rabbi yehuda, rotza hi vetakkanat bittah uvosha mechatanah. mode rabbi yehuda benoten lachamoto sheviit, sheenah chashuda lehachalif lehaachil et bittah sheviit: 
Hallokeach perot mimmi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, veshachach leasseran, veshoalo veshabbat, yochal al piv. chashcha motzae shabbat, lo yochal ad sheyyeasser. lo metzao, amar lo echad sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, meussarin hen, ochel al piv. chashcha motzae shabbat, lo yochal ad sheyyeasser. terumat maaser shel demay shechazra limkomah, rabbi shimon shezuri omer, af bechol shoalo veochlo al piv:
Mishnah Demai 4:2-5:
Hammaddir et chavero sheyyochal etzlo, vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot, ochel immo bashshabbat harishona, veaf al pi sheeno maamino al hammaasrot, uvilvad sheyyomar lo meussarin hen. uveshabbat sheniyya, af al pi shennadar mimmennu hanaya, lo yochal ad sheyyeasser: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, en adam tzarich likrot shem lemasar ani shel demay. vachachamim omrim, kore shem veeno tzarich lehaferish: 
Mi shekkara shem litrumat maaser shel demay ulemasar ani shel vadday, lo yittelem beshabbat. veim haya chohen o ani lemudim leechol etzlo, yavou veyochlu, uvilvad sheyyodiem: 
Haomer lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, kach li mimmi shehu neeman umimmi shehu measser, eno neeman. meish peloni, hare ze neeman. halach likkach mimmennu, veamar lo lo metzativ velakachti lecha meacher shehu neeman, eno neeman:
Mishnah Demai 4:6-5:2: Hannichnas leir veeno makkir adam sham, amar, mi kan neeman. mi kan measser. amar lo echad, ani, eno neeman. amar lo, ish peloni neeman, hare ze neeman. halach likkach mimmennu, amar lo, mi kan mocher yashan. amar lo, mi sheshshelachacha etzli, af al pi shehen kegomlin ze et ze, hare ellu neemanin:
Hachammarim shennichnesu leir, amar echad, shelli chadash veshel chaveri yashan, shelli eno metukkan veshel chaveri metukkan, enan neemanin. rabbi yehuda omer, neemanin:

Hallokeach min hannachtom, ketzad hu measser. notel kede terumat maaser vechalla, veomer, echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan, hare vetzad ze maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, vehashshear challa, umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo, umechullal al hammaot:

Harotze lehaferish teruma uterumat maaser keachat, notel echad mishsheloshim veshalosh ushelish, veomer, echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan, hare ze betzad ze chullin, vehashshear teruma al hakkol. umea chullin sheyyesh kan, hare ze betzad ze maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, vehashshear challa, umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo, umechullal al hammaot:
Mishnah Demai 5:3-7: Hallokeach min hannachtom, measser min hachamma al hatztzonenet, umin hatztzonenet al hachamma, afillu mittefusin harebe, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda oser, sheani omer, chittim shel emesh hayu mishshel echad, veshel hayyom hayu mishshel acher. rabbi shimon oser bitrumat maaser, umattir bechalla:
Hallokeach min happalter, measser mikkol tefus utefus, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, meachat al hakkol. mode rabbi yehuda belokeach min hammanpol, shehu measser mikkol echad veechad:

Hallokech min heani, vechen heani shennatnu lo ferusot pat o filche devela, measser mikkol echad veechad. uvitmarim uvigrogarot, bolel venotel. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehammattana merubba, aval bizman shehammattana muetet, measser mikkol echad veechad:
Hallokeach min hassiton vechazar velakach mimmennu sheniyya, lo yeasser mizze al ze, afillu meoto hassug, afillu meoto hammin. neeman hassiton lomar, mishshel echad hem:

Hallokeach mibbaal habbayit vechazar velakach mimmennu sheniyya, measser mizze al ze, afillu mishshete kuppot, afillu mishshete ayarot. baal habbayit shehaya mocher yarak bashshuk, bizman shemmeviin lo miggannotav, measser meachat al hakkol. umiggannot acherot, measser mikkol echad veechad:
Mishnah Ketubot 10:1-4:
Mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim umet, harishona kodemet lashsheniyya, veyorshe harishona kodmin leyorshe sheniyya. nasa et harishona vameta, nasa sheniyya umet hu, sheniyya veyorsheha kodmim leyorshe harishona: 
Mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim umetu veachar kach met hu, vitomim mevakshim ketubbat imman veen sham ella shete chetubbot, cholkin beshave. haya sham motar dinar, ellu notlin ketubbat imman veellu notlin ketubbat imman. im amru yetomim, anachnu maalim al nichse avinu yater dinar, kede sheyyittelu chetubbat imman, en shomin lahen, ella shamin et hannechasim bevet din: 
Hayu sham nechasim barauy, enan kevammuchzak. rabbi shimon omer, afillu yesh sham nechasim sheen lahem acharayut, eno chelum, ad sheyyihyu sham nechasim sheyyesh lahen acharayut yoter al shete hakketubbot dinar: 
Mi shehaya nasuy shalosh nashim umet, ketubbatah shel zo mane veshel zo matayim veshel zo shelosh meot veen sham ella mane, cholkot beshave. hayu sham matayim, shel mane notelet chamishshim, shel matayim veshel shelosh meot, shelosha shelosha shel zahav. hayu sham shelosh meot, shel mane notelet chamishshim, veshel matayim, mane, veshel shelosh meot, shishsha shel zahav. vechen shelosha shehittilu lechis, pichatu o hotiru, kach hen cholkin:
Mishnah Ketubot 7:6-10:
Veellu yotzot shello vichtubba, haoveret al dat moshe vihudit. veezo hi dat moshe, maachilato sheeno meussar, umeshammashto nidda, velo kotza lah challa, venoderet veenah mekayyemet. veezohi dat yehudit, yotza veroshah parua, vetova vashshuk, umedabberet im kol adam. abba shaul omer, af hamekallelet yoldav befanav. rabbi tarfon omer, af hakkolanit. veezo hi kolanit, lichshehi medabberet betoch betah ushecheneha shomin kolah: 
Hamekaddesh et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim venimtzeu aleha nedarim, enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim, tetze shello vichtubba. al menat sheen bah mumin venimtzeu vah mumin, enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu vah mumin, tetze shello vichtubba. kol hammumin happoslin bakkohanim, poslin bannashim: 
Hayu vah mumin veodah bevet aviha, haav tzarich lehavi reaya shemmishshennitarsa noldu vah mumin hallalu venistachafa sadehu. nichnesa lirshut habbaal, habbaal tzarich lehavi reaya shead shello nitarsa hayu vah mumin ellu vehaya mikkacho mekkach taut, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bamme devarim amurim, bemumin shebbasseter. aval bemumin shebbaggaluy, eno yachol liton. veim yesh merchatz beotah hair, af mumin shebbasseter eno yachol liton, mippene shehu vodkah bikrovotav: 
Haish shennoldu vo mumin, en kofin oto lehotzi. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, bamme devarim amurim, bammumin hakketannim. aval bammumin haggedolim, kofin oto lehotzi: 
Veellu shekkofin oto lehotzi, mukke shechin, uvaal polippos, vehamekammetz, vehametzaref nechoshet, vehabbursi, ben shehayu vam ad shello nisseu uven mishshennisseu noladu. veal kullan amar rabbi meir, af al pi shehitna immah, yecholah hi shettomar, sevura hayiti sheani yecholah lekabbel, veachshav eni yechola lekabbel. vachachamim omrim, mekabbelet hi al karchah, chutz mimmukke shechin, mippene shemmemikkato. maase vetzidon bevursi echad shemmet vehaya lo ach bursi, amru chachamim, yechola hi shettomar, leachicha hayiti yechola lekabbel, ulecha eni yechola lekabbel:
Mishnah Ketubot 8:1-4:
Haishsha shennaflu lah nechasim ad shello titares, modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyam. naflu lah mishshennitarsa, bet shammay omrim, timkor, uvet hillel omrim, lo timkor. ellu vaellu modim, sheim machra venatna, kayyam. amar rabbi yehuda, amru lifne rabban gamliel, hoil vezacha vaishsha, lo yizke vannechasim. amar lahem, al hachadashim anu voshin, ella shaattem megalgelin alenu et hayeshanim. naflu lah mishshennisset, ellu vaellu modim sheim machra venatna shehabbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot. ad shello nisset venisset, rabban gamliel omer, im machra venatna, kayyam. amar rabbi chanina ben akiva, amru lifne rabban gamliel, hoil vezacha vaishsha, lo yizke vannechasim. amar lahem, al hachadashim anu voshin, ella sheattem megalgelim alenu et hayeshanim: 
Rabbi shimon cholek ben nechasim linchasim. nechasim hayeduim labbaal, lo timkor. veim machra venatna, batel. sheenan yeduim labbaal, lo timkor. veim machra venatna, kayyam: 
Naflu lah kesafim, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. perot hattelushin min hakkarka, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. vehamechubbarin bakkarka, amar rabbi meir, shamin otan kamma hen yafin beferot vechamma hen yafin belo ferot, vehammotar, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. vachachamim omrim, hamechubbarin lakkarka, shello. vehattelushin min hakkarka, shellah, veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot: 
Rabbi shimon omer, mekom sheyyafe chocho vichnisatah, hura kocho vitziatah. mekom shehura kocho vichnisatah, yafe chocho vitziatah. perot hamechubbarin lakkarka, bichnisatah shello uvitziatah shellah. vehattelushin min hakkarka, bichnisatah shellah uvitziatah shello:
Mishnah Ketubot 8:5-8:
Naflu lah avadim ushefachot zekenim, yimmachru veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo timkor, mippene shehen shevach bet aviha. naflu lah zetim ugefanim zekenim, yimmachru leetzim veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. rabbi yehuda omer, lo timkor, mippene shehen shevach bet aviha. hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto, hotzi harebe veachal kima, kima veachal harebe, ma shehotzi hotzi, uma sheachal achol. hotzi velo achal, yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol: 
Shomeret yavam shennaflu lah nechasim, modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyam. meta, ma yaasu vichtubbatah uvannechasim hannichnasin vehayyotzin immah. bet shammay omrim, yachaloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav. uvet hillel omrim, nechasim bechezkatan, ketubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal, nechasim hannichnasim vehayyotzim immah bechezkat yorshe haav: 
Hinniach achiv maot, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. perot hattelushin min hakkarka, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. hamechubbarin bakkarka, amar rabbi meir, shamin otan kamma hen yafin beferot vechamma hen yafin belo ferot, vehammotar, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. vachachamim omrim, perot hamechubbarim bakkarka, shello. vehattelushin min hakkarka, kol hakkodem zacha vahen. kadam hu, zacha. kadma hi, yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. kenasah, hare hi cheishto lechol davar, uvilvad shettehe chetubbatah al nichse valah harishon: 
Lo yomar lah, hare chetubbetich munnachat al hashshulchan, ella kol nechasav acharain lakketubba. vechen lo yomar adam leishto, hare chetubbetich munnachat al hashshulchan, ella chol nechasav acharain lichtubbatah. gershah, en lah ella chetubbatah. hechezirah, hare hi kechol hannashim veen lah ella chetubbatah bilvad:
Mishnah Ketubot 9:1-4:
Hakkotev leishto, din udevarim en li vinchasayich, hare ze ochel perot bechayyeha. veim meta, yorshah. im ken lamma chatav lah din udevarim en li vinchasayich, sheim machra venatna, kayyam. katav lah, din udevarim en li vinchasayich uveferotehen, hare ze eno ochel perot bechayyeha. veim meta, yorshah. rabbi yehuda omer, leolam ochel pere ferot, ad sheyyichtov lah din udevarim en li vinchasayich uveferotehen uvefere ferotehen ad olam. katav lah, din udevarim en li vinchasayich uveferotehen uvefere ferotehen bechayyayich uvemotech, eno ochel perot bechayyeha. veim meta, eno yorshah. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, im meta, yirashenna, mippene shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora, tenao vatel: 
Mi shemmet vehinniach ishsha uvaal chov veyorshin, vehaya lo fikkadon o milve beyad acherim, rabbi tarfon omer, yinnatnu lakkoshel shebbahen. rabbi akiva omer, en merachamin baddin, ella yinnatnu layyorshin, shekkullan tzerichin shevua veen hayyorshin tzerichin shevua: 
Hinniach perot telushin min hakkarka, kol hakkodem zacha vahen. zachta ishsha yoter mikketubbatah, uvaal chov yoter al chovo, hammotar, rabbi tarfon omer, yinnatnu lakkoshel shebbahen. rabbi akiva omer, en merachamin baddin, ella yinnatnu layyorshim, shekkullam tzerichin shevua veen hayyorshim tzerichin shevua: 
Hammoshiv et ishto chenvanit o shemminnah appotroppa, hare ze mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu al pilkah veal issatah:
Mishnah Ketubot 9:5-9:
Katav lah, neder ushevua en li alayich, en yachol lehashebiah, aval mashbia hu et yorsheha veet habbaim birshutah. neder ushevua en li alayich veal yorshayich veal habbaim birshutich, eno yachol lehashebiah, lo hi velo yorsheha velo et habbaim birshutah. aval yorshav mashbiin otah, veet yorsheha veet habbaim birshutah. neder ushevua en li velo leyorshay velo labbaim birshuti alayich veal yorshayich veal habbaim birshutich, eno yachol lehashebiah, lo hu velo yorshav velo habbaim birshuto, lo otah velo yorsheha velo habbain birshutah: 
Halcha mikkever balah levet aviha o shechazra levet chamiha, velo naaset appotroppa, en hayyorshin mashbiin otah. veim naaset appotroppa, hayyorshin mashbiin otah al heatid lavo veen mashbiin otah al ma sheavar: 
Happogemet ketubbatah, lo tippara ella vishvua. ed echad meidah shehi ferua, lo tippara ella vishvua. minnichse yetomim uminnechasim meshubadin veshello vefanav, lo tippara ella vishvua: 
Happogemet ketubbatah ketzad, hayta chetubbatah elef zuz, veamar lah hitkabbalt ketubbatech, vehi omeret lo hitkabbalti ella mane, lo tippara ella vishvua. ed echad meidah shehi ferua ketzad, hayta chetubbatah elef zuz, veamar lah hitkabbalt ketubbatech, vehi omeret lo hitkabbalti, veed echad meidah shehi ferua, lo tippara ella vishvua. minnechasim meshubadim ketzad, machar nechasav laacherim, vehi nifraat min hallakochot, lo tippara ella vishvua. minnichse yetomim ketzad, met vehinniach nechasav laytomim, vehi nifraat min hayetomim, lo tippara ella vishvua. veshello befanav ketzad, halach lo limdinat hayyam, vehi nifraat shello vefanav, enah nifraat ella vishvua. rabbi shimon omer, kol zeman shehi tovaat ketubbatah, hayyorshin mashbiin otah. veim enah tovaat ketubbatah, en hayyorshin mashbiin otah: 
Hotzia get veen immo chetubba, gova chetubbatah. ketubba veen immah get, hi omeret avad gitti vehu omer avad shovri, vechen baal chov shehotzi shetar chov veen immo ferozbul, hare ellu lo yippareu. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, min hassakkana veelach, ishsha gova chetubbatah shello veget, uvaal chov gove shello vifrozbul. shene gittin ushete chetubbot, gova shete chetubbot. shete chetubbot veget echad, o chetubba ushene gittin, o chetubba veget umita, enah gova ella chetubba achat, shehamegaresh et ishto vehechezirah, al menat ketubba harishona machazirah. katan shehissio aviv, ketubbatah kayyemet, sheal menat ken kiyyemah. ger shennitgayyer veishto immo, ketubbatah kayyemet, sheal menat ken kiyyemah:
Mishneh Torah, Foundations of the Torah:
Kol hannitpal lashshem millefanav muttar lemochoko kegon lamed millaAdonai uvet mibbelohim vechayyotze bahen enan kikdushshat hashshem. vechol hannitpal lashshem meacharav kegon ch shel elohecha vechem shel elohechem vechayyotze bahen enam nimchakim vahare hem kishar otiyyot shel shem mippene shehashshem mekaddesham. veaf al pi shennitkaddeshu veasur lemochokam hammochek ellu haotiyyot hannitpalot eno loke. aval makkin oto makkat mardut:
Katav alef lamed melohim, yod hei meAdonai, eno nimchak. veen tzarich lomar yah shehu shem bifne atzmo. mippene shezze hashshem miktzat shem hameforash hu. aval hakkotev shin dalet mishshadday, tzaddi bet mitztzevaot, hare ze nimchak:
Shear hakkinnuyin shemmeshabbechin bahen et hakkadosh baruch hu kegon channun verachum haggadol haggibbor vehannora hanneeman kanno vechazak vechayyotze bahen hare hen kishar kitve hakkodesh umuttar lemochokan:

Keli shehaya shem katuv alav kotzetz et mekom hashshem vegonzo. vaafillu haya hashshem chakuk bichle mattachot o bichle zechuchit vehittich hakkeli hare ze loke ella chotech et mekomo vegonzo. vechen im haya shem katuv al besaro hare ze lo yirchatz velo yasuch velo yaamod bimkom hattinnofet. nizdammena lo tevila shel mitzva korech alav gemi vetovel. veim lo matza gemi mesabbev bivgadav velo yehaddek kede shello yachotz. shello amru lichroch alav ella mippene sheasur laamod bifne hashshem keshehu arom:
Hassoter afillu even achat derech hashechata min hammizbeach o min hahechol o mishshear haazara loke shenneemar baavodat kochavim <small>(Shemot led 13)</small> "ki et mizbechotam tittotzun" vechatuv <small>(Devarim 12 4)</small> "lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem". vechen hassoref atze hakkodesh derech hashechata loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 3)</small> "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh" uchetiv lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem: 
Kitve hakkodesh kullan uferushehen uveurehen asur lesarfam o leabbedam bayyad vehameabbedan bayyad makkin oto makkat mardut. bamme devarim amurim bechitve hakkodesh shekketavam yisrael bikdushsha aval eppikoros yisrael shekkatav sefer tora sorfin oto im haazkarot shebbo. mippene sheeno maamin bikdushshat hashshem velo ketavo lishmo ella shehu maale bedato shezze kishar haddevarim vehoil vedato ken lo nitkaddesh hashshem. umitzva lesarfo kede shello lehanniach shem laeppikorosim velo lemaasehem. aval oved kochavim shekkatav et hashshem gonzin oto. vechen kitve hakkodesh shebbalu o shekketavan oved kochavim yigganzu:

Kol hashshemot haamurim beavraham kodesh af ze shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 3)</small> "adonay im na matzati chen" hare hu kodesh. kol hashshemot haamurim belot chol chutz mizze <small>(gemara shavuot la b)</small> "al na adonay hinne na matza avdecha chen". kol hashshemot haamurim begivat binyamin kodesh. kol hashshemot haamurim bemicha chol. kol hashshemot haamurim benavot kodesh. kol shelomo haamur beshir hashshirim kodesh vahare hu kishar hakkinnuyin chutz mizze <small>(Shir hashshirim 8 12)</small> "haelef lecha shelomo". kol malchayya haamur bedaniyyel chol chutz mizze <small>(Daniel b 37)</small> "ant malka melech malchayya" vahare hu kishar hakkinnuyin:
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 7:1-3: Hameraggel bachavero over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "lo telech rachil beammecha". veaf al pi sheen lokin al davar ze avon gadol hu vegorem laharog nefashot rabbot miyyisrael. lechach nismach lo <small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "velo taamod al dam reecha". tze ulemad ma era ledoeg haadomi:

E zehu rachil. ze shettoen devarim veholech mizze laze veomer kach amar peloni kach vechach shamati al peloni. af al pi shehu emet hare ze machariv et haolam. yesh avon gadol mizze ad meod vehu bichlal lav ze vehu lashon hara. vehu hamesapper bignut chavero af al pi sheomer emet. aval haomer sheker nikra motzi shem ra al chavero. aval baal lashon hara ze sheyyoshev veomer kach vechach asa peloni vechach vechach hayu avotav vechach vechach shamati alav veamar devarim shel genay. al ze amar hakkatuv <small>(Tehillim 12 4)</small> "yachret Adonai kol sifte chalakot lashon medabberet gedolot":

Amru chachamim shalosh averot nifrain min haadam baolam hazze veen lo chelek laolam habba. avodat kochavim vegilluy arayot ushefichut damim. velashon hara keneged kullam. veod amru chachamim kol hamesapper belashon hara keillu kofer baikkar. shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 12 5)</small> "asher amru lilshonenu nagbir sefatenu ittanu mi adon lanu". veod amru chachamim shelosha lashon hara horeget. haomro. vehamekabbelo. veze sheomer alav. vehamekabbelo yoter min haomro:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 3:1-3:
Muttar lehatechil melacha meerev shabbat af al pi shehi nigmeret meeleha beshabbat. shello neesar alenu laasot melacha ella beatzmo shel yom. aval keshettease hammelacha meatzmah beshabbat muttar lanu lehanot bema shennaasa beshabbat meelav: 
Ketzad. potkin mayim lagginna erev shabbat im chashecha vehi mitmallet veholechet kol hayyom kullo. umannichin mugmar tachat hakkelim vehen mitgammerin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. umannichim kilor al gav haayin veispelanit al gabbe hammakka umitrappein veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. veshorin deyo vesammanin im chashecha vehen shorin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. venotnin tzemer leyura veunin shel pishtan lattannur vehem mishtannin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. uforsim metzudot lechayya uleofot uledagim im chashecha vehen nitztzodin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. vetoanin bekorot bet habbad uveiggule haggat im chashecha vehammashkin zavin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. umadlikin et hanner o et hammedura mibbaerev vehi doleket veholechet kol hashshabbat kullah: 
Mannichin kedera al gabbe haesh o basar battannur o al gabbe gechalim vehen mitbashshelim veholchin kol hashshabbat veochlin otah beshabbat. veyesh bedavar ze devarim shehen asurin gezera shemma yachte baggechalim beshabbat:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 1:1-4:
Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturim mittalmud tora. aval katan aviv chayyav lelammedo tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 11 19)</small> "velimmadtem otam et benechem ledabber bam". veen haishsha chayyevet lelammed et benah. shekkol hachayyav lilmod chayyav lelammed: 
Keshem shechayyav adam lelammed et beno kach hu chayyav lelammed et ben beno shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 9)</small> "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha". velo beno uven beno bilvad ella mitzva al kol chacham vechacham miyyisrael lelammed et kol hattalmidim af al pi sheenan banav. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 7)</small> "veshinnantam levanecha" mippi hashshemua lamdu banecha ellu talmidecha shehattalmidim keruyin banim shenneemar <small>(Melachim b b 3)</small> "vayyetzu vene hanneviim". im ken lamma nitztavva al beno veal ben beno. lehakedim beno leven beno uven beno leven chavero:
Vechayyav liskor melammed livno lelammedo. veeno chayyav lelammed ben chavero ella bechinnam. mi shello limmedo aviv chayyav lelammed et atzmo kesheyyakkir shenneemar <small>(Devarim 5 1)</small> "ulemadtem otam ushemartem laasotam". vechen atta motze bechol makom shehattalmud kodem lammaase mippene shehattalmud mevi lide maase veen hammaase mevi lide talmud:
Haya hu rotze lilmod tora veyesh lo ben lilmod tora hu kodem livno. veim haya beno navon umaskil lehavin ma sheyyilmod yoter mimmennu beno kodem. veaf al pi shebbeno kodem lo yibbatel hu. shekkeshem shemmitzva alav lelammed et beno kach hu metzuvve lelammed atzmo:
Niddah 13b:8-11: Baanashim tikkatzetz. ibbaya lehu: dina tenan o latuta tenan? dina tenan, ki ha derav huna katz yeda, o latuta tenan?

Ta shema, detanya: rabbi tarfon omer: yad laamma — tikkatzetz yado al tabburo. amru lo: yashav lo kotz bichreso, lo yittelennu?! amar lahen: lo. vahalo kereso nivkaat! amar lahen: mutav tibbaka kereso, veal yered liver shachat.
I amrat bishlama dina tenan, hayeynu deamri: "vahalo kereso nivkaat", ella i amrat latuta tenan, may "kereso nivkaat"? ella may dina tenan, la saggi delav al tabburo?

Ella hachi kaamar rabbi tarfon: kol hammachnis yado lematta mittabburo — tikkatzetz. amru lo lerabbi tarfon: yashav lo kotz bichreso lo yittelennu?! amar lahen: lo. vahalo kereso nivkaat! amar lahen: mutav tibbaka kereso, veal yered liver shachat.

Meat shenot meat tenumot meat ׀ chibbuk yadayim lishkav
Uva-chimhallech reshecha umachsorcha keish magen {p}
Shabbat 62b:6-17: "Vereshit shemanim yimshachu", amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ze pilyayton.
Metiv rav yosef: af al pilyayton gezar rabbi yehuda ben bava, velo hodu lo. vei amrat, mishshum taanug, ammay lo hodu lo?

Amar leh abbaye: uletamaych, ha dichtiv: "hashshotim bemizreke yayin" — rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar kenishkenin, vechad amar shemmezarkin kosotehen ze laze. hachi name daasir? veha rabba bar rav huna ikkela leve resh galuta veishti biknishkenin, vela amar leh vela midde!
Ella: kol midde deit beh taanug veit beh simcha — gezaru rabbanan, aval midde deit beh taanug velet beh simcha — la gezaru rabbanan.
"Hashshochvim al mittot shen useruchim al arsotam". amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: melammed shehayu mashtinin mayim bifne mittotehen arummim.
Megaddef ba rabbi avahu: i hachi, hayeynu dichtiv: "lachen atta yiglu berosh golim" — mishshum demashtinin mayim bifne mittotehem arummim yiglu berosh golim?!
Ella amar rabbi avahu: ellu bene adam shehayu ochlim veshotim ze im ze, vedovkin mittotehen zo bazo, umachalifin neshotehen ze im ze, umasrichin arsotam beshichvat zera sheeno shellahen.
Amar rabbi avahu, veamri la bematnita tana: shelosha devarim meviin et haadam lide aniyyut, veellu hen: hammashtin mayim bifne mittato arom, umezalzel bintilat yadayim, vesheishto mekallalto befanav.
Hammashtin mayim bifne mittato arom, amar rava: la amaran ella demahdar appeh lefureyeh, aval levaray — let lan ba.
Umahdar appeh lefureyeh, name la amaran ella leara, aval bemana — let lan ba.
Umezalzel bintilat yadayim, amar rava: la amaran ella dela mesha yedeh kelal, aval mesha vela mesha — let lan ba.
Velav milleta hi, deamar rav chisda: ana meshay mele chafnay mayya vihavu li mele chafnay tevuta.
Yevamot 62b:8-63a:1: Matnitin delav kerabbi yehoshua, detanya, rabbi yehoshua omer: nasa adam ishsha beyalduto — yissa ishsha beziknuto. hayu lo banim beyalduto — yihyu lo banim beziknuto, shenneemar: "babboker zera et zarecha velaerev al tannach yadecha ki encha yodea e ze yichshar haze o ze veim shenehem keechad tovim".

Rabbi akiva omer: lamad tora beyalduto — yilmod tora beziknuto. hayu lo talmidim beyalduto — yihyu lo talmidim beziknuto, shenneemar: "babboker zera et zarecha vegomer". amru: shenem asar alef zugim talmidim hayu lo lerabbi akiva miggevat ad antifras, vechullan metu beferek echad, mippene shello nahagu kavod ze laze.

Vehaya haolam shamem, ad shebba rabbi akiva etzel rabbotenu shebbaddarom ushenaah lahem: rabbi meir, verabbi yehuda, verabbi yose, verabbi shimon, verabbi elazar ben shammua, vehem hem heemidu tora otah shaa.
Tana, kullam metu mippesach vead atzeret. amar rav chama bar abba veittema rabbi chiyyay bar avin: kullam metu mita raa. may hi? amar rav nachman: askara.
Amar rav matna: halacha kerabbi yehoshua.

Amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi chanilay: kol adam sheen lo ishsha — sharuy belo simcha, belo beracha, belo tova. belo simcha, dichtiv: "vesamachta atta uvetecha". belo beracha, dichtiv: "lehaniach beracha el betecha". belo tova, dichtiv: "lo tov heyot haadam levaddo".
Bemareva amri: belo tora, belo choma. belo tora, dichtiv: "haim en ezrati vi vetushiyya niddecha mimmenni". belo choma, dichtiv: "nekeva tesovev gaver".
Rava bar ulla amar: belo shalom, dichtiv: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha ufakadta navcha velo techeta".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hayyodea beishto shehi yirat shamayim veeno pokdah — nikra chote, shenneemar: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha vegomer". veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: chayyayv adam lifkod et ishto beshaa shehu yotze ladderech, shenneemar: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha vegomer".
Ha mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "veel ishech teshukatech", melammed shehaishsha mishtokeket al balah beshaa shehu yotze lederech! amar rav yosef: lo nitzrecha ella samuch levivstah.
Vechamma? amar rava: ona. vehane mille lidvar harshut, aval lidvar mitzva — mitteridi.

Tanu rabbanan: haohev et ishto kegufo, vehamechabbedah yoter miggufo, vehammadrich banav uvenotav bederech yeshara, vehammassian samuch lefirkan — alav hakkatuv omer: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha". haohev et shechenav, vehamekarev et kerovav, vehannose et bat achoto,
Vehammalve sela leani bishat dochko — alav hakkatuv omer: "az tikra vaAdonai yaane teshavva veyomar hinneni".
Zevachim 64b:6-12: Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehizza middam hachattat" – migguf hachattat. ha ketzad? ochez barosh uvagguf, umazze al kir hammizbeach; velo al kir hakkevesh, velo al kir hechol, velo al kir ulam. veeze? ze kir hattachton.
O eno ella kir haelyon? vedin hu: uma behema, sheolatah lematta – chattatah lemala; of, sheolato lemala – eno din shechattato lemala?!
Talmud lomar: "vehannishar baddam yimmatze el yesod hammizbeach" – kir shehashsheyarin shello mitmatztzim laysod; veeze? ze kir hattachton.
Venabed meillay, vahadar nabed mittattay! amar rava: mi ketiv "yematztze"?! "yimmatze" ketiv, demimmela mashma.
Amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: ketzad molkin chattat haof? ochez gappav bishte etzbaot ushete raglayim bishte etzbaot, umoteach tzavvarah al rochav gudalo, umolkah.
Bematnita tena: tzippera millevar; ochez gappav bishte etzbaot ushene raglayim bishte etzbaot, umoteach tzavvaro al rochav shete etzbeotav, umolek. vezo avoda kasha shebbammikdash.
Zo hi – vetu la?! vehaikka kemitza vachafina! ella ema: zo avoda kasha meavodot kashot shebbammikdash.
Zohar, Addenda, Volume I 41:342: Tana ammud echad min haaretz ad larakia vetzaddik shemo al shem hatztzaddikim ukkeshyisrael tzaddikim mitgabber veim lav mitchalesh vehu sovel kol haolam dichtiv (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam. veim chalash lo yuchal lehitkayyem haolam. ad kan:
Zohar, Toldot 1: Veelle (Bereshit 28) toldot yitzchak vegomer. patach rabbi chiyyay veamar (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato. ta chazi, kad baa kudesha berich hu vesalik biruta kammeh lemivre alma, hava mistakkel beorayyta, uvera leh, uvechol ovada veovada devara kudesha berich hu vealma hav mistakkel beorayyta, uvara leh. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon vaehye shaashuim yom yom al tikre amon, ella uman.

Kad baa lemivre adam amra tora kammeh, i bar nash yitbere, ulevatar yechote veant tidun leh, ammay yehon ovade yedach lemaggana, deha la yechul lemisbal dinach. amar leh kudesha berich hu, ha atkinat teshuva ad la varati alma, amar kudesha berich hu lealma beshaata deavad leh uvara leadam, amar leh, alma alma, ant venimusach la kayymin ella al orayyta. uvegin kach barati leh laadam bach, begin deyitassak bah. vei lav, ha ana ahadar lach letohu vavohu vecholla begineh deadam kayyma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 45:12) anochi asiti eretz veadam aleha barati. veorayyta kayyma umachreza kammayyhu divne nasha, begin deyitasseku veyishtaddelu bah velet man deyarchin udeneh.

Ta chaze, kol man deishtaddal beorayyta ihu kiyyem alma, vekiyyem kol ovada veovada al tikkuneh kedka yeut, velet lach kol shayyfa veshayyfa dekayyma beh bevar nash, dela have lekovleh beriya bealma. deha kema devar nash ihu mitpallig shayyfin, vechullehu kayymin dargin al dargin mittaknin illen al illen vechullehu chad gufa, hachi name alma, kol inun beriyyayn kullehu shayyfin shayyfin, vekayymin illen al illen, vechad mittaknan kullehu, ha gufa mammash. vecholla kegavvna deorayyta, deha orayyta kolla shayyfin ufirkin, vekayymin illen al illen, vechad mittakkenan kullehu, itavidu chad gufa. kevan deistakkal david beovada da, patach veamar, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyancha.

Beorayyta inun kol razin illain chatimin dela yachlin leitdabbaka, beorayyta kol inun millin illain, deitgalleyayn vela itgalleyayn, beorayyta inun kol millin dilela uletatta, kol millin dealma den, vechol millin dealma deate beorayyta inun, velet man deyashgach veyada lon, uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato.

Ta chaze ata shelomo uvaa lemekam al milloy deorayyta, veal dikduke orayyta, vela yachil, amar (Kohelet 7:23) amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni. david amar, (Tehillim 119:18) gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha. ta chaze, ketiv bishlomo (Melachim 1 Adonai:12) vaydabber sheloshet alafim mashal vayhi shiro chamishsha vaalef. veha ukemuha. dechamishsha veelef teamim havu bechol mashal umashal dehava amar. uma shelomo deihu basar vadam kach havu bemilloy, millin deorayyta dekaamar kudesha berich hu, al achat kamma vechamma, debchol milla umilla it bah kamma meshalim, kamma shirin, kamma tushebchan, kamma razin illain, kamma chachman veal da ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv leela, (Bereshit 25:12) veelle toldot yishmael, deinun teresar nesiin, levatar amar veelle toldot yitzchak, salleka datach dechevan dichtiv beh beyishmael deolid terisar nesiin, veyitzchak olid teren benin, deda istallak veda la istallak. al da ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai, da yitzchak, veyitzchak appik leh leyaakov dehava ihu bilchodoy yattir mikkullehu, deolid teresar shivtin, kiyyuma dilela vetatta. aval yitzchak leela bikdushsha illaa (sefer acher veyishmael) veesav letatta, veal da ketiv, mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato, da yaakov kad itdabbak shimsha besihara kamma kochvaya nehirin minnayyhu.

(Bereshit 25:19) veelle toldot yitzchak ben avraham. amar ribbi yose, may shena dead hacha la ketiv ben avraham vehasheta amar, ella af al gav dichtiv vayvarech elohim et yitzchak beno, hasheta demit avraham diukeneh hava beh, veishtaar beh beyitzchak, dechol man dechame leyitzchak hava amar da avraham vadday, vehava sahid veamar (Bereshit 25:19) avraham holid et yitzchak.

Rabbi yitzchak kam lelya chad lemile beorayyta, verabbi yehuda kam bekesaroy, behahi shata. amar rabbi yehuda, ekum veezil legabbe rabbi yitzchak, veile beorayyta venitchabbar kechada. azal immeh chizkiyya berih dehava ravya. kad kariv abbava, shama leh leribbi yitzchak dehava amar, vayhi achare mot avraham vayvarech elohim et yitzchak beno vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, hay kera lav resheh sefeh velav sefeh resheh, may shena dekudesha berich hu itzterich levarcha leh leyitzchak, begin deavraham la beracheh. may taama, mishshum dela yitbarech esav, veal da seliku inun birchan lekudesha berich hu, veukemuha. vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, may lachay roi, ella deitchabbar vah bishchinta, bera demalach kayayma itchaze alah, ketargumo, uvegin kach beracheh.

Adhachi, batash rabbi yehuda abbava veal, veitchabbaru. amar rabbi yitzchak, hasheta ziuuga dishchinta bahadan. amar ribbi yehuda, hay beer lachay roi dekaamart shappir, aval bemilla ishtema. patach veamar, (Shir hashshirim 4:15) mayan gannim beer mayim chayyim venozlim min levanon, hay kera ittemar aval ha ukemuha, mayan ganim da avraham beer mayim chayyim da yitzchak, venozlim min levanon da yaakov. beer mayim chayyim da yitzchak, hayeynu dichtiv vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi. umay beer da shechinta. lachay, da chay haolamim, tzaddik chay haolamim velet leafrasha lon, chay hu bitri almin, chay leela, deihu alma illaa, chay legabbe alma tattaa, vealma tattaa begineh kayyma venahara.

Ta chaze, sihara la itnehirat, ella kad chazya leh leshimsha, vechevan dechazya leh, itnehir. veal da hay beer lachay roi vadday, ucheden itnahara, vekayyma bemayin chayin, lachay roi, begin leitmalleya uleitnahara mehay chay.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Shmuel b 23:20) uvenayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay dehava tzaddik venahir ledareh, kema dechay dilela nahir lealma. uvechol zimna hay beer lachay istakkal vechame, begin leitnahara kidkaamaran. vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi. hayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:11) bekachto et rivka, veyativ bahadah, veitachid immah, choshech ballayla, dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi. veta chaze, yitzchak bekiryat arba hava batar demit avraham, mahu vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, deizdavvavg beh, veachid beh behahu bera, leatara rechimuta kidkaamaran.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar, (Kohelet 1:Adonai) vezarach hashshemesh vva hashshemesh veel mekomo shoef zoreach hu sham. vezarach hashshemesh, da shimsha denahir lesihara, dechad itchaze bahadah keden nahara, veitnehir vezarach meatar illaa dekayyma aleh, mittamman zarach tadir. uva hashshemesh, leizdavvevga bahadah desihara. (Kohelet 1:6) holech el darom, deihu yemina veshavve tukefeh beh, uvegin detukefeh beh, kol chela degufa bimina hu uveh talya. ulevatar sovev el tzafon, nahir lesitra da venahir lesitra da. sovev sovev holech haruach, bekadmita ketiv shemesh, vehasheta ruach. ella kolla chad veraza chada, vechol da begin desihara itnahara minneh veyitchabberun tarvavyyhu.

Ta chaze, kad ata avraham lealma chavik lah lesihara vekariv lah, kevan deata yitzchak achid bah veatkif bah kedka yeut, umashich lah birchimu, kema deittemar dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat lerosh. kevan deata yaakov, keden itchabbar shimsha besihara veitnehir, veishtakkach yaakov shelim vechol sitrin, vesihara itnehirat veittakkanat bitresar shivtin.

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar (Tehillim 134:1) hinni barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai vegomer. hay kera ukemuha, aval ta chaze, hinne barchu et Adonai, uman inun deyitchazun levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, kol avde Adonai, begin dechol bar nash bealma miyyisrael af al gav decholla yitchazun levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, birchata divginayyhu yitbarchun illain vetattain man hi, hahi devarchin leh avde Adonai vela kullehu. uman inun devirkathon bircheta, haomdim bevet Adonai ballelot, illen inun dekayymu befalgut lelya veitare lemikre beorayyta. illen kayyme bevet Adonai ballelot, deha keden kudesha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikaya beginta deeden. veanan kayyme hacha leitara bemille deorayyta, nema bemille deyitzchak, deanan beh.
Zohar, Toldot 11: (Bereshit 26:1) vayhi raav baaretz millevad haraav harishon vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 11:5) Adonai tzaddik yivchan verasha veohev (600 nachash) chamas sana nafsho. kamma ovadoy dekudesha berich hu mittaknan, vechol ma deihu avid kolla al dina ukeshot, kema dichtiv, (Devarim lak) hatztzur tamim poolo ki chol derachav mishpat el emuna veen avel tzaddik veyashar hu.

Ta chaze, la dan kudesha berich hu leadam kadmaa ad depakkid le letoalteh, dela yiste libbeh ureuteh leorach ochora begin dela yistaav. veihu la istammar, veavar al pikkude demareh ulevatar ken dan leh dina.
Veim kol da, la dan leh kedka chaze leh, veorich immeh rugezeh veitkeyyaym yoma chad deihu elef shenin, bar inun shivim shanim demasar leh ledavid malka dela hava leh miggarmeh kelum.

Kegavvna da, la dan leh lebar nash keovadoy bishin deihu avid tadir, dei hachi la yachil alma leitkayyma, ella kudesha berich hu arich rugezeh im tzaddikaya, veim rashshiaya yattir mitztzaddikaya. im rashshiaya begin dituvun bityuveta shelemata, deyitkayymun behay alma uvealma deate. kema dichtiv, (yechezkel 33:11) chay ani neum Adonai vegomer im echpotz vegomer ki im beshuv rasha middarko vechaya. vechaya bealma den, vechaya bealma deate, veal da orich rugezeh lon tadir. o begin deyippuk minnehon giza tava bealma kema deappik avraham mitterach deihu giza tava, vesharasha vechulaka tava lealma.

Aval kudesha berich hu medakdek im tzaddikaya tadir, bechol ovadin deinun avdin. begin deyada dela yistun leyamina usemala, uvegin kach avchin lon. lav begineh, deha ihu yada yitzra vetukefa dimhemnuta dilhon, ella begin laarama rishehon beginayyhu.

Kegavvna da, avad leh leavraham, dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:1) vehaelohim nissa et avraham. may nissa, haramat nes. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:10) harimu nes, (Yirmeyahu 4:6) seu nes, arim digla dileh bechol alma, veaf al gav deha ittemar, begin da kudesha berich hu arim digla deavraham beenehon decholla, hada hu dichtiv nissa et avraham, uf hachi kudesha berich hu begin laarama digla detzaddikaya ihu bachin lon, laarama reshayyhu bechol alma.

(Tehillim 11:5) tzaddik yivchan, may tama, amar ribbi shimon begin dekudesha berich hu kad itrae behu betzaddikaya, ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 53:10) vaAdonai chafetz dakkeo hecholi. veukemuha. aval begin diruta dekudesha berich hu, la itrae ella benishmata, aval begufa la, deha nishmata ihi damya lenishmata dilela, vegufa lav ihu chaze leitachada leela, veaf al gav dediukena degufa beraza illaa ihu.

Veta chaze, bezimna dekudesha berich hu itrae benishmateh debar nash, leithannaa (nusach acher leitnahara) vah, mache legufa begin detishlot nishmata. deha beod denishmata im gufa, nishmata la yachla leshaltaa. dechad itra (nusach acher itbar) gufa, nishmata shalta. tzaddik yivchan, may tzaddik yivchan, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 28:16) even bochan, hachi name tzaddik yivchan, atkif leh. kehay even bochan, dehi (Yeshayahu 28:16) pinnat yikrat, hachi name tzaddik yivchan.

Verasha veohev chamas sana nafsho. may sana nafsho, salleka datach dekudesha berich hu have denafsho sana lehahu rasha. ella hahu darga dechol nishmatin talyayn beh, sana nafsho dehahu rasha, dela baya lah kelal. la baya lah la bealma den vela bealma deate. uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 11:5) verasha veohev chamas sana nafsho, vadday. davar acher sana nafsho, kema deat amer, (Amos 6:8) nishba adonay Adonai benafsho, uvegin kach tzaddik yivchan.

Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu leadam, pakkid leh leotava leh, yahav leh chachmeta, istallak bedargoy leela. kad nachat letatta, chama tiuveta deyetzer hara veitdabbak beh, veinshe kol ma deistallak (sefer acher deistakkal), bikara illaa demareh.

Ata noach, bekadmita ketiv, (Bereshit 6:9) noach ish tzaddik tamim haya, ulevatar nachat letatta, vechama chamra takkif, dela tzalel, mechad yoma, veishte minneh, veishtakkar veitgeli, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:21) vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch oholo.

Ata avraham, istallak bechachmeta, veistakkal bikara demareh, levatar (Bereshit 12:10) vayhi raav baaretz vayyered avram ymitzrayma lagur sham ki chaved haraav baaretz vegomer. levatar ma ketiv, (Bereshit 13:1) vayyaal avram mimitzrayim hu veishto vechol asher lo velot immo hannegba, veistallak ledargeh kadmaa dehava beh bekadmita, veal bishlam venafak bishlam.

Ata yitzchak, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 26:1) vayhi raav baaretz millevad haraav harishon vegomer. veazal yitzchak veistallak mittamman levatar bishlam. vechullehu tzaddikayay, kullehu bachin lon kudesha berich hu, begin laarama reshayyhu bealma den uvealma deate.
Zohar, Toldot 14: (Bereshit 26:22) vayyatek mishsham vayyachpor beer acheret vegomer, ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 58:11) venachacha Adonai tamid vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha veatzmotecha yachalitz vegomer. hay kera ukemuha veittemar. aval behay kera, beh ittakkafu mare mehemnuta deavtach lon lealma deate. venachacha Adonai tamid behay alma uvealma deate. venachacha Adonai, kevan deamar venachacha Adonai, ammay tamid. ella da tamid deven haarbayim, deihu ittakkaf techot deroeh deyitzchak, veda hu chulaka lealma deate, menalan middavid dichtiv, (Tehillim 23:3) yancheni bemagele tzedek lemaan shemo.

(Yeshayahu 58:11) vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha, da aspaklarya denahara, dechol nishmatin ithannan leistakkala uleitanaga begavav. veatzmotecha yachalitz, hay kera lav risheh sofeh. i nishmateh detzaddika, (salleka leella, nusach acher ithane beidduna da dilella) may veatzmotecha yachalitz. ella ha ukemuha. da techiyyayt hammetim, dezammin kudesha berich hu leachayay metaya uleatkana lon legarmoy devar nash lemeheve kekadmita begufa shelim. venishmata ittosfat nehora go aspaklarya denahara, leitnahara im gufa lekayyma shelim kedka chaze.

Uvegin kach ketiv, vehayita kegan rave. may kegan rave, dela pasku memoy illain, lealam ulealme almin, vehay ginta itshakke minneh, veitravve minneh tadir. uchemotza mayim, da hahu nahar denagid venafik meeden vela paskin memoy lealmin.

Ta chaze, bera demayyin navin, hay ihu raza illaa bego raza dimhemnuta. bera deit beh motza mayim, veihu bera deitmalleya mehahu motza mayim, veinun teren dargin deinun chad, dechar venukeva kechada kedka yeut.

Veta chaze, hahu motza mayim vehahu bera inun chad, veikre kolla beer. deha hahu mekora deayyil, vela pasik lealmin, uvera itmele. uman deistakkal bevera da, istakkal beraza illaa dimhemnuta, veda hu simana deavahan, demishtaddele lachpor bera demaya go raza illaa, velet leafrasha ben mekora uvera vecholla chad.

(Bereshit 26:22) vayyikra shemah rechovot. ramiz dezamminin benoy lemiflach uleatkana hay bera kedka chaze, beraza dekarbanin veillavvavn. kegavvna da, (Bereshit 2:15) vayyannichehu began eden leavdah uleshamrah, illen karbanin veillavvavn uvegin da, yitpashshetun mabbuoy lechol sitrin kema deat amer, (Mishlei Adonai:16) veyafutzu mayenotecha chutza barchovot palge mayim, uvegin kach vayyikra shemah rechovot.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Mishlei 1:20) chachmot bachutz tarona barchovot titten kolah. hay kera ihu raza illaa. may chachmot, illen chachma illaa vechachmeta zeera deitkelilat bah beillaa vesharya vah.

Bachutz tarona. ta chaze, chachma illaa ihi setima dechol setimin, vela ityeyda velav ihi beitgalleya, kema deat amer, (iyyov 28:13) lo yada enosh erkah vegomer, kad itpashtat leitnahara, itnahara beraza dealma deate, vealma deate itbere minneh. keditnan alma deate itbere beYod, veitkasya hay chachma tamman veinun chad. bezimna deitattad (nusach acher deitattar nusach acher deitavad) kolla beraza dealma deate kidkaamaran, keden hu chedva leitnahara, vecholla bachashay dela ishtema levar lealmin.

Tu baya leitpashsheta, venafik mehay atar esha umaya verucha, kema deittemar (74 amud alef). veitavid chad kala denafka levar veishtema, kema deittemar. keden mittamman ulehallan ihu chutz, deha lego bachashay ihu dela ishtema lealmin, hasheta deishtema raza, ikre chutz, mikkan bae bar nash leatkana baavidteh (pikkude 226 amud alef) uleshoola.

Barchovot, man rechovot, da hahu rekia deveh kol kochavaya denaharin, veihu mabbua dememoy la faskin. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan, veihu rechovot. vetamman titten kolah, illaa vetattaa vecholla chad.

Uvegin da amar shelomo, (Mishlei 24:27) hachen bachutz melachtecha veattedah bassade lach vegomer. hachen bachutz, kema deittemar. dichtiv bachutz tarona, deha mikkan kayyma avida leittakkana umilla leshaala, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:32) ki sheal na leyamim rishonim vegomer, ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim.

Veattedah bassade lach, da (Bereshit 27:27) sade asher beracho Adonai. uvatar deyinda bar nash raza dechachmeta veyatkin garmeh vah, ma ketiv achar, uvanita vetecha. da nishmata devar nash begufeh, deyittakkan veyitavid gevar shelim. veal da kad chafar yitzchak veavad bera bishlam, lehahu shelam (nusach acher lemeheve shelim) kare leh rechovot, vecholla kedka yeut. zakkain inun tzaddikaya deovadehon legabbe kudesha berich hu lekayyma alma. dichtiv, (Mishlei 2:21) ki yesharim yishkenu aretz, yashkinu aretz. veha ukemuha.
Zohar, Toldot 16: (Bereshit 27:1) vayyikra et esav beno haggadol, deitkellal missitreh dedina kashya (sham) vayyomer hinne na zakanti lo yadati yom moti. ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Tehillim 84:6) ashre adam oz lo vach vegomer, zakkaa bar nash deittakkaf beh bekudesha berich hu veyashve tokfeh beh.

Yachol kachananya mishael vaazarya deittakkafu veamru, (Daniel 3:17) hen itay elahana di anachna falchin yachol leshezavutana miggo attun nura yakidta umin yedacha malka yesheziv. ta chaze, dei la yesheziv vela itkeyyaym alayyhu kudesha berich hu, ishtakkach shemeh dekudesha berich hu, dela yitkaddash beenayyhu decholla kema deamru. ella, kevan deyadu dela amru kedka yeut, ahadaru veamru, (Daniel 3:18) vehen la yedia leheve lach malka vegomer. ben yesheziv, ben la yesheziv, yedia lehve lach malka vegomer. vetaninan demilla oda lehu yechezkel, veshamu vekabbilu minneh, dekudesha berich hu la itkeyyaym alayyhu, begin dikabbelun agra. ucheden ahadaru veamru, vehen la yedia leheve lach malka vegomer.

Ella la yittakkaf bar nash deyema, kudesha berich hu yeshezvinani, o ihu avid li kach vechach, aval yeshavve tukefeh beh bekudesha berich hu disayyea leh, kad ihu ishtaddal beinun pikkudin deorayyta, ulemehach beorach keshot. dechevan deate bar nash leitdakkaa, mesayyin leh vadday, uveda yittakkaf beh bekudesha berich hu, deihu yesayyea leh, veyittakkaf beh, dela yashve tukefeh beochora, uvegin kach oz lo vach. mesillot bilvavam, deyaavid libbeh kedka yeut bela hirhura ochora, ella kehay mesilla deihi mityayshva leaavara bechol atar deitzterich, hachi name.

Davar acher ashre adam oz lo vach, oz, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 29:11) Adonai oz leammo yitten, begin deitzterich leh lebar nash deyitassak beorayyta lishmeh dekudesha berich hu, dechol man deitassak beorayyta vela ishtaddal lishmah, tav leh dela itbere. mesillot bilvavam, may mesillot bilvavam, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 68:5) solu larochev baaravot beyah shemo. da hahi orayyta, deihu ishtaddal bah learama leh lekudesha berich hu ulemebad leh chativa bealma.

Ta chaze, yaakov kol ovadoy havu lishma dekudesha berich hu, uvegin kach kudesha berich hu hava immeh tadir, dela aade minneh shechinta. deha beshata dekara leh yitzchak leesav bereh, yaakov la hava tamman, ushechinta odaat lah lerivka, verivka odaat leh leyaakov.

Ribbi yose amar, ta chaze, i chas veshalom behahu zimna yitbarach esav, la shelot yaakov lealmin. ella meim kudesha berich hu hava, vecholla beatreh ata kedka chaze. ta chaze, (Bereshit 25:28) verivka ohevet et yaakov ketiv, veha ittemar. uvegin kach shadrat begineh deyaakov, (Bereshit 27:6) hinne shamati et avicha medabber el esav achicha lemor.
Veatta beni shema bekoli vegomer. behahu zimna, erev pesach hava, uvae yetzer hara leitbaara, uleshalletaa sihara, raza dimhemnuta. veal da avdat tere tavshilin.

Ribbi yehuda amar, ramaz hacha dezamminin benoy deyaakov lekarva shene seirim, chad laAdonai, vechad laazazel beyoma dechippure. uvegin kach, karivat shene gedaye izzim, (145 amud bet) chad begin darga dilela, vechad begin lechafyay dargeh deesav dela yishlot aleh deyaakov, veal da sheni gedaye izzim, umittarvayyhu taim yitzchak veachil.

(Bereshit 27:25) vayyave lo yayin vayyesht, vayyave lo yayin, remez ramiz, meatar rachik kariv leh mehahu atar (deesav). ribbi elazar amar, remez mehahu yayin dechol chadu ishtechach beh, begin lechadta leh leyitzchak, devae chedva, kedka bayayn chedva lechadta sitra (delevae) dileh, veal da vayyave lo yayin vayyesht.
Zohar, Toldot 19: Ta chaze, beshata deamar yitzchak leesav, (Bereshit 27:3) vetze hassade vetzuda li tzayido, beHei, veukemuha. venafak esav begin deyitbarech miyyitzchak, dekaamar leh, (Bereshit 27:7) vaavarechcha lifne Adonai, deillu amar vaavarechcha vela yattir, yaot. kevan deamar lifne Adonai, behahi shata izdaza karse yekara dekudesha berich hu, amra, uma deyippuk chivya meinun levavtin, veyishtaar yaakov behu.

Behahi shata, izdamman michael veata kammeh deyaakov, ushechinta bahadeh, veyada yitzchak, vechama legan eden bahadeh deyaakov, uvarcheh kammeh. vechad al esav, al bahadeh gehinnom. veal da (Bereshit 27:33) vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod, dechashav dela hava esav behahu sitra, patach veamar, (Bereshit 27:33) vaavorachehu gam baruch yihye.

Begin kach, izdamman yaakov bechachmeta uvaakimu deayyte birchan aleh deyaakov deihu kegavvna deadam harishon, veitnetalu mehahu chivya deihu sefat shaker. dechamma shikra amar, vechamma mille deshikra avad, begin leataa uleayytaa levavtin al alma. begin kach, ata yaakov bechachma veate leavuy, begin leayytaa birchan al alma, ulenatla minneh ma demana mealma, umidda lokovel midda hava. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 109:17) vayyeehav kelala vattevoehu velo chafetz bivracha vattirchak mimmennu. aleh ketiv, (Bereshit 3:14) arur atta mikkol habbehema umikkol chayyat hassade. veishtaar beh ledare darin, veata yaakov venatil minneh birchan.

Umin yomoy deadam, izdamman yaakov lenatla mehahu chivya, kol hanne birchan, veishtaar ihu bilvavtin vela nafak minnayyhu. vedavid amar beruach kudesha, (Tehillim 120:3-4) ma yitten lecha uma yosif lach lashon remiyya chitztze gibbor shenunim. ma ichpat leh lehahu chivya visha, deayyte levavtin al alma. kema deamru, nachash noshech umemit, velet leh hanaa minneh.

Lashon remiyya, derame leh leadam uleitteteh, veayyte bisha aleh veal alma. levatar ata yaakov, venatil middileh kol inun birchan. chitztze gibbor shenunim, da esav denatar devavu (nusach acher daagazeym) leyaakov al inun birchan, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 27:41) vayyistom esav et yaakov al habberacha vegomer. (davar acher 33 ta chaze)

Veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz, ha milleela umittatta bechibbura chada. verov dagan vetirosh, ha ukemuha. aval kedichtiv, (Tehillim 37:25) velo raiti tzaddik neezav vezaro mevakkesh lachem. ta chaze, (sham) naar hayiti vegomer veukemuha, hay kera saro shel olam amaro vechulei. uvegin kach amar verov dagan vetirosh.

Yaavducha ammim veyishtachavu lecha leummim, bezimna deshallit shelomo malka biyrushalam, dichtiv, (divre hayamim b 9:24) vechol malche haaretz vegomer meviim ish minchato vegomer. (Bereshit 27) veyishtachavu lecha leummim, bezimna deyete malka meshicha, dichtiv, (Tehillim 72:11) veyishtachavu lo chol melachim. ribbi yehuda amar, kolla bezimna deyete malka meshicha, kedichtiv veyishtachavu lo chol melachim kol goyim yaavduhu.

Hve gevir leachecha, hve, vela amar hye, o tihye. ella da raza illaa dimhemnuta, deillen atvavn innun raze dimhemnuta. Adonai leela, vav beemtzaita, Adonai levatar. uvegin kach amar, heve gevir leachecha, leshalletaa alayyhu uleraddaa lon, bezimna deata david malka. ribbi yose amar, kolla ihu bezimna deyete malka meshicha, deha begin deavru yisrael al pitgame orayyta, keden (Bereshit 27:40) ufarakta ullo meal tzavvarecha.

Veyitten lecha haelohim ribbi yose amar, kol hanne birchan missitra dechulakeh deyaakov havu umiddileh natal, veillen birchan hava ka bae yitzchak levarcha leh leesav, uvegin kach avad kudesha berich hu, vegaram leh leyaakov lenatla middileh.

Ta chaze, beshata dehahu nachash ayyte levavtin al alma veitlatya ara, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 3:17) uleadam amar ki shamata lekol ishtecha vegomer, arura haadama baavurecha vegomer, dela tehe avda perin veibbin kedka yeut. lokovel da, umishmanne haaretz. (sham) beitztzavon tochalenna, lokovel da mittal hashshamayim. (sham) vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach, lokovel da, verov dagan vetirosh. (sham) bezeat appecha tochal lechem, lokovel da, (Bereshit 27:28) yaavducha ammim veyishtachavu lecha leummim, deinun yaavdun ara veyiflechun bechakla, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 61:5) uveni nechar ikkarechem vechormechem. vecholla natal yaakov, da lokovel da, umiddileh natal. vekudesha berich hu garim leh leyaakov deyittol hanne birchan, leitdabbeka beatreh vechulakeh, veesav leitdabbeka beatreh vechulakeh.
Amar rabbi chizkiyya, veha chaminan demishmanne haaretz umital hashshamayim, inun birchan natal esav levatar, kema deat amer, hinne mishmanne haaretz yihye moshavecha umital hashshamayim meal.

Amar ribbi shimon, lav hay kehay vela da keda, kamma itparshan dargin. beyaakov ketiv, veyitten lecha haelohim, uveda ketiv yihye. beyaakov ketiv, mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz, beesav ketiv mishmanne haaretz vetal hashshamayim, deha lav da ihu keda.

Vedargin itparshan kamma vechamma. begin divda deyaakov ketiv beh, veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim, da tal illaa denagid meattik yomin deikre tal hashshamayim, hashshamayim dilela, tal denagid bedarga deshamayim, umittamman lachakal tappuchin kaddishin. umishmanne haaretz, haaretz, (da eretz dilella eretz hachayyim) beesav ketiv umishmanne haaretz, beyaakov mishmanni haaretz da eretz hachayyim dilela, veyarit lah beara dilela uvashshamayim dilela. uleesav beara dehacha letatta, uvashshamayim dehacha letatta. yaakov leela leela. esav letatta letatta.

Tu, yaakov leela vetatta, veesav letatta. veaf al gav dichtiv (Bereshit 27:40) vehaya kaasher tarid ufarakta ullo meal tzavvarecha. mehay dehacha letatta, aval leela la chelum, dichtiv, (tehillim lak) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato. ta chaze, beshata desharu lenatla birchan dilhon, yaakov veesav. yaakov natal chulakeh dilela, veesav natil chulakeh letatta.
Ribbi yose beribbi shimon ben lakuneya amar leribbi elazar, kelum shamata meavicha, ammay la itkayymu birchan devarcheh yitzchak leyaakov, veinun birchan divrich yitzchak leesav itkayymu kullehu.

Amar leh, kol inun birchan mitkayyme, uvirchan ochoranin devarcheh kudesha berich hu leyaakov. aval miyyad, yaakov natal leela, veesav natil letatta. levatar kad yakum malka meshicha, yittol yaakov leela vetatta veyitavid esav mikkolla, vela yehe leh chuleka veachsana veducherana bealma, kema deat amer, (Ovadya 1:18) vehaya bet yaakov esh uvet yosef lehava uvet esav lekash vegomer. begin deyitavid esav mikkolla, veyarit yaakov teren almin, alma den vealma deate.

Uvehay zimna ketiv, (Ovadya 1:21) vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav vehayta laAdonai hamelucha. hahu malchu deesav, denatal behay alma, yahav leh kudesha berich hu (sefer acher yehe leh lekudesha berich hu) bilchodoy. vechi hasheta lav ihi malchu mikudesha berich hu, ella af al gav deshallit kudesha berich hu leela vetatta, ha yahav lon lishar amin, lechol chad vechad chulak veachsanta behay alma, leishtammasha beh. uvehahi zimna, yittol mikkullehu malchuta, utehe dileh kolla, dichtiv vehayta laAdonai hamelucha, leh bilchodoy, dichtiv, (zecharya 14:9) vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

(Bereshit 27:30) vayhi ach yatzo yatza yaakov vegomer. ribbi shimon amar, ach yatzo yatza, tere yetziot hallalu lamma. ella chad dishchinta vechad deyaakov, deha kad al yaakov, shechinta alat immeh, vekamme shechinta itberach. deyitzchak hava amar birchan, ushechinta ode lehu alayyhu. vechad nafak yaakov, shechinta nafkat immeh, hada hu dichtiv ach yatzo yatza yaakov, tere yetziot kechad.

(Bereshit 27:30) veesav achiv ba mitztzedo. min hatztzayid la ketiv, ella mitztzedo, deihu tzeda dileh, dela hava beh beracha, veruach hakkodesh tzavvcha veamra, (Mishlei 23:6) al tilcham et lechem ra ayin.

Vayyaas gam hu matammim vegomer. (Bereshit 27:31) yakum avi, dibbureh hava beazzut, bitkifu rucha, milla delet bah taama, yakum avi. ta chaze, ma ben yaakov leesav, yaakov amar bichsifu deavoy, baanava, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 27:18) vayyavo el aviv vayyomer avi. ma ben hay lehay, ella, dela vaa leizdazea leh, mallil belashon tachanunim, (Bereshit 27:19) kum na sheva veachla mitztzedi. veesav amar, yakum avi, keman dela mallil immeh.

Ta chaze, beshata deal esav, al immeh gehinnom, izdaza yitzchak, vedachil. dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:33) vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod. kevan dichtiv vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola, day. mahu (gedola) ad meod. ela, dela hava dechilu veemata. denafal aleh deyitzchak, rabbata, miyyome deitbere. veafilu behahi shata, deitakad yitzchak al gabbe madbecha vechama (shechinta) sakkina aleh, la izdaza. kehahi shata deal esav, vechama gehinnom deal immeh, keden amar, beterem tavo (sham) vaavarachehu gam baruch yihye, begin (dechamat) dechamit shechinta deode al inun birchan.

Davar acher, yitzchak amar vaavarachehu, nafak kala veamar, gam baruch yihye, baa yitzchak lemelat leh leyaakov, amar leh kudesha berich hu, yitzchak, garmach ana (ant) layyt, deha kevar amart leh, (sham) orarecha arur umevarachecha baruch.
Ta chaze kolla odu al inun birchan, illae vetattae, veafillu ihu chulak adveh deesav, odi alayyhu uvarcheh ihu, veode al inun birchan vesalkeh al resheh leela.

Menalan, dichtiv, (Bereshit lak) vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani. vayyomer shalcheni, begin deatkif beh yaakov. vechi hech yachil bar nash deihu gufa uvisra, leittakfa beh bemalacha deihu ruach mammash, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot meshartav esh lohet.

Ella, mikkan demalache sheliche dekudesha berich hu, kad inun nachatin lehay alma gelimin, veitgelimu umitlabbeshin (101 amud alef) begufa kegavvna dehay alma, begin dehachi itchaze, dela lehashenaa mimminhaga dehahu atar deazil tamman.

Veha ittemar, demoshe kad salik leela, ma ketiv, (Shemot la) vayhi sham im Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo achal umayim lo shata, begin minhaga, dela lehashenaa mehahu atar deazil letamman, veinun malachin kad nachatu letatta ketiv, (Bereshit 18:8) vehu omed alehem tachat haetz vayyochelu. vechen hacha, hay malacha kad nachat letatta, la itavak immeh deyaakov, ella miggo dehava itlabbash begufa kegavvna dehay alma. veal da itavak yaakov bahadeh kol hahu lelya.

Ta chaze, begin deshaltanuta dehanne, lav ihu ella belelya vadday. uvegin kach, shaltanuta deesav lav ihu ella begaluta, deihu layla. veal da belelya ittakkaf immeh deyaakov, veitavak immeh. vechad ata tzafra, itchalash cheleh, vela yachil, ucheden ittakkaf yaakov, begin deyaakov, shaltanuteh bimama.

Uvegin kach, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 21:11) massa duma elay kore misseir shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel. deha cheden shuletanuteh dideh deesav, deihi seir ballayla ihu, uvegin kach itchalash kad ata tzafra, ucheden (Bereshit 32:27) vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar.
