Vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani. ki im berachtani, ki im tevarcheni mibbae leh, may ki im berachtani. im odet al inun birchan devarchani abba vela tehe mekatrega li beginayyhu, ma ketiv, (Bereshit lak) vayyomer lo yaakov yeamer od shimcha ki im yisrael vegomer, ammay yisrael, amar leh, baal karchin it lan leshammasha lach, deha ant itatterat bechelach leela bedarga illaa, yisrael yihye shemecha vadday.

Ki sarita im elohim, may im elohim, salleka datach dealeh hava amar. ella amar leh, sarita leitchabbera uleizdavvevga im elohim bechibbura, beziuuga deshimsha vesihara, veal da la ketiv al (sefer acher et) elohim, ella im elohim, bechibbura veziuuga chada.

Davar acher, vayyomer, kema deat amer, (Shemot 15:26) vayyomer im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha, uf hacha, (Bereshit 32:29) vayyomer lo yeamer od shimcha yaakov ki im yisrael, keden itattar yaakov bedargeh, lemeheve kelala deavahan. ma ketiv, (sham) vayvarech oto sham. may vayvarech oto sham, deode leh al kullehu birchan, devarcheh avoy.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Mishlei 16:7) birtzot Adonai darche ish gam oyvav yashlim itto. ta chaze, kamma it leh levar nash, leittakna sheviloy beh bekudesha berich hu, begin lemebad pikkude deorayyta. deha okkemuha, devadday (Shemot 106 amud bet, 162 amud bet) teren malachin shelichan it levar nash milleela leizdavvevga bahadeh, chad limina vechad lismala, veinun sahaden beh bevar nash bechol ma deihu avid, inun mishtakkeche tamman vekarinan lon yetzer tov veyetzer ra.

Ate bar nash leitdakkaa uleishtaddela befikkude deorayyta, hahu yetzer tov deizdavvavg beh, kevar ihu ittakkaf al hahu yetzer hara veishtalim bahadeh veithappich leh leavda. vechad bar nash azil leistaava, hahu yetzer hara ittakkaf veitgabbar al hahu yetzer tov, veha okimna. vadday kad hahu bar nash ate leitdakkaa, kamma tekifu ittakkaf bar nash, kad itgabbera hahu yetzer tov keden (Mishlei 16:7) oyvav yashlim itto, dehahu yetzer hara itkafya kammeh deyetzer tov. veal da amar shelomo, (Mishlei 12:9) tov nikle veeved lo, may veeved lo, da yetzer hara. ucheden kad azil bar nash befikkude orayyta, keden gam oyvav yashlim itto, da yetzer hara, vedata missitroy.

Ta chaze, begin deyaakov, avtach beh bekudesha berich hu, vechol archoy havu lishmeh, al da oyvav yashlim itto. veda (davar acher da) samael, chela vetukefa deesav deashlim immeh deyaakov, uvegin deashlim immeh deyaakov, veode leh al inun birchan, keden ashlim immeh esav, (nusach acher keden ode leh asu dichtiv yesh li rav achi yehe lecha asher lecha, deha ode leh al inun birchan dileh becharba) vead dela ishtelim immeh yaakov legabbe hahu memanna deitpakkad aleh, la ashlim immeh esav, begin kach, bechol atar tukefa diltatta talya betukefa dilela.

Vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod vayyomer mi efo. mi efo, may mi efo, mi hu ze mibbae leh. ella mi efo, dekayyma shechinta tamman, kad berich leh yitzchak leyaakov, veal da amar, mi efo. man hu dekaim hacha, veode al inun birchan devarchit leh, vadday (Bereshit 27:33) gam baruch yihye. deha kudesha berich hu istakkam beinun birchan.

Ribbi yehuda amar, begin hahi charada deacharid yaakov leyitzchak avoy, itanash yaakov beonasha deyosef, decharad charada kehay, beshata deamru leh, (Bereshit 37:32) zot matzanu. yitzchak amar mi efo. beefo itanash yaakov, dichtiv, (Bereshit 37:32) efo hem roim, vetamman yosef itavid veitanish yaakov. veaf al gav dekudesha berich hu istakkam al yedoy beinun birchan, ihu itanash beefo, dichtiv efo hem roim. umittamman itavid minneh veitanash kol hahu onasha.

(Bereshit 27:33) vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola, may gedola, ketiv hacha gedola, uchetiv hatam (Devarim 18:16) veet haesh haggedola hazzot vegomer, deal immeh gehinnom. ad meod. may ad meod. ketiv hacha meod, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 1:31) vehinne tov meod, da malach hammavt, keden amar mi efo.

(Bereshit 27:34) kishmoa esav et divre aviv vegomer. amar ribbi chiyyay, kamma bishin avdu inun dimin devacha veappik esav kamme avoy, begin deyitbarech minneh, begin dehava chashiv milla deavoy yattir. hachi kara shemo yaakov. (davar acher 33 veukemuha) hachi kara shemo, kara shemo hahu dekara leh, appik tzitza deroka begin kelana. hachi nikra shemo la ketiv, ella kara shemo.

(Bereshit 27:36) vayyaakveni ze paamayim. ze. mahu ze, (ella) vayyaakveni paamayim mibbae leh. ella, milla chad have tere zimne, bechorati, (160 amud alef, Shemot 111 amud alef) ahadar leh zimna ochora birchati, ze hu tere zimnin. kegavvna da, (bareasheytemag) ki atta shavnu ze paamayim, milla chad, teren zimnin. chad deha ahadarna leh vela neheve bechissufa kammeh dehahu bar nash. shavnu, boshnu. anan bechissufa minneh, uchevar ahadarna.

Kegavvna da, amar iyyov, (iyyov 13:24) vetachsheveni leoyev lach, ahadar iyyov, oyev. veukemuha dichtiv, (iyyov 9) asher bisara yeshufeni vegomer. amar lefanav, ribbono shel olam, shemma ruach seara avra lefanecha. vehacha bechorati lakach vehinne atta ahadar milla venatil birchati.

(Bereshit 27:37) hen gevir samtiv lach vegomer, ulecha efo ma eese beni. ulecha efo, let keyayma hacha man demistakkam alach. ma eese beni. keden, barcheh behay alma veistakkal bedargeh, veamar (Bereshit 27:40) veal charbecha tichye, deha hachi itchaze lach leoshada damin ulemebad keravin, veal da amar ma eese beni.

Ribbi elazar amar, ulecha efo ma eese, kevan deamar hay, ammay beni. ella amar leh, ulecha efo ma eese, deant bedina uvecharba uvedama chazina lach, uleachicha beorach shelim. ella beni, beni vadday, ana garimna lach, begin deant beni. veal da al charbecha tichye veet achicha taavod. veadayin la itkayyaym, deha la falach leh esav leyaakov. begin deyaakov la vaa leh hasheta, veihu ahadar vekara leh adoni kamma zimne, begin deistakkal lemerachok, vesalik leh lesof yomaya, kidkaamaran.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havu azle vearcha. ad dehavu azle, chamu leh leribbi yose sava dehava azil batrayyhu. yatvu ad demata legabbayyhu. kevan demata legabbayyhu, amru hasheta archa mittakna kamman, azlu. amar ribbi chiyyay (Tehillim 119:126) et laasot laAdonai. patach ribbi yose veamar, (Mishlei 31:26) piha patcha vechachma vetorat chesed al leshonah. piha patcha vechachma, da keneset yisrael, vetorat chesed al leshonah illen inun yisrael, deinun lishna deorayyta demishtae vah yome velele.

(Mishlei 31:26) piha patcha vechachma da 2 divreshit, veukemuha. vetorat chesed al leshonah da avraham, deveh bara alma, uveh mishtae tadir. 2 satim mehay gisa, ufeticha mehay gisa. setima mehay gisa, kema deat amer, (Shemot 33:23) veraita et achoray. peticha mehay gisa, begin leanhara (nusach acher lahedarea) anpaha legabbe ela, ufeticha mehay gisa, begin lekabbela milleela, veihi akkesaddera lekabbela. uvegin kach kayyma beresha deorayyta veitmalyay levatar, piha patcha vechachma, bechachma vadday, dichtiv bereshit bara elohim, ketargumo. vetorat chesed al leshonah, deha levatar mishtae veamar (Bereshit 1:3) vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or. piha patcha vechachma, da Adonai (kadmaa) dishma kaddisha decholla bah, veihi satim vegalleya, kelila deela vetatta, raza deela vetatta.

(Mishlei 31:26) piha patcha vechachma, begin deihi setima dela ityeyda kelal, dichtiv, (iyyov 28:21) veneelma meene chol chay umeof hashshamayim nistara. vechad share leitpashsheta bechachma deitdabbak bah, veihi begavvav, (veihi) afikat kala, deihi torat chesed.

Piha patcha vechachma, da hei batraa deihu (deihi) dibbur, umilla talya bechachma. vetorat chesed al leshona. da kol dekayyma al dibbur leanhaga leh. vetorat chesed, da yaakov, deihu al leshonah, leanhaga milla uleachada lah, deha let dibbur bela kol, veukemuha.

Patach ribbi chiyyay avatreh veamar, (Mishlei 8:12) ani chachma shachanti arma vedaat mezimmot emtza. ani chachma, da keneset yisrael. shachanti arma, da yaakov deihu chakkim, vedaat mezimmot emtza da yitzchak, dehava leh daat mezimmot levarcha leh leesav. uvegin dechachma ishtattef bahadeh deyaakov deihu arma, vedaat mezimmot emtza, deitbarach yaakov meavoy, vesharu aleh kol inun birchan, veitkayymu beh uvivnoy lealam ulealme almin.

Meinun itkayymu behay alma, vechullehu yitkayymun lezimna demalka meshicha, dichden yehon yisrael goy echad baaretz veam echad lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (yechezkel 37:22) veasiti otam legoy echad baaretz. veyishletun leela vetatta, dichtiv, (Daniel 7:13) vaaru im anane shemaya kevar enash ate, da malka meshicha, dichtiv, (Daniel 12) uveyomehon di malchayya innun yekim elah shemaya malchu vegomer. veal da baa yaakov, deyistallekun birchoy lehahu zimna deate, vela natal lon lealtar.

Patach ribbi yesa avatreh veamar, veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai veal techat yisrael vegomer. hay kera ukemuha. aval behahi shata denafak yaakov mikkamme avoy, beinun birchan, istakkal benafsheh. amar, ha illen birchan, baena lesalka lon levatar learichu yomin, vehava dachil umistafe, nafak kala veamar, (Yirmeyahu 46:28) veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai ki ittecha ani, la eshbok lach behay alma. (Yirmeyahu 46:28) ki hinni moshiacha merachok, lehahu zimna deant salik lon leinun birchan.

(Yirmeyahu 46:27) veet zaracha meeretz shivyam, deaf al gav dehashta natil birchoy esav veyishtabedun bivnach, ana appik lon midoy, ucheden yeshabedun banecha beh. veshav yaakov, leinun birchan, veshav yaakov, da shechinta (nusach acher dehi immeh deyaakov). veshav yaakov vadday. veshakat veshaanan, kema deukemuha. meinun malkevavn, mibbavel mimmaday umiyyavan, umeedom. deinhu havu deishtabedu behu beyisrael. (sham) veen macharid, lealam ulealme almaya.

Azlu, ad dehavu azle, amar ribbi yose, vadday kol ma deavid kudesha berich hu beara, kolla hava beraza dechachmeta, vecholla begin leachazaa chachmeta illaa lehu livne nasha, begin deyilfun mehahu ovada razin dechachmeta, vecholla inun kedka yeut, veovadoy kullehu orche deorayyta, begin deorche deorayyta, inun arche dekudesha berich hu, velet milla zeera delet bah kamma orchin ushevilin, verazin dechachmeta illaa.

Ta chaze, deha ribbi yochanan ben zakkay hava amar telat mea halachot pesukot, beraza dechachmeta illaa, bappasuk (Bereshit 36:39) veshem ishto mehetavel bat matred bat me zahav, vela gale lon, ella leribbi liezer dehava immeh, begin leminda dechamma razin illain inun bechol ovada veovada deihi beorayyta, uvechol milla umilla chachmeta ihi, veorayyta dikshot, begin kach inun millin deorayyta, millin kaddishin inun, leachazaa minah niflaot, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 119:18) gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha.

Ta chaze, beshata deakim hahu chivya leadam uleitteteh, deakriv leitteta veattil bah zuhama, veitpatta beh adam keden istaav alma veitlatya ara begineh, vegarim mota lechol alma, vekayyma alma leitpara minneh. ad deata ilana dechayye, vechafe (vechipper) al adam, vechafyay leh lehahu nachash dela yishlot lealmin al zara deyaakov.

Deha bezimna deakrivu yisrael sair, hava itkafya hahu nachash veithappach leavda, (144 amud bet) kema deittemar. veal da akriv yaakov leavoy teren seirin. chad, leakkefya leesav deihu sair. vechad, begin darga dehava tale beh esav veitdabbak beh (142 amud bet) veittemar.
Uvegin kach kayyma alma, ad detete itteta kegavvna dechavva, uvar nash kegavvna deadam, veyaakimu veyachkimu leh lehahu chivya bisha vehahu derachiv aleh vecholla ittemar.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 25:27) vayhi eshav ish yodea tzayid ish sade, veha ittemar veyaakov ish tam yshev ohalim. ish tam, gevar shelim, ketargumo. yshev ohalim, ammay ihu tam, begin deihu yshev ohalim, deachid (139 amud bet) litren sitrin, leavraham uleyitzchak. veal da, yaakov besitra deyitzchak ata legabbe deesav, kema deittemar. dichtiv, (Shmuel b ko) im chasid titchassad veim ikkesh tittappal. vechad ata im birchan, besiyyua dilela ka ata, besiyyua deavraham veyitzchak, uvegin kach bechachmeta hava, kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, kad yaakov itar legabbe samael, darga deesav, vekabbil aleh leyaakov, veyaakov natzach leh bechamma sitrin, natzach lechivya bechachmeta uvaakimu, vela itnatzach, bar besair. veaf al gav decholla chad, natzach kemo chen lesomol benitzchona ochora, venatzcheh, hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit lak) vayavek ish immo ad alot hashshachar. vayyar ki lo yachol lo.

Ta chaze, zechuteh deyaakov kamma hava, deihu ata uvaa leaavara leh mealma. vehahu lelya, havat lelya deitbere beh sihara, veyaakov ishtaar bilchodoy. dela hava immeh ochora, ditnan la yippuk bar nash yechiday belelya, vekol shekken (169 amud bet) belelya deitberiu beh nehorin, deha sihara ihi chasra, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot chaser. vehahu lelya, ishtaar bilchodoy, begin dechad sihara (114 amud bet) chasra, chivya visha ittakkaf veshalta, ucheden ata samael, vekatrig leh, uvaa leovada leh mealma.

Veyaakov hava takkif bechol sitrin, besitra deyitzchak uvesitra deavraham, deinun havu takkifu deyaakov. ata limina chama leavraham takkif vitkifu deyoma, besitra dimina dechesed. ata lismala, chama leyitzchak takkif bedina kashya. ata leguppa, chama leyaakov, takkif mitteren sitrin illen desacharan leh, chad mikkan, vechad mikkan. keden, (Bereshit 32:26) vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf yerecho, deihu atar levar miggufa, veihu chad ammuda degufa, keden vatteka kaf yerech yaakov beheavko immo vegomer.

Kevan deitar tzafra veavar lelya, ittakkaf yaakov, veitchallash cheleh disomol, keden amar shalcheni, demata zimna lomar shirata detzafra. uvae lemezal, veode leh al inun birchan, veosif leh birchata ochora, dichtiv (Bereshit 32:30) vayvarech oto sham.

Ta chaze, kamma birchan itbarech yaakov, chad deavoy, behahu akimu, veravavch kol inun birchan. vechad dishchinta devarich leh kudesha berich hu, kad hava ate millavan, dichtiv, (Bereshit la) vayvarech elohim et yaakov. vechad, devarcheh leh hahu malacha memanna deesav. vechad, beracha ochora, devarcheh leh avuha, kad hava azil lefaddan aram, dichtiv (Bereshit 28:3) veel shadday yevarech otcha vegomer.

Behahu zimna dechama yaakov garmeh bechol hanne birchan, amar, beman birchata deminnayyhu eshtammesh hasheta. amar, bachalasha minnayyhu eshtammesh hasheta, uman ihu, da batrayyta, devarcheh avuha, veaf al gav deihi takkifa, amar, lav ihi takkifa beshaltanuta dehay alma kekadmaa.

Amar yaakov, ettol hasheta da veeshtamash bah, (166 amud bet, 172 amud bet) vaasallek kol inun ochoranin lezimna deitzterich li velivnay batray. ematay, bezimna deyitkanneshun kol ammemaya leovada banay mealma, dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:10-11) kol goyim sevavuni beshem Adonai ki amilam. sabbuni gam sevavuni vegomer. sabbuni chidvorim vegomer. ha hacha telata, legabbe telata deishtaaru. chad, inun birchan kadmay deavuha. teren, inun birchan devarcheh kudesha berich hu. telat, inun birchan devarcheh hahu malacha.

Amar yaakov, lehatam itzterichu, legabbe melachin vechol ammin dechol alma, veasllik lon lehatam. vehasheta legabbe deesav, day li vehay. lemalka, dehavu leh kamma ligyonin takkifin, kamma mare maggiche kerava laagacha keravin, dizminin legabbe melachin takkifin leagacha behu kerava. adhachi shama al listim chad kappacha, amar, hanne bene tare yehachun tamman. amar leh, mikkol ligyonin dilach, let ant meshadder hatam ella illen. amar, legabbe hahu listim, day beillen. deha kol ligyonotay umare kerava, estallak legabbe inun melachin takkifin, beyoma dikrava, deitzterichu li, lehvu.
Uf hachi yaakov amar legabbe esav, day li hasheta beillen birchan. aval lehahu zimna, deitzterichu levanay legabbe kol malchin veshallitin dechol alma, asallek lon.

Kad yimte hahu zimna, yitarun inun birchan mikkol sitrin, veyitkayyaym alma al kiyyumeh kedka yeut, umehahu yoma ulehala, yekum malchuta da al kol shear malchu ochora, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Daniel 2:44) taddik vetasef kol illen malchevata vehi tekum lealmayya. vehayeynu hahi avna, deitgezarat min tura di la vidayin, kema deat amer (Bereshit 49:24) mishsham roe even yisrael, man even da. da keneset yisrael, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 28:22) vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva vegomer.

Rabbi chiyyay amar, mehacha (Yeshayahu 10:21) shear yashuv shear yaakov, illen birchan ochoranin deishtaaru, uchetiv, (Micha Adonai:7) vehaya sheerit yaakov baggoyim bekerev ammim rabbim (illen birchan acharanin ketiv, (Micha Adonai:7) vehaya sheerit yaakov) baggoyim kullehu, velo veesav bilchodeh, uchetiv vehaya sheerit vegomer, kattal meet Adonai.

Patach rabbi yesa veamar (Malachi 1:6) ben yechabbed av veeved adonav, ben, da esav. dela hava bar nash bealma deyokir leavoy, kema deokir esav leavoy. vehahu yakkiru deokir leh ashlit leh behay alma.

(Sham) veeved adonav, da eliezer eved avraham (87 amud alef) veukemuha, deha bar nash dehava ate lecharan, bechamma utera, vechamma mattenan unevazbezin, ugemallin teinan. dela amar livtuel velavan, deihu rechimoy deavraham, o bar nash ochora deate befiyyusa deavraham, ella ad la yemallel milloy, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 24:34) vayyomer eved avraham anochi, ulevatar adoni adoni, begin deyokir leh leavraham hahu yekara vehahu tivu, orich leh lechamma zimnin.

Kacha esav, hahu yekara deokir leh leavoy, orich leh kol hanne zimnin deyishlot bealma da. veinun dimin, oridu lon leyisrael beshibuda dileh, ad dituvun yisrael lekudesha berich hu, bivchiya uvedimin. dichtiv bivchi yavou vegomer, ucheden ketiv, vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav vehayta laAdonai hammelucha. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen.

rashi: Mi gam bachem veyisgor delatayim. halevay veyakum ish tov bachem sheyyisgor dalte mikdashi levilti havi sham karban metoeva hazzot.

Velo tairu mizbechi chinnam. baishim sheeni mitratztze bahem, shehare en li chefetz bachem. verabbotenu darshu betorat kohanim: adam omer lachavero: "hagef li et haddelet hazzo" – en tovea aleha sachar; "hadelek li et hanner hazze" – en shoel aleha sachar. veattem – mi bachem shessagar delatay chinnam? velo heartem mizbechi chinnam. kal vachomer shello asitem chinnam devarim sheddarkan laasotan besachar. lefichach en li chefetz bachem.
targum: Man af hacha bechon viguf dashe vet makdeshi vela tikrevun al madbechi karban merachak la raava kodamay bechon amar Adonai tzevaot vekureban leraava la akabbel miyedchon:

rashi: Yikrevu yeme evel avi. kemishmao, shello atzaer et abba, umidreshe aggada lechamma fanim yesh:
ohc: Yikrevu yeme evel vegomer. perush, achar sheyyamut veyikkaver, sheaz hu hatechalat shivat yeme avelut, vechash shello yahargennu beod shello nikbar aviv, ki hammet yodea kodem sheyyissatem haggolel (shabbat 152:).

rashi: Shiva. al shem habberit:
Esek. irur:
Ki hitasseku immo. nitasseku immo aleha bimriva veirur:
Yafutzu mayenotecha chutza. sof shettikne talmidim, vetore horaot barabbim, veyetze lecha shem:
Barchovot. ir tefutzena palge memecha:
targum: Nishpeun mayanach levara uviftaye teyafe demaya:

ohc: Veatta veni. perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (avot 2:10): veshuv yom echad lifne mitatcha, uferush ki en adam batuach bechayyav afilu yom echad, uvaze yihye tamid bitshuva. laze amra veatta vegomer kum berach vegomer, perush veatta techef umiyyad, vahagam shello amar esav ella "yikrevu" vegomer, efshar sheyyamut yitzchak beotah shaa veyotzi machshavto lappoal:
Berach lecha el lavan. ki hu yaamod neged esav im yelech lehargecha:

rashi: Lifne Adonai. birshuto, sheyyaskim al yadi:
Bemirma. bechachma:

ohc: Vayyar esav ki raot vegomer. yaggid hakkatuv ki lo chash esav ella letzad hakepadat aviv alehem, aval zulat ze lema shehem bechinat hara lo chash sheen nafsho metaevtan. umimmotza davar gam ken atta yodea shello hoil taam heyotam raot beene yitzchak ella leval yosif mehem, aval legaresh otan shehayu kevar etzlo lo. veulay shekkol haregashato lo hayta ella shemma yitpakkeu birchotav letzad banim asher yihyu lo mibbenot kenaan, laze lakach mibbenot yishmael kede sheyyitkayyemu habberachot beemtzaut habbanim sheyyihyu lo mehem.
Chassalat parashat toldot

rashi: Sitna. 465:
Midyanim yeshalleach. ben adam levoro:
targum: Umithappech velibbeh vechashal bishta bechol zeman tigre rame:

rashi: Vayyuggad lerivka. beruach hakkodesh huggad lah ma sheesav mehareher belibbo:

Mitnachem lecha. nicham al haachva lachashov machashava acheret lehitnakker lecha ulehargecha. umidrash aggada kevar atta met beenav veshata alecha kos shel tanchumim. ulefi peshuto leshon tanchumim, mitnachem hu al habberachot baharigatcha:
ohc: Esav benah haggadol. amro "haggadol", lomar ki hu yachol asot asher zamam laasot leachiv, "benah hakkatan" perush letzad heyoto katan mimmennu bayyecholet.
Mitnachem lecha. perush mekabbel nechama al asher asita lo, lehargecha, uvaze tachzor lo habbechora vehabberacha.

rashi: Hinne anochi holech lamut. (mitnodedet veholechet hi habbechora shello tehe chol et haavoda babbechorot, ki shevet levi yittol otah, veod) amar esav: ma tivah shel avoda zo? amar lo: kamma azharot voonashin umitot teluyin bah keotah sheshshaninu, ellu hen shebbemita: shetuye yayin uferue rosh; amar: ani holech lamut al yadah, im ken ma chefetz li vah?

Vattichhena. baashanan shel ellu. davar acher keshenneekad agga hammizbeach vehaya aviv rotze leshochoto, beotah shaa niftechu hashshamayim verau malache hashsharet vehayu vochim, veyardu dimotehem venaflu al enav, lefichach kahu enav. davar acher kede sheyyittol yaakov et habberachot:
ohc: Vayhi ki zaken yitzchak. taam hodaa zo, ki zo sibba sheyyittol yaakov et habberachot keshello yakkirehu. veamar leshon tzaar, shehutzrach littol yaakov habberachot al yede sibba zo velo bidiat yitzchak, ki mizze subbevu kamma sibbot livne ammenu.
Et esav. velo amar "el esav", ki lo haya roehu lomar shekkeraahu, ella kara et shemo.

Beno haggadol. netinat taam lamma lo kara leyaakov, ki ze habbechor, veulay shello yada mehammecher. vetaam yitzchak shehaya chafetz levarech esav harasha, ki chashav shebbeemtzaut habberachot yithappech lemiddat hattov veyetiv derachav, ki hatztzaddikim yichavu baasot benehem resha, vehaya mishtaddel immo lehetiv, veefshar shehaya moil. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 80:1) ki neenash yaakov shemmana dina meesav, sheefshar shehayta machziratto lammutav, hare sheefshar lo lachzor lammutav.

rashi: Vayyashov vayyachpor. habbeerot asher chafru bime avraham aviv ufelishtim sittemum, mikkodem shennasa yitzchak miggerar, chazar vachafaran:
Kimat hayiti vechol ra. kefesa beni uven gehinnom, (kelomar: bishvil davar muat hayiti achshav bechol ra, shello shamati lekol moray; sheillu shamati lahem, lo yeera bi kach rabbi yosef kera):
targum: Al kelil havet li bechol bishin bego kenishta veedta:

rashi: Em yaakov veesav. eni yodea ma melammedenu:
ohc: Vayyishlach yitzchak vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar achi rivka, mi lo yada baze, uma gam shebbesamuch amar ken. veod amro em yaakov veesav hem devarim yeterim?

Achen ba hakkatuv latet taam leyitzchak avinu sheshshalach ben tzaddik leadam rasha mefursam lavan haarammi. vahagam sheavraham shalach velakach rivka, lo haya betuel mefursam beresha kelavan. veod shello amar beferush avraham sheyyikkach bat betuel, ma sheen ken yitzchak shetztzivva leyaakov sheyyikkach ishsha mibbenot lavan harasha, laze amar achi rivka ushenehem yatzu mibbetuel harasha, uchemo chen yetze millavan bat tzaddeket. gam en lehochiach shello yetze shalshelet shoresh kedushsha meadam rasha, laze amar em yaakov veesav perush hare sheyyatzta shalshelet hakkedushsha meav rasha, gam ken en lehachelit velomar ki leheyot lavan rasha lo yetze mimmennu banot kerivka.

Veyesh lecha ladaat ki davka bayyamim hahem sheadayin lo nitbarru hanneshamot hakkedoshot mimmekom shivyam, vehukkera mishpachat avraham ki sham kanta lah hakkedushsha makom, vehaya lah leot olam avraham vesara ki hem gerim rishonim, vechol asher yitgayyer mehaummot bechol zeman yikkare avraham unekeva sara. laze min hakkedushsha yechappes achar mino, ki echad haya avraham velo hushlam binyan hakkedushsha bizcharim uvinkevot ki lo holid ella et yitzchak velo holid nekevot immo. veulay ki laze amar hakkatuv (Bereshit 25:19) "avraham holid et yitzchak" perush levaddo belo bat zug, uchemo chen yitzchak lo haya lo banot ki nitzotzot hakkedushsha hannekevot odam beeretz shevi, laze shelacho yitzchak lechazzer achar avedato.

Ach ze hayyom shekkivvinuhu, ki parchu shoresh hakkedushsha hen bene yisrael, ufarach matte oz tifara, vehukkar ilan hachayyim chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato, hen hemma hammuvhakim bakkodesh, velo yissov adam mimmattot bene yisrael lemishpechot haaretz, veim nishar minnitzotze hakkedushsha betoch haammim, hare hem bitziatam laolam mitassefim uvaim, veachar gerutam yeamnu ki avudim hayu velanu hem.

Vetaam hakkenaani asher hikpid avraham levilti kachat lo ishsha mehem, gam yitzchak tzivva leyaakov al ze, rabbotenu amru (Bereshit Rabba perek 59) ki hu arur vezera avraham baruch vechulei, vedivrehem setumim hem. ulefi ma shekkatavti matzinu ikkar hattaam nachon, ki tamo shel avraham hu ki hu meshullal minnefashot hakkedoshot vechol benotav chelek ra umetoav, laze hechlitu levilti kachat mimmennu ki lo yimmatze bo davar kadosh, vehu sod amro (Bereshit 9:25) "arur kenaan" perush: meshullal behechlet mimmin hakkedushsha:

Vetimtza ki mimmin haummot ad hayyom odam mitkabbetzim uvaim gerim vechosim betzel hakkodesh, asher lo shamanu mime kedem ki nitgayyer ger kenaani kishar haammim, veze yaggid devarenu. veulay ki laze yetzav hael (Devarim 20:16) "lo techayye kol neshama" mishshiva amamim, vedikdek lomar "kol neshama" latet taam lemitzvat "lo techayye", ki en bahem neshama, perush: nefesh kedosha sheyyityaches eleha shem neshama lachus aleha lehachayotah keammon umoav, vehaven:

Veachare hodia elohim otanu et kol zot, tzarich latet lev maddua anu baavonot meshubadim lichnaan (Shoftim 4:2), achar sheyyadanu neemana shehashshibud hu levarer hannitzotzot shel hakkedushsha shebbetoch hakkelippa, uvakkenaanim en bahem nitzotz kadosh laredet acharav baggalut. vetimtza ki mitzrayim asher nitrokna mehannitzotzot, keamram zichronam livracha (fesachim 118:): lo yatzu yisrael ad sheasauha kimtzuda sheen bah dagan vechimtzula sheen bah dagim, dichtiv "vaynatztzelu et mitzrayim" (Shemot 12:36), tzivva Adonai leval yavou shamma, vechammevoar hattaam bedivre haari zichrono livracha (sear haggilgulim). veim ken, ech yihye shennisbol et kol otzem haggalut hazze mibbeli heyot bo nitzotze hakkedushsha?

Achen yitbaer haddavar al derech amram zichronam livracha (Likkutei tora mikketz) ki yesh shene mine nitzotze hakkedushsha shevuyim bakkelippa: haachat neshamot yekarot veyotzot beemtzaut halleda, keavraham uchesara ucherivka verachel, uchenishmat rabbi chanina ben teradyon sheyyatza mishshechem im dina, ucherut mimmoav uchenaama meammon ucheuneklos hagger vechaddome. vehashsheni hu min nitzotz shel kedushsha haddavuk bakkelippa veeno yotze kelal ella meore bakkelippa, veen lo metziut lippared mimmennu ella kaasher yatzer leyisrael al yede tzaar o al yede hakkaa, shebbeemtzaut davar ze tihye nifredet hakkedushsha vechozeret lesharshah. umeatta yesh taam legalut ze, ki teavve levarer bechinat nitzotze hakkedushsha sheenah nifredet ella al yede tzaar shemmitztaarim yisrael. veal galut hazze amar hakkatuv (Ovadya 1:20) "vegalut hachel hazze livne yisrael asher kenaanim ad tzarfat", shehakkatuv kerao hachel milleshon "nihyeti venachaleti" (Daniel 8:27), ki hassagat tachlit haggalut benehem hu beemtzaut hatztzaar, velaze hu meshunne mikkol haggaluyyot kaasher rainu beenenu. veamar "asher kenaanim" velo amar "bakkenaanim", vegam amar "kenaanim" leshon rabbim, ulay kivven al hannitzotzot shel hakkedushsha shelleheyotam atta betoch kelippat kenaan yikkaru bishmo kenaanim. veshiur hakkatuv al ze hadderech: galut hachel hazze, shehu galut yisrael, hu lesibbat bene yisrael shehem atta nikraim kenaanim al makom shehem bo.

rashi: Asher en lah katzin. sheyyochiach otah vizarzenna veyotzi miyyadah im tigzol davar mechavertah, veaf al pi chen:
targum: Delet lah chatzda hech af la sarcha veshalita:

rashi: Morat ruach. leshon hameraot ruach, kemo mamrim heyitem, kol maasehen hayu lehacheis uleitztzavon:
Leyitzchak ulerivka. shehayu ovdot aza (Bereshit Rabba):

ohc: Veatta vegomer. perush: beotah shaa yemaher lehavi min hammuchan gedaye izzim.

Shema bekoli. perush: hagam sheyyesh bidvarim ellu kignevat haddaat, im kol ze yesh lecha lishmoa bekoli. perush: millevad chiyyuv mitzvat kibbud av vaem shehi mitzvat ase, gam hi nevia, uchetiv bedivre nevi emet (Devarim 18:15) "elav tishmaun". laze amra shema bekoli, uchevar katavnu (Bereshit 16:5) sheyyitztaddek navi beamro laavor al mitzva mimmitzvot hattora lefi shaa:

rashi: Veal charbecha. kemo becharbecha, yesh al bimkom b, kemo amadtem al charbechem – becharbechem; al tzivotam – betzivotam:
Tarid. leshon tzaar kemo arid besichi, kelomar, kesheyyaavru yisrael al hattora veyihye lecha pitchon pe lehitztaer al habberachot shennatal, ufarakta ullo vegomer:
ohc: Veet achicha vegomer vehaya kaasher vegomer. rabbu happerushim baze. veefshar lomar shennitkavven lomar al ze hadderech shekkol habberachot shebbercho yihye kaasher yaavod et achiv. vechaasher yered mimmadrega zo, o yirtze leshon ridduy kaasher tihye raduy veavud, yakdim lifrok ullo, veachar kach tered veyihye bet yaakov esh vegomer uvet esav lekash (Ovadya 1:18) veyichle. velaze dikdek lomar vehaya leshon simcha, ki az yismechu hashshamayim vetagel haaretz:
O yirtze, vehaya kaasher tishlot atta baolam, lo tihye maalatcha alav, ella "ufarakta ullo meal" vegomer – lo hu yishlot becha velo atta timshol bo. uma shemmashal achar kach, avonot hittu elle.

rashi: Anochi esav bechorecha. anochi hammevi lecha veesav hu bechorecha:
Asiti. chamma devarim kaasher dibbarta elay:
Sheva. leshon mesev al hashshulchan, lechach meturgam istachar:
ohc: Anochi esav bechorecha. perush, leheyot shekkana habbechora meesav hinne hu naasa esav letzad bechinat habbechora, ki lah yikkare esav bechoro. veamro asiti kaasher dibbarta elay, perush, ki taam shetztzivva leesav hu ki hu beno habbechor, vechevan shennatal habbechora keillu haddavar ba elav.

rashi: Ki tomar edom rushshashnu. veim yomru macharive hammikdash: mittechillatenu rashim hayinu, aval meatta sheheesharnu mibbizzat yerushalayim nashuv venivne choravot shellanu – ko amar Adonai vegomer.
targum: Are yemrun edomae itmaskanana kean atarna netuv venivne chorvata kidnan amar Adonai tzevaot inun yivnun vaana afagar veyikron lehon techuma deama rashia veama deayte alehon levat ad alma:

rashi: Massa devar Adonai. 581 belaaz, davar hannimsar lemalachi laset oto el bene yisrael.

Beyad malachi. kevar haya masur beyado ze yamim rabbim. mikkan darshu rabbotenu bivrayta dimchilta, shekkol hanneviim amdu al har sinay, vesham nimseru lahem hannevuot. vechen (Yeshayahu 48:16) omer: "meet heyotah sham ani, veatta Adonai elohim shelachani".
targum: Matal pitgama dayya al yisrael beyad malache deyitkere shemeh ezra safra:

ohc: Velo hikkiro ki hayu vegomer. veaf al pi chen dacha shemiat kol millifne chush hahergesh, ki hakkol yachol lehishtannot, o letzad mashmia, o letzad shomea, ma sheen ken haregashat saarot hayyadayim hu siman muvhak.

Vayvarchehu. perush, letzad ki mikkodem shemmishshesho veyada ki esav hu, lo haya lo davar machchish lakkol habba leaznav sheeno esav, vahare ze metatea venichnas bachashashat yaakov sheamar "veheveti alay" vegomer, vahagam shello matzinu lo shekkillo, af al pi chen hechin libbo lesinato, vedavar ze batztzaddikim yafil, vetze ulemad middivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (bava metzia 84.) im hayu makpidim belibbam al hazzulat hayu meviim alav kelala, laze kesheraa yadav seirot vayvarchehu lehasir hahefech shehumeshach mikkodem

rashi: Mishmanne eretz vegomer. zo italia shel yavan:
ohc: Vayyaan yitzchak aviv. perush netinat taam lamma chazar levarcho, letzad rachame av keshebbacha nichmeru rachamav.
Hinne mishmanne. perush, en lo ella ma shellefanav, lo keyaakov sheamar "veyitten lecha" betosefet vav, perush, millevad olam hannitzchi, uchemo shepperashnu.

rashi: Ben arbaim shana. shehare keshebba avraham mehar hammoriyya nitbasser shennolda rivka, veyitzchak haya ben 37 shana, shehare bo bapperek meta sara, umishshennolad yitzchak ad haakeda shemmeta sara, 37 shana hayu – ki bat 90 hayta keshennolad yitzchak, uvat 127 keshemmeta – shenneemar vayyihyu chayye sara vegomer hare leyitzchak 37 shanim, uvo vapperek nolda rivka; himtin lah ad shettehe reuya levia 3 shanim unesaah:

Bat betuel mippaddan aram achot lavan. vechi adayin lo nichtav shehi bat betuel vaachot lavan umippaddan aram? ella lehaggid shivchah, shehayta bat rasha vaachot rasha umekomah anshe resha velo lamda mimmaasehem:

Mippaddan aram. al shem sheshshene aram hayu, aram naharayim vaaram tzova, kore oto paddan, leshon tzemed bakar, targum paddan torin; veyesh potrin paddan aram kemo sede aram, shebbilshon yishmael korin lesade faddan:
ohc: Vayhi yitzchak ben arbaim vegomer. taam shehutzrach lehodia zeman nissuav ma shello nahag ken beavraham, ba latet taam leikkuv hazzeman sheshshaha yitzchak belo nissuin ad avor arbaim shana, veamar hattaam bekachto et rivka bishvil kichat rivka shaha ad arbaim shana, uchemo sheggamar omer lo leishsha perush lo meyuchedet hi bat zugo. ha lamadta shekkodem lah lo hayta lo bat zug, uchemo shekkatavnu bapparasha hakkodemet, vehi ketanna hayta shennolda baakeda keshehuchshar leholid. umeatta en taromet al yitzchak sheshshaha ad arbaim shana, gam al avraham sheikkev ad arbaim shana, ki az hayta bat shalosh shanim kefi hacheshbon.

Bat betuel haarammi vegomer achot vegomer. taam shechazar hakkatuv lehodia ze – lo lehashemienu bat mi hi, ella lelammed sanegorya al rivka, lefi sheomer besamuch "vayyeater lo Adonai" – lo velo lah, vetavo hassevara lomar ki taam haddavar letzad pechitut rivka chas veshalom, ki lo reuya hi lishmoa eleha elohim. laze hikdim lomar bat betuel, lomar ki zo hi sibba lema shehetir Adonai leyitzchak, ki hu ben avraham vehi bat betuel. vechafal lomar haarammi mippaddan aram lehair ki nitkavven beamro "haarammi" lomar harammay, ki im nitkavven lechannoto leshem iro hare hu amur. vehakkavvana baze, letzad shello nitparsem rishuto baolam, ba lehodio ki rasha haya, uveemtzauto lo huchshera tefillat rivka kitfillat yitzchak.

Veamro achot lavan lelo tzorech, venosaf shekkevar yadanu, ella hattaam hu shebba lelammed zechut al rivka birotenu sheyyalda ben rasha muvhak, vetomar ech mibbeten baruch yatza arur, laze amar ki ze hu sibba laddavar heyotah achot lavan haarammi, perush harammay betosefet resha al aviv, uchevar kadmu chazal (bava batra 110.) rov habbanim, lattaam hayyadua, velaze yatza esav, vezulat ze tzeetzaeha tzaddikim hayu yotzim mimmenna, ki tzaddeket gemura hayta, vehaed "lenochach ishto", veamru zichrono livracha (Bereshit Rabba 143) vechulei. veshello tomar veim ken velamma lo natan lev yitzchak livdok beachiha, laze gamar omer lo leishsha uchemo shepperashti lemala, vezulat ze lo haya nose achot rasha.

Od remez behodaat achot lavan al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 60:13) shettaam rivka shehayta akara hu letzad birkat lavan, kede shello yerae ki birchato taase maase tov. laze kodem sheamar hakkatuv ki akara hi, kadam lomar taam haddavar veamar "achot lavan", vezo hayta sibba shenneekra rivka ad shehutzrechu litfilla.

rashi: Hinnatzel kitzvi miyyad. maher vehishshamet mishsham kitzvi hannimlat miyyad haadam:
targum: Ditteptze hech tavya min nishba vehech tzippera min pucha:

rashi: Vaavudda rabba. peulla rabba bilshon 107 avebareynea, avoda mashma avoda achat; avudda mashma peulla rabba:
Ki chillel yehuda. et atzmo, shehaya kodesh laAdonai, "reshit tevuato" (Yirmeyahu 2:3).
Uvaal bat el nechar. shennasu nashim nachriyyot bevavel, vaafillu hakkohanim, kemo shemmeforash besefer (Ezra 9). verabbotenu amru: malachi ze ezra.
targum: Shekaru devet yehuda vetoevta itavidat beyisrael uvirushelem are afisu devet yehuda nafshehon dahavat kadisha kodam Adonai dircham veitreiu lemisav lehon neshin benat palche kochvaya:

rashi: Benachal gerar. rachok min hair:
ohc: Vayyichan benachal gerar. ki lo ratza laakor et dirato meeretz pelishtim behechlet, letzad mitzvat hammelech malko shel olam hi lemor (Bereshit 26:3) "gur baaretz hazzot". vahagam shennomar shehammakom hahu lo haya bichlal ma sheamar lo Adonai "shechon baaretz", af al pi chen anus haya mehammelech adon haaretz. veulay ki asa Adonai kacha lenissayon, shehagam sheamar lo Adonai "lecha ulezaracha etten et kol haaratzot", af al pi chen lo netanuhu afillu lashevet sham keachad haam, im lo yeharher achar hashshechina, uchemo chen asa leavraham.
Al tira ki ittecha vegomer, perush: leheyot sheraa hashepala mimmelech pelishtim sheggersho meartzo velo yada an yifne, chash ki Adonai azavo. laze amar "al tira, lo azavticha, ittecha ani".

rashi: Achadim. muatim:
ohc: Ad asher tashuv vegomer. perush, baavor zeman al hammeora, hachema meatzmah mitkareret mertichatah, veamrah od ad shuv af achicha perush: ki lo yoil ze levad ella ad shuv af achicha mimmecha, perush, shehagam sheyyazkirucha lefanav lo yechere appo, vehu amro mimmecha az hu siman sheshshachach hammaase vechulei.
Veshalachti vegomer, perush, ani eshlach acharecha kesheyyihye chen, aval atta lo tavo beshum ofen.

rashi: Kol yaakov. shemmedabber bilshon tachanunim kum na, aval esav kintureya dibber yakum avi:

ohc: Vayyar esav ki verach vegomer. pasuk ze en lo gizra, veim gizrato hu "vayyelech esav el yishmael" haya maspik bappasuk sheachare ze "vayyar esav ki raot".

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi lehodia sheyyada esav halichat yaakov veafnah, ki halach bemitzvat aviv veimmo vegam lemitzvat kichat ishsha, vegam berchuhu beshallecham oto, ki letzad ze lo redafo sheyyada sheyyimmana miyyado, heyoto holech lishte mitzvot: kibbud av vaem ulekichat ishsha. vahagam sheshshalach elifaz keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit 29:11), efshar shebbachan ki hu notzeach badderech leyaakov, umaase avot asu banim asher kiddam badderech leyisrael, vechashav esav ki gadol koach elifaz mikkocho bivchinat redifa badderech leyaakov uvanav.

rashi: Sa na. leshon hashechaza, keotah sheshshaninu en mashchizin et hassakkin, aval massiah al gabbe chavertah (betza 28), chadded sakkincha ushechot yafe, shello taachileni nevela (Bereshit Rabba):
Telyecha. charbecha shedderech litlotah:
Vetzuda li. min hahefker velo min haggezel:
Yatzo yatzo. ze yotze veze va:
ohc: Vayhi kaasher killa. taam amro vayhi leshon tzaar, ki hattora mitztaeret al asher killa velo berach kol habberachot, shehare matzinu shebberach leesav achar ken, veim haya mevarech otam habberachot hannisharot leyaakov kevar avda tikvat edom.

Vayhi ach yatzo vegomer. taam amro vayhi leshon tzaar, gam amar ach, gam kafal lomar yatzo yatza. nitkavven lomar sheadayin haya meukkav bitziat yaakov, vehu amro ach yatzo miet bayyetzia ella lesibba sheera yatza, vehassibba hi ma shehodia hakkatuv levassof beamro "veesav achiv ba mitztzedo", ulesibba zo miher ligmor hayyetzia vehu amro yatza, veramaz el hatztzaar shechash yaakov sheyyimmatze kegannav bammachteret bifne aviv keshehirgish beviat esav. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba parasha 66) darshu beofen acher.

rashi: Haleiteni. eftach pi ushefoch harebe letochah, kemo sheshshaninu en ovsin et haggamal aval malitin oto:

Min haadom haadom. adashim adummot, veoto hayyom met avraham, shello yire et esav ben beno yotze letarbut raa, veen zo seva tova shehivticho hakkabba; lefichach kitztzer hakkabba Adonai shanim mishshenotav, sheyyitzchak chay 180 shana veze 175, uvishshel yaakov adashim lehaverot et haavel. velamma adashim? sheddomot legalgal, shehaavelut galgal hachozer baolam (veod ma adashim en lahem pe, kach haavel en lo fe, sheasur ledabber, ulefichach hamminhag lehaverot haavel bitchillat maachalo betzim, shehem agullim veen lahem pe, kach avel en lo fe, kidamrinan bemoed katan 0 avel kol shelosha yamim harishonim eno meshiv shalom lechol adam vechashe sheeno shoel battechilla, mig vead 7 meshiv veeno shoel vechulei; berashi yashan):
ohc: Al ken kara shemo vegomer. perush, hu esav kara shemo edom, vehattaam lo letzad shekkara "haadom haadom" shene peamim, ella letzad shehaya holech lamut uvo hecheya nafsho, kara shemo edom bishmo, veesav badek bishma haya, keamro (Bereshit 27:36) "hachi kara shemo" vegomer:

rashi: Katzti vechayyay. maasti vechayyay:
ohc: Katzti vechayyay vegomer. lo ratzta legallot haddavar leyitzchak mishshum issur rechilut veamra sibba acheret, aval ma sheggilleta leyaakov, adrabba, kiyyema mitzvat (Vayikra 19:16) "lo taamod al dam reecha".

rashi: Lech el nemala atzel vegomer. vachacham – vehitchakkem:
targum: Itreme leshumeshmana atle chame archathon veitchakkam:

rashi: Michra chayyom. ketargumo keyom dilhen, kayyom shehu varur, chach mechor li mechira verura:
Bechoratcha. lefi shehaavoda babbechorot, amar yaakov en rasha ze cheday sheyyakriv lehakkabba:
ohc: Vayyomer yaakov michra chayyom vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro chayyom sheen lah mashmaut. venire ki leheyot ki bechora zo shekkone mimmennu yesh bah peratim sheenam bammetziut ella bemot aviv, vehem devarim shello bau laolam, uchefi toratenu hakkedosha en adam makne davar shello ba laolam, laze nitchakkem lomar "chayyom" kede shettitkayyem hammechira. vehu al pi ma sheamru bemassechet metzia daf 16 ufesakuhu happoskim (choshen mishpat siman 211 saif 2): hatztzayyad ani sheen lo ma yochal sheamar "ma sheyyaale bimtzudati hayyom machur lecha" – mimkaro kayyam, vehattaam mishshum kede chayyav. vechatvu haggeonim sheen hattaam taluy beomer "hayyom" ella hu haddin yom acher mimkaro kayyam, mittaam kede chayyav, velo amru "hayyom" ella lishlol ma sheyyaale bimtzudato sheloshim yom o shana shehu yoter mikkede michyat yom echad, aval michyat yom echad bechol metziut sheyyihye kayyam. vehu amro michra chayyom, perush kedin yom, shehare ayef haya umishshum kede chayyav mimkaro mimkar hagam shehu davar shello ba laolam. vezulat metziut ze en din sheyyachol lizkot bemecher habbechora. vehitzdik esav divre yaakov keamro hinne hu holech lamut veen lecha takkanat mishshum kede chayyav gedola mizzo.

rashi: Vayyetar. hirba vehiftzir bitfilla:

Vayyetar lo. nitpatztzer venitpayyes venitpatta lo. veomer ani, kol leshon eter leshon hafetzara veribbuy hiv, vechen vaatar anan hakketoret (25 8) – marbit aliyyat heashan, vechen vehaetartem alay divrechem (sham 35), vechen venatarot neshikot sone (Mishlei 27) – domot limrubbot vehinnam lemassa; anekareysheraa 109:
Lenochach ishto. ze omed bezavit zo umitpallel vezo omedet bezavit zo umitpallelet:
Vayyetar lo. lo velo lah, sheen doma tefillat tzaddik ben tzaddik litfillat tzaddik ben rasha, lefichach lo velo lah (yevamot 64):
ohc: Vayyeater lo vegomer. taam shello amar "vayyeda yitzchak et" vegomer, keamro (Bereshit 4:1) "vehaadam yada", (Shmuel 1 1:19) "vayyeda elkana" vegomer, ulay shehayta hattefilla achar sheyyada (berachot 60.) toch shelosha yamim harishonim, keamram zichronam livracha (berachot 60.) shelosha yamim harishonim yitpallel shello yasriach, vezo hayta tefillato shel yitzchak.

rashi: Befiv. ketargumo befiv shel yitzchak. umidrasho befiv shel esav, shehaya tzad oto umerammehu vidvarav:
ohc: Vayyeehav yitzchak vegomer. hinne ledivrehem zichronam livracha (tanchuma) sheamru shehaya tzad aviv bidvarim, heach measserin et hammelach, lo chash laasot ken ella leyitzchak velo lerivka, ki lo letzad hammitzva haya choshesh ella letzad shehaya yare mikkillato, gam letikvat habberachot, ma sheen ken rivka. velaze timtza shello amar "yikrevu yeme evel avi veimmi" ella "avi", vetaam rivka shello higgida leyitzchak risho, efshar shehaya merammehu shello befaneha leval daat sibbat ahavato oto lahasirah. ulefi uneklos shettirgem "are mitztzedeh hava achel", tzarich ladaat lamma lo yoil taam ze gam lerivka, ki min hassetam lo yaflig atzmo yitzchak merivka. veulay ki rivka chiyyuvah al yitzchak lehaachilah basar, uchemo shekkatav maharik beeven haezer (siman 70 saif 1) shechayyav bimzonoteha, veim bene mishpachtah regilim bigdolot tzarich lehanehigah ken, ad kan. veyadua ki betuel sar vegadol laaram, laze lo tachazik tova leteref befiha.

rashi: Vezeriti feresh. shel behemot chaggechem al penechem. kelomar, lo tekabbelu sachar meitti ki im leraa, levoshet, veegar lachem et zera hassade.
Venasa etchem elav. peresh behemot karbenotechem yissa etchem elav, lihyot zollim venivzim kamohu.
targum: Ha ana nezef lechon beallat bar zara vaagile bahatat chovechon al appechon vaavatel revut chagechon veyitmena chulakchon mineh:

rashi: Beshalom uvemishor halach itti. aharon veelazar ufinchas. vechen bemaase haegel, heshivu kol shivtehem meavon, shenneemar: "vayyeasfu elav kol bene levi" (Shemot 32:26).
targum: Orayta dekusheta hava bepumeh veshikra la ishtechach besifvateh bishlama uviruta uvitritzuta halech kodamay vesagiin ativ mechova:

rashi: Shesh henna sane Adonai vesheva. toavat nafsho, kelomar: gam hashsheviit immahem:
targum: Shit inun desane elaha uvesheva asdeyat nafsheh:

rashi: Ki nochach ene Adonai darche ish vegomer mefalles. – shokel derachav veyodea kamma avonot vechamma zechuyyot beyado:
targum: Metul dekadam aynoy deelaha inun archateh degavra vechulehon sheviloy gelan kodamoy:

rashi: Ufarinu vaaretz. ketargumo venefush beara:
Lo negaanucha. kesheamarnu lech lecha meimmanu:
Atta. gam atta ase lanu kemo chen:
ohc: Im taase immanu. dikdeku lomar nosach veseder habberit asher yichrot lahem shehu bishvil hattova, vehu amro im taase immanu raa kaasher vegomer, perush: tihye hashshevua bead hattova shekkibbalta mimmennu. uvaze yesh taam lehafesakat hakketuvim beseder ze, shemmin harauy haya lo lehafesik betevat "kaasher" vegomer, vetevat "im taase immanu raa" hayu nismachim bappasuk shellefanav shemmesayyem "berit immach", sham kanu mekomam lehazekir habberit.

Ulefi devarenu yeduyyak al nachon, ki yechavven ledakdek seder hashshevua shettihye bishvil hattova. veamram lo negaanucha vegomer, leheyot sheen hakkarat hachesed sheasu shehaya letovat yitzchak ella achar hakkarat perat ze, ki timtza shemechukke hammelachim sheyyittenu yad veezer leshochne artzam liknot hon lishte sibbot: haachat leim yitztarchu lahem lehalevot mehem yihye lahem bayit vahon laazor lehoil lefi shaa, hashsheniyya kede shettitromem malchutam, ki titnasse birvot bah anashim ashirim uvaale shem ki hu mittachsise hammalchut. uleachat mishshete sibbot yomar haomer ki tovat avimelech leyitzchak lahanaat atzmo nitkavven, laze dikdek lomar kaasher lo negaanucha miyyamenu, afillu bingia shehu davar sheeno mechasser mamon ella kedavar shechozer beenav. uvaze beemet ki lo asinu immecha rak tov, perush shalal teamim hannogim lahem, vehitzdik shehakkavvana hi lehetiv lo davka. uletzad shettomar ki hayta hakkavvana lemaalat hammalchut, hinne shillachnucha atta umamoncha, vehu amro vanneshallechacha beshalom, perush uvemamoncha. hareta ladaat ki en kavvanatenu behetiv immecha letachsise hammelucha, umeatta lo haya metziut lehatzedik hattov hahu ki nitkavvenu letovato, ella achar sheshshillechuhu hukkeru haddevarim kenim. uvaze natnu tosefet taam gam ken lema sheshshillechuhu, ki hu ze davar hammaamid letovat hanaa hamekayyemet hashshevua. vechol ze nichlal bichlal amram "rao rainu".

Veraiti lerazal sheamru (Bereshit Rabba 64) veze leshonam: melammed shello asu immo tova shelema, ad kan. velichora divrehem rechokim beyoter, ki hem bau leratztzoto uleharoto chibba yetera, veyomru elav hafechatat hattov. ulema shekkatavti ki kavvanatam hi kede shettihye hashshevua bishvil tova, yihyu divrehem zichronam livracha meirim kashshemesh. ki amru shehattova shehetivu immo lo hayta muchletet lehetiv elav, ella letachlit hamekuvva mimmennu lahem, shehu habberit asher shoalim mimmennu, venachon uchefattish yefotzetz.
Veamro atta atta beruch Adonai – perush, shello era lo ra meemtzaut sheshshalchuhu, shehare hu mevorach kemo shehaya kodem, vehakkavvana baze shello nitbattel hattov hahu shebbaado atta nishba lanu.

Veda shehagam shekkatav haribbash sheeno karuy bishvil tova ella im hayta hattova beet hashshevua, hu haddin im bishat hashshevua barur shennishba bead tova shekkevar asa lo, hare ze dome lezokef alav hattova bechov uvead vittur hachov nishba.

Od yirtze latet taam sheenam machzirim oto laaretz, ki hu beruch Adonai adrabba beyoter maala mikkodem, ki ad atta hayta hashepaato meemtzaut hair shehi tachat memshelet sare mala, ma sheen ken atta shehu makom leatzmo, hashepaato haya shello al yede emtzai ella beruch Adonai.

Od yirtze lishlol taanat setirat hahatava, ki lo mehem haya hammussag elav hattov ella meAdonai, veharaya, hen hayyom bammakom shehu bo, mevorach bechol midda tova. laze amru atta atta beruch Adonai, perush: atta achar shehetavnu lecha beemtzaut hammuchan matza mekor habberachot lachul alecha berov tov. uveofen ze hishbiu bechol tokef sheen metziut lehattir, aval zulat ze haya yachol lehattir. vahagam deamrinan beferek hashsholeach (gittin 46) lisvarat chachamim shecholkim al rabbi yehuda shettaam shello hikku yisrael haggivonim hu mishshum kedushshat hashshem, uferesh Rashi shello yomru hannachrim avru bene yisrael al shevuatam, hare dahagam deyeshnah lehattara letzad dehave chillul hashshem baddavar lo yattir, en ze meikkar hattora ella gader. veod kevar katavti beorech behilchot nedarim bifrat ze ki davka bishvua shehi mefursemet kehahi shel givonim, uchemo sheddiyyakti sham middivre Rashi.

Veod. lu yihye shessovrim chachamim sheen lechallek bechol shevuat nachrim, hare yesh sevarat rabbi yehuda sheen mechallek ben nachrim leyisrael, sheyyodim haggoyim sheyyesh hattara lishvua veen kan chillul hashshem, velaze nitchakkem avimelech lehashebio shevua sheen lah hattara gam lisvarat rabbi yehuda.

rashi: Holech ikkeshut pe. haholech baakimat sefatayim:
targum: Bar nash taloma gavra avla mehalech baakimut pumeh:

rashi: Hachamudot. hannekiyyot, ketargumo dachyata, davar acher shechamad otan min nimrod:
Asher ittah babbayit. vahalo chamma nashim hayu lo, vehu mafkid etzel immo? ella shehaya vaki vemaasehen vechoshdan:
ohc: Vattalbesh vegomer. perush: halamatam alav betikkun hallevisha, hagam shehayu gedolim tikkenatam lakkatan.

rashi: Veelle toldot yitzchak. yaakov veesav haamurim bapparasha:

Avraham holid et yitzchak. al yede shekkatav hakkatuv yitzchak ben avraham huzkak lomar avraham holid et yitzchak; lefi shehayu letzane haddor omrim meavimelech nitabbera sara, shehare kamma shanim shahata im avraham velo nitabbera hemennu; me asa hakkabba? tzar kelaster panav shel yitzchak dome leavraham, veheidu hakkol avraham holid et yitzchak, vezehu shekkatuv kan yitzchak ben avraham, shehare edut yesh sheavraham holid et yitzchak:
ohc: Veelle toldot vegomer. tzarich ladaat: 1 bimkom sheyyazkir toldot yitzchak, hizkir ledat yitzchak, 2 lo haya tzarich lehodia ki avraham holid et yitzchak.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi al ze hadderech: veelle toldot yitzchak perush haamurim besof happarasha, vechevan shezzachar banav shel yitzchak, uchevar kadam lanu ki yitzchak keshennolad lo haya bemadrega sheyyolid ki ba missitra denukeba, uchemo shekkatavnu (Bereshit 22:2), im ken minnayin lo toladot? laze gamar omer: avraham holid et yitzchak, perush hifil koach halleda beyitzchak, shehimshich elav nefesh shehi bemadregat hammolid, veze haya beemtzaut haakeda kemo shekkatavnu.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (yevamot sad.) "vayyeater lo Adonai" lefi sheen dome vechulei litfillat tzaddik ben tzaddik, ad kan. ha lamadta ki letzad heyot lo av tzaddik nitratztza Adonai lo venatan lo banim, vehu amro avraham holid vegomer, perush beemtzaut zechut avraham holid vegomer:

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 63) befasuk (Yeshayahu 29:22) "el bet yaakov asher pada et avraham", ki bizchut yaakov nitztzol avraham mikkivshan haesh, vezulato kevar haya chas veshalom avraham nisraf beur kasdim. vehu amro elle toldot yitzchak ben avraham, shebbeemtzauto avraham holid et yitzchak, ki zulat yaakov shehu toldot yitzchak kevar haya avraham nisraf kodem sheyyolid yitzchak.

Od yirmoz al ikkar toldot hatztzaddikim shehem mitzvot umaasim tovim, ki leheyot sheyyitzchak lo nodu nisyonotav vegeder tzidkuto, vahagam sheppashat tzavvaro al gabbe hammizbeach en davar ze mevoar battora, vead hayyom yesh mefarshim (even Ezra 22:4) ki beal karcho neekad, laze modia hakkatuv beamro "veelle toldot yitzchak ben avraham" – habbet uree hammolid vehammuram kayyotze bo. veramaz gam ken betevat ben avraham al derech amro (Mishlei 10) "ben chacham", perush ki hu avraham bivchinat hatztzidkut vehafelagat chibbato yitbarach. uchefi ze yeduyyak gam ken amro veelle betosefet vav, lomar mosif al toldotav shel avraham hammefursam letova bechamma nisyonot, gam toldotav shel yitzchak bedomin.
Od yirmoz al ze hadderech "veelle toldot yitzchak ben" – echad haya avraham, perush kaddome lo, shello damu leavraham shete toldotav shel yitzchak.

Od yirmoz beamro avraham holid vegomer al ze hadderech, shehagam sheddimma toldot hattov shel yitzchak leshel avraham karamuz beamro "veelle" betosefet vav, im kol ze lo tishve maalato leshel avraham, ki hu haav zikka lo. vehu amro avraham holid et yitzchak, bechinat hattov shebbo baa mikkoach hammolid, ma sheen ken avraham ki aviv oved avoda zara haya, vehu nitatztzem lehassig boro umaalat avraham nisgava. velaze nikra (Yeshayahu 41:8) avraham ohavo yitbarach, perush: hu kadam lihyot ohev lekono, kodem sheyyair Adonai elav ahavato bo hu radaf acharav behitatztzemut nifla, ma sheen ken yitzchak, ki bana vo avraham binyan ahavat hattov, uchesheppakach eno baolam kevar nacha alav ruach Adonai.

Od yirmoz al ze hadderech, ki toldot yitzchak haya bivchina yoter meulla mittoldot avraham, ki eno dome tzaddik ben tzaddik letzaddik ben rasha (yevamot sad), shehu avraham ben terach. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 38,12) sheasa teshuva, im kol ze beet ledat avraham ad samuch lemitato lo haya ella bemadregat rasha, ufeullat haav rasha tachshich meor nefesh habben. uvivchina zo nitrabbet hachesharat maase yitzchak, vehu amro veelle betosefet al harishon, venatan taam beamro "avraham holid" vegomer:

Od nitkavven lomar al ze hadderech: elle toldot – perush meoraot asher avaruhu leyitzchak kammeforashim beseder happarasha, ucheamram zichronam livracha shekkullam shelemim belo shum meora shel tzaar uverov tuv osher vechavod, vechammevoar beferush ramban zichrono livracha (Bereshit 25:34), ma shello haya chen leavraham shekkamma avaruhu mehatztzarot. venatan hakkatuv taam letzad ki avraham holid et yitzchak, uletzad sheaviv tzaddik haya vezikka lo haosher vehakkavod vechulei, ma sheen ken avraham shello haya lo av sheyyezakke lo.

rashi: Achot nevayot. mimmashma shenneemar bat yishmael eni yodea shehi achot nevayot? ella lamadnu shemmet yishmael mishsheyyeadah leesav kodem nissueha vehissiah nevayot achiha, velamadnu shehaya yaakov beoto happerek ben 63 shanim, shehare yishmael ben 74 shanim haya keshennolad yaakov, 14 shana haya gadol yishmael miyyitzchak, veyitzchak ben 60 shana beledet otam hare 74, ushenotav hayu 137, shenneemar veelle shene chayye yishmael vegomer, nimtza yaakov keshemmet yishmael ben 63 shanim haya, velamadnu mikkan shennitman bevet ever 14 shana veachar kach halach lecharan, shehare lo shaha bevet lavan lifne ledato shel yosef ella 14 shana, shenneemar avadticha arba esre shana bishte venotecha veshesh shanim betzonecha, usechar hatztzon mishshennolad yosef haya, shenneemar vayhi kaasher yalda rachel et yosef vegomer; veyosef ben 30 shana haya keshemmalach, umishsham ad sheyyarad yaakov lemitzrayim 9 shanim, 7 shel sava uv shel raav, veyaakov amar lefaro yeme shene meguray sheloshim umeat shana – tze vachashov 14 shellifne ledat yosef usheloshim shel yosef vetesha mishshemmalach ad shebba yaakov, hare 53, ucheshepperesh meaviv haya ben 63, hare 116, vehu omer sheloshim umeat shana, hare chaserim 14 shanim, ha lamadta sheachar shekkibbel habberachot nitman bevet ever 14 shanim, aval lo neenash bizchut hattora; shehare lo peresh yosef meaviv ella 22 shana, dehaynu miz ad 39, keneged 22 shepperesh yaakov meaviv velo chibbedo, vehem 20 shanim bevet lavan ushete shanim sheshshaha vadderech, kedichtiv vayyiven lo bayit ulemiknehu asa sukkot, ufer razili mizze happasuk sheshshaha 18 chodashim badderech – devayit hava bimot haggeshamim vesukkot havu bimot hachamma – ulecheshbon happesukim shechashavnu leel mishshepperesh meaviv ad sheyyarad lemitzrayim shehaya ben 130 shanim, sheshsham anu motzim od 14 shanim – ella vadday nitman bevet ever bahalichato levet lavan lilmod tora mimmennu, uvishvil zechut hattora lo neenash alehem velo peresh yosef mimmennu ella 22 shana – midda keneged midda – ad kan berashi yashan:
Al nashav. hosif risha al rishato, shello geresh et harishonot:

ohc: Vayyomer hishshava li. taam shehutzrach lishvua, leheyot ki yesh babbechora peratim shehem devarim sheen bahem mammash, kemo hakkavod vehammaala, shealehem hikpid yaakov laavodat bet elohenu shehi babbechorot, uchefi toratenu hakkedosha en adam makne lo bemecher velo bemattana davar sheen bo mammash kayyadua (282 hilchot mechira perek 22), laze nitchakkem lizkot baddavar al yede shevua. vechen hu hasekamat poske hattora (yore dea siman 239) ki hashshevua chala ben al davar sheyyesh bo mammash ben al davar sheen bo mammash, vehu amro hishshava li.

Vehinne shevua zo lo taspik lekinyan davar shello ba laolam, ki taam deen adam makne davar shello ba laolam hi letzad dela samcha dateh delokeach vechulei, vechen muchach bimtzia daf 16. aval im haya dato somechet haya nikne, ushevua lo toil baze, velachen hutzrach letaam "chayyom" kemo shepperashti. shuv ba leyadi sefer harivash siman 328 veze leshono: katavta sheraita rabbi yaakov ben harosh shekkatav beshem aviv demakne davar shello ba laolam im nishba kana vechulei, ureayato mimmechirat bechora shemmachar esav leyaakov uchetiv "hishshava li", ad kan. teshuva: lo harosh velo rabbi yaakov beno chatime alah, veen litlot begavre ravreve sevara kazo sheen lah al ma shettismoch, gam haraya sheheviu en lah ikkar lefi shehaya kodem haddibbur, uman lema lan shello haya adam makne davar shello ba laolam az, vehashshevua hayta leravcha demilleta shello yearer, lefi shehaya ish zeroa, ad kan. vehem devarenu atzman, ella sheharivash lo hitbonen latet taam shehutzrach shevuat esav kemo shekkatavti.

Vetaam amro hishshava li velo hispik lomar "hishshava" vehaddavar muvan ki lo hi hammechira, nitkavven lomar ki shevua zo tzericha lihyot al dato shel yaakov, shezzulat ze yachol levattelah belibbo, veikkar hashshevua tzericha lihyot ballev, kidamar rabbi akiva (sifra, perek 12): haadam bishvua, sheyyihye piv velibbo shavim bishat hashshevua. laze amar "hishshava li", perush: ledati.

Gam dikdek lomar li, ki davka hu sheyyachol lehitkayyem mecher habbechora bechol chalakav, aval lo lezulat, ki hazzulat eno ben keniyya ella devarim shehem mamon, aval devarim shehem yerushsha maalot meavihem, kegon haavoda shebbevet elohim vehakkavod, enam beish nachri, velav kol kemineh lemachram lezar.

Vayyimkor et bechorato. hitzdika hattora hammechira shekayyemet hi beyado mitteamim shekkatavnu, vahagam shello machar ella leanso, vahagam shemmachar davar shave mea mane bemane. veze lecha leshon 355 (choshen mishpat 227): im machar mippene dachko vezilzel bimchirato yoter mikkede shehaddaat toa, shennikkar shemmippene dachko hutzrach lezalzel, eno yachol lachzor bo, deyada umachal, ad kan leshono. umeatta, hagam shemmachar davar muflag haerech bilgima achat shel nazid, mimkaro mecher, kemo sheggilla hu dato beamro hinne hu holech lamut, veen lecha dochak gadol mizze, (Iyov 2:4) "or bead or vechol asher laish yitten bead nafsho". vehinne zulat hametzaa zo lo haya metziut leyaakov lizkot babbechora miyyad esav. veal esav amar hannavi (Mishlei 5:22) "avonotav yilkeduno et harasha", shebbesibbat avonotav sheasa bo bayyom, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 63,14) beferush amro "vehu ayef", ze haya sibba lehotzi mimmennu habbechora vetaamodna beyad harauy lah.

rashi: Vayyivez esav. heid hakkatuv al risho shebbizza avodato shel makom:
ohc: Vayyakam vayyelech vayyivez esav vegomer. perush: hattora meida alav shebbizza habbechora bedato. velaze lo hispik lomar "vayyivez" vechozer el esav haamur besamuch, vehaven. vechavvanat hodaa zo lomar gam belo taam dilanso gamar, ki beenav bezuya hi umachor yimkerenna bidvar ma, hagam shello haya tzarich lehashiv nafsho vegamar umakne.

rashi: Avonotav yilkeduno. kemo yilkeduhu:
Uvechavle chattato yittamech. yittale, shehattaluy nitmach bachevel shehu taluy bah:
targum: Chovoy derashia kamtin leh uvechavle dachatoy nitpecher:

rashi: Lo yadati yom moti. amar rabbi yehoshua ben karcha im maggia adam leferek avotav yidag chamesh shanim lifnehen vechamesh leachar ken; veyitzchak haya ben 123, amar shemma leferek immi ani maggia vehi meta bat 127 vahareni ven Adonai shanim samuch lefirkah; lefichach lo yadati yom moti, shemma leferek immi, shemma leferek abba:
Nochel. mitnakkel bemirma, bedivre sheker lefanay, lemor: "en li tova mizzo".
Veyesh beedro zachar. ayil hehagun leola, vehu noder zevach.
Mashchat. baal mum, kemo (Vayikra 22:25) "mashchatam bahem".
targum: Velit deyabed binchil veit beedreh dechar vehu chayav lindar udevach dimchabbel kodam Adonai are melach rav ana amar Adonai tzevaot ushemi chasin beammaya:

rashi: Bene immecha. veyaakov amar lihuda bene avicha, lefi shehayu lo vanim mikkamma immahot, vechan, shello nasa ella ishsha achat, omer bene immecha (Bereshit Rabba):

Orrecha arur umevarchecha baruch. uvevilam hu omer mevarchecha varuch veorrecha arur? hatztzaddikim techillatam yissurim vesofan shalva veorrehem umetzaarehem kodmim limvarchehem, lefichach yitzchak hikdim killat orrim levirchat mevarchim; harshaim techillatan shalva vesofan yissurin, lefichach bilam hikdim beracha liklala (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Yaavducha vegomer. ulay ki hammelech lo yaale mas hannogea lo ben haam, vechaddome laze yimmatze bizman sheyyisrael meshubadim leummot haolam, hammelachim shebbahem shehem baale tora peturim mehammas (Ezra 7:24). uma sheamar achar kach (Bereshit 27:40) "veet achicha taavod" vehu haya melech, chozer el bene esav.
Heve gevir leachecha. perush, achiv mammash lo yihye lo leeved, ella sheyyihye hu gevir lo, aval habbaim acharav yishtachavu lo, vehu amro veyishtachavu lecha bene immecha:

Od yirtze sheyyihye hu mitgabber alav beemtzaut avodat hakkodesh, az yishtachavu lo bene vegomer, ki zulat ze lo yishtabed ach leachiv, velaze timtza ki bimat hitrashshelut shehayu mitrashshelim yisrael baavodat Adonai, techef umiyyad (Melachim 2 8:22) vayyifsha edom:
Orrecha vegomer umevarchecha vegomer. perush: orrecha leatid arur hu meachshav velo yakum learer, umevarchecha baruch hu mikkodem kede shettachul birchato alecha.

Vetaam amro "mevarchecha" leshon rabbim velo berach ella leechad, gam hizkir mearrim rabbim vearur leechad, nitkavven lishlol chelek mehamearrim sheeno arur, vehu achiyya hashshiloni (Melachim 1 11:29) vechayyotze bo, laze amar "arur" velo "arurim" kullam, uvammevarchim gam ken yesh mehammevarchim sheeno bichlal baruch, vehu bilam harasha, shehagam shebberach lo yevorach, velaze amar "mevarchecha" – yesh bahem chelek echad shehu baruch velo kullam, lishlol hannizkar.

Veamar umevarchecha betosefet vav, lirmoz al min mekallel sheyyeshno bichlal beracha, vehu hammechavven levarech, al derech amram rabbanan lerabbi elazar ben rabbi shimon bar yochay (moed katan 9:) "tizra velo techtzad" vechulei, veze hu shiur hakkatuv orrecha arur umevarchecha perush, veotam orrecha im hem mechavvenim limvarchecha – baruch.

rashi: Vayyecherad. ketargumo uteva, leshon temiha. umidrasho raa gehinnom petucha mittachtav:
Mi efo. lashon leatzmo meshammesh im kamma devarim; efo – ayye fo, mi hu veefo hu hatztzad tzayid?
Vaochal mikkol. mikkol teamim shebbikkashti litom, taamti vo (Bereshit Rabba):
Gam baruch yihye. shello tomar illule sherimma yaakov leaviv lo natal et habberachot, lechach hiskim uvercho middato (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyecherad yitzchak vegomer gam baruch vegomer. taam shene devarim hafekiyyim benose echad, ki mittechilla charad al harammaut, veachar kach chash lema shekkadam veamar bevirchato "orrecha arur" uverchahu. kodem lo yada mi hu vecharad vechash leadam acher, ucheshehitbonen baddavar vehiskil ki hu yaakov berach oto, ki heriach mereach begadav veyada hefresh shebbeno leven esav vechatam al habberachot. gam chash lema shekkadam lomar "orrecha arur" laze berchahu.

rashi: Achad haam. hameyuchad baam, ze hammelech:
Veheveta alenu asham. im shachav kevar, heveta alenu asham:
Baaretz hahiv. aappi sheeno chashuva keeretz yisrael atzmah, keeretz shiva goyim (Bereshit Rabba):
Bashshana hahi. aappi sheenah ketiknah, shehayta shenat reavon (Bereshit Rabba):
Baaretz hahi bashshana hahi. shenehem lamma? lomar, shehaaretz kasha vehashshana kasha:
Mea shearim. sheamaduha kamma reuya laasot, veasta al achat sheamaduha mea. verabbotenu amru omed ze lemaasrot haya:
ohc: Mea shearim vayvarchehu. perush, leheyot dedavar hannimdad en habberacha metzuya bo (bava metzia 42.), vechan amar shehagam shennimdad venoda shiur mea shearim, af al pi chen vayvarchehu Adonai. od yirtze shello nichnas bo ayin hara mehafelagat harevach, ki yetzav Adonai itto et habberacha.

rashi: Veatta challu na fene. veatta attem hakkohanim haosim hara hazzot, ech yaale bilvavchem lihyot sheluche yisrael levakkesh alehem rachamim? hare miyyedchem hayta zot haraa.
Hayissa. et penechem lishmoa tefilla mippichem, velachon et sholchechem?
targum: Uchean tzalu kean kodam elaha vikabbel tzelotana miyedchon hava da hayitnasvun lechon appin amar Adonai tzevaot:

rashi: Venivo nivze achlo. nivo shel mizbeach hashshagur besiftotechem, zehu: "tamid nivze achlo" – attem omrim alav. kelomar, kevar hotzetem alav dibba zo, veniv ze hechezaktem lemizbechi.
Achlo. maachalo.
targum: Veattun mechallin yateh bidattun amrin petora dayya besir hu uvesiran mattenata mineh:

rashi: Veyitten lecha. yitten veyachazor veyitten (Bereshit Rabba). ulefi feshuto musav leinyan harishon: ree reach beni shennatan lo hakkabba kereach sade vegomer veod yitten lecha mittal hashshamayim vegomer:
Mittal hashshamayim. kemashmao; umidreshe aggada yesh leharebe fanim:

Haelohim. mahu haelohim? baddin; im rauy lecha yitten lecha veim lav lo yitten lecha, aval leesav amar mishmanne haaretz yihye moshavecha, ben tzaddik ben rasha yitten lecha; umimmennu lamad shelomo, kesheasa habbayit sidder tefillato. yisrael shehu vaal emuna umatzdik alav et haddin lo yikra alecha tiggar, lefichach venatatta laish vechol derachav asher teda et levavo (Melachim 1, 8), aval nachri mechussar amana, lefichach amar atta tishma hashshamayim, veasita kechol asher yikra elecha hannachri (sham), ben rauy ben sheeno rauy ten lo, kede shello yikra alecha tiggar:
ohc: Veyitten lecha haelohim. taam amro vav bitchillat inyan, leheyot shekkadam veamar "vayvarchehu" hosif od lomar "veyitten lecha" vegomer, uma shello peresh habberachot harmuzot bevayvarchehu", ulay sheyyechavven al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 39:11) shemmafteach habberachot netano Adonai leavraham veavraham leyitzchak (Bereshit Rabba 11) veatta mesaram yitzchak leyaakov, vehu amro vayvarchehu perush, masar lo habberachot sheyyihyu birshuto.

Od yirtze shebbercho berachot ruchaniyyot vegashmiyyot. keneged haruchaniyyot amar behelem "vayvarchehu", ucheneged haggashmiyyot amar veyitten lecha vegomer betosefet vav, lomar millevad olam haelyon asher bachar avraham levanav, shehu ikkar tachlit zera yisrael, od yitten lo baolam hazze vechulei:
Od yirtze al ze hadderech: lo millevad middat harachamim, ella gam middat haddin taskim al netina zo, vehu amro veyitten lecha haelohim, perush gam middat elohim.

rashi: Vayyigdelu … vayhi esav. kol zeman shehayu ketannim, lo hayu nikkarim bemaasehem, veen adam medakdek bahem ma tivam; kevan shennaasu vene shelosh esre shana, ze peresh levatte midrashot veze peresh laaza:
Yodea tzayid. latzud ulerammot et aviv befiv veshoalo abba, haech measserin et hammelach veet hatteven? kassavur aviv shehu medakdek bemitzvot (tanchuma):
Ish sade. kemashmao, adam batel vetzode vekashto chayyot veofot:
Tam. eno vaki vechol elle, kelibbo ken piv, mi sheeno charif lerammot karuy tam:
Yoshev ohalim. oholo shel shem veoholo shel ever:
En ra. vechi en davar ze ra?
targum: Udeattun mekarvin deavir ledabbacha hala bish udeattun mekarvin dachagir vedimria hala bish karevohi kean leshiltonach daalach hayitree bach o hayisav appach amar Adonai tzevaot:

rashi: Ben arbaim shana. esav haya nimshal lachazir, shenneemar yecharsemenna chazir miyyaar (Tehillim 80), hachazir hazze keshehu shochev, poshet telafav, lomar reu sheani tahor; kach ellu gozlim vechomsim umarim atzmam kesherim; kol 40 shana haya esav tzad nashim mittachat baalehen umeanne otam, keshehaya ben 40 amar abba ben 40 shana nasa ishsha, af ani chen:
Lihyot beriti et levi. sheani chafetz shettitkayyemu (itti) babberit shekkaratti leshevet levi.
targum: Vetedun are shelachit levatchon yat tafkedta hada lemeheve keyami deim levi amar Adonai tzevaot:

rashi: Nokashta veimre ficha. shettakata kaf lehiddaver im hazzarim (yoma paz.):
targum: Attzedta bemaamara defumach itachadta bemaamara defumach:

rashi: Veel shadday. mi shedday bevirchotav lammitbarchin mippiv, yevarech otcha:
Yigdal Adonai meal ligvul yisrael. yare gedullato meal ligvulenu lehodia ki anachnu ammo. veyonatan tirgem: "yisge yekara da, veafte yat techum ara deyisrael".
targum: Veenechon yechzeyan veattun temrun yisge yekara dayya veafte yat techum yisrael:

rashi: Lech hitrappes. hatter lo pas yad, leshallem lo mamono:
Urehav reecha. veim en lo mamon immecha, ella shennokashta beimre ficha ledabber lo kashot, harebe alav reim levakkesh mimmennu sheyyimchol lecha:

Davar acher: beni im aravta lereecha. achar shennaaseta arev lehakkadosh baruch hu shehu reacha, kedichtiv "ze dodi veze rei" (Shir HaShirim 5:16), vekibbalta alecha besinay uvearvot moav beala uvishvua lishmor mitzvotav:
Takata lazzar kappecha. shettashuv vetasur midderachav vetidbak baeppikorsin lalechet bedarchehem:
Nokashta beimre ficha. shettakata kaf lehiddaver im hazzarim:
Ase zot efo beni vehinnatzel. hoil uvata vechaf reecha besinay, vekibbalta elohuto alecha:
Lech hitrappes. hikkana lefanav kaaskuppa hannirpeset venidreset:
Urehav reecha. harebe reim sheyyitpallelu alecha lefanav. vechen nidrash bemidrash tehillim :
targum: Aved hechna beni veitpetza metul dinfalta beyad dechavrach ezel gereg chavil chavrach:

rashi: Shete mayim mibborecha. mibbor shennatan lecha hakkadosh baruch hu lechelkecha, hi torat moshe:
Borecha. mayim mechunnasim:
Venozlim mittoch beerecha. mayim chayyim. kelomar: techilla kemayim mechunnasim, ulevassof novin hem veholchin:
targum: Ishte maya min guvach uredaya min berach:

rashi: Ki archu. amar, meatta en li lidog, meachar shello anasuha ad achshav, velo nizhar lihyot nishmar:
Vayyashkef avimelech vegomer. raahu meshammesh mittato:
ohc: Metzachek et rivka. perush: maase chibba hannaaset ben ish leishto. uledivre haomer (Bereshit Rabba 64,5) "metzachek" meshammesh mittato, ulay shehaya beechad mehadderachim shemmuttar afillu bayyom, kemo shettomar lirfua, uchemo shekkatav rambam (hilchot deot perek 4), o kammaase shehuva bashshas (ketuvot daf 65) devethu deabbayye degallet vechulei veazal rava vechulei, ki hatztzaddikim yachushu ledome dedome dechiur leval yikkashlu vo.

rashi: Leishto. al ishto, kemo imri li achi hiv (Bereshit 20:13):
Lechallel berit avotenu. berit shekkarat hakkadosh baruch hu im avotenu besinay.
targum: Hala abba chad lechulana hala elaha chad bara yatana ma den neshaker gevar baachohi laafasa keyama di im avahatana:

rashi: Koretz beenav. remizot shel mirma:
Molel beraglav. kelomar: meshafshef ze al ze:
Umore beetzbeotav. kullam min leshon remazim hem, ze nofel al haayin veze nofel al haregel veze nofel al haetzba. vehaikkar – hu medabber al harshaim hammesitin et habberiyyot laavodat gillulim:
targum: Ramez beaynoy vetaches beragloy veramez beetzbeateh:

ohc: Ki atzamta mimmennu vegomer. perush, veen gedullat hammalchut nikkeret lifne gedullato, veen lecha bizyon hammelech kaze.

rashi: Shama avraham bekoli. keshennissiti oto:
Vayyishmor mishmarti. gezerot leharechaka al haazharot shebbattora, kegon sheniyyot laarayot ushevut lashshabbat (yevamot 21):
Mitzvotay. devarim sheillu lo nichtevu reuyin hem lehitztauot, kegon gezel ushefichut damim:
Chukkotay. devarim sheyyetzer hara veummot haolam meshivin alehem, kegon achilat chazir ulevishat shaatnez, sheen taam baddavar, ella gezerat hammelech vechukkotav al avadav:
Vetorotay. lehavi tora shebbeal pe halacha lemoshe missinay (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Shama avraham bekoli – lechol asher nissitihu, vayyishmor mishmarti – shamar atzmo leval yavo leyado davar shetztzivvitihu lishmor, uchemo chen shamar hammitzvot leval yaavruhu behesach haddaat. vechukkotay" hem mitzvot sheen bahem taam, uchemo chen torati shamar leval tishshachach mimmennu, al derech amro (Devarim 4:9) "ushemor nafshecha vegomer pen tishkach et haddevarim" vegomer:

rashi: Haveracha achat. hei zo meshammeshet leshon temiha, kemo habbemachanim? hashshemena hi? hakkemot naval?

Vayyishma yaakov. mechubbar lainyan shel mala, vayyar esav ki verach yitzchak vegomer vechi shillach oto paddena aram, vechi shama yaakov el aviv vehalach paddena aram, vechi raot benot kenaan, vehalach gam hu el yishmael:
Vayyomer ani. lo amar ani esav ella ani:
ohc: Vayyomer atta ze vegomer. perush, matzdik devarav ki hu esav, lo shoel. uteshuvat yaakov hi bilshon peshitut "ani".

Od yirtze beamro atta ze, leheyot shehaya kolo maggid ki yaakov hu, laze nitkavven levarech lagguf hammachlit ki hu esav. velaze amar "atta ze" more beetzba laasher yaggid chush hammishshush, vehaya malbish habberachot bedato bema shellefanav belo shum machshava mi hu. veze hu letova ot shekkibbel habberachot yaakov bechavvana elav, vahagam sheggamar omer yitzchak vehizkir esav, im kol ze bishat habberacha lo haya mevarech ella ze shellefanav.

rashi: Latzud tzayid lehavi. mahu lehavi? im lo yimtza tzayid yavi min haggezel:
ohc: Verivka shomaat vegomer. perush: modia hakkatuv ki rivka nevia hayta veshomaat tamid bedivre yitzchak vegomer, hagam shello yedabber befaneha, vehaven. velaze amar verivka shomaat bedabber vegomer, velo amar "vattishma rivka" vegomer, velo amar "hayta shomaat" vegomer. veulay ki dibber elav yitzchak ballat, velaze heemin bevo yaakov ki hu esav, ki beozen esav dibber. vahagam ki ene yitzchak kavdu, im kol ze hodio ki divre seter elav. veulay ki laze ramaz hakkatuv beamro vayyikra et esav vegomer vayyomer elav beni vayyomer hinneni, perush: nityachadu lidvarim nichmasim.

rashi: Ish sair. baal sear:

Hachi kara shemo. leshon tema hu, kemo hachi achi atta, shemma lechach nikra shemo yaakov al shem sofo shehu atid leakveni? tanchuma. lamma charad yitzchak? amar shemma avon yesh bi shebberachti katan lifne gadol veshinniti seder hayyachas, hitchil esav metzaek vayyakeveni ze faamayim, amar lo aviv me asa lecha? amar lo et bechorati lakach, amar bechach hayiti metzer vechared shemma avarti al shurat haddin, achshav labbechor berachti, gam baruch yihye:
Vayyakeveni. ketargumo uchemani – aravani; vearav – ucheman. veyesh metargemin vechakkemani, nitchakkem li:
Atzalta. leshon haferasha kemo vayyatzel:
ohc: Vayyomer hachi kara vegomer. perush: matmiah "hachi kara shemo yaakov?" umashmaut hashshem lo yaggid ella akba achat, vehu akavani ze faamayim, sheillu haya shemo akavot o okvot haya okvo paamayim.
O yirtze al ze hadderech: hachi kara shemo yaakov – velo amar akba o akev, sheaz lo yaggid ella al akba achat, aval yaakov yaggid al hattemidut, velaze ad atta kevar [akavo] paamayim.

rashi: Veet esav saneti. ledochafo el eretz seir mippene yaakov achiv. uminhag shebbaolam, mi sheyyesh lo shene banim, labbechor hu borer lo mana yafa.
Vaasim et harav shemama. enan domin lehare yisrael.
Letannot midbar. meon tannim.
targum: Veyat esav rechiket veshaveti yat turohi letzadu veyat achsanteh letzadut madbera:

rashi: Vaachuzzat mereehu. ketargumo vesiat merachamohi, siat meohavav. veyesh potrin mereehu 40 misod hatteva, kemo sheloshim mereim deshimshon, kede shettihye tevat vaachuzzat devuka; aval en derech eretz ledabber al hammalchut ken, siat ohavav, sheim ken, kol siat ohavav holich immo, velo haya lo ella sia achat shel ohavim – lachen yesh lefatro ballashon harishon; veal titma al tav shel achuzzat veaappi sheen teva semucha, yesh dugmatah bammikra ezrat mitztzar (Tehillim 60), ushechurat velo miyyayin (Yeshayahu nusach acher):
Achuzzat. leshon kevitza vaagudda shenneechazin yachad:
ohc: Vaavimelech halach elav miggerar vechulei. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar miggerar vehu davar yadua, gam en tzorech behodaa zo. verabbotenu zichronam livracha hirgishu vedarshu (Bereshit Rabba parasha 64) megorar vechulei, veze derech derash. od lamma hutzrach lakachat immo pichol vaachuzzat mereehu, veim letachsise melucha lo haya tzorech lichtov lehodia devarim sheen lanu baze tzorech.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi letaretz ma sheyyikshe lanu, lamma hutzrach avimelech lachzor achar yitzchak lichrot lo berit lelo tzorech, ki kevar nishba lo avraham (Bereshit 21:23) "im tishkor li ulenini ulenechdi", uma michush haya lo laavimelech bishvuat avraham shehutzrach lishvuat yitzchak? veramban zichrono livracha hirgish leyashshev veamar sheyyirat avimelech sheyyitzchak yafer havetachat avraham letzad shehem heferu berit vegershuhu meittam, ad kan. velo raiti shehitna avimelech leavraham bishvuato lashevet beartzo hu uvanav, veen hafarat berit bema sheshshalchu yitzchak, vaadayin kushya bimkomah omedet shello haya tzarich livrit yitzchak.

Asher al ken ba hakkatuv veamar miggerar, perush: mittaam gerar yesh makom lachush levittul berit avraham vehutzrechu lechazzek berit im yitzchak. vehu al derech ma sheamru bindarim (daf 65) veze leshonam: tanya hammudar hanaa mechavero en mattirin lo ella befanav. vechatvu haggahot mayymoniyyot beferek 6 mehilchot shevuot veze leshonam: veamar rabbenu yitzchak davka lechattechilla tzarich beinyan ze aval lo diavad, ulechattechilla lo amru ella beadam haose lo tova, kegon moshe shennatan lo yitro bitto vetzidkiyyahu shehotzio nevuchadnetztzar mimmaasar vechulei, aval adam acher afillu lechattechilla, kidmuchach mipperek ellu neemarin vechulei (sota lo), ad kan. hinne muchach kefi ze sheyyachol hannishba al daat chavero laasot hattara afillu lechattechilla afillu shello befanav, veen tzarich lomar diavad kol shello kibbel hanaa mimmennu. veyesh lecha ladaat ki avraham lo kibbel hanaa meavimelech, ki ma shennatan lo mattanot hu letzad kelimmat sara, uma shennatan lo lashevet bigrar lo kibbel avraham, uchemo shennire mehakketuvim ki pana techef vehalach lo miggerar veyashav lo biver sheva, makom sheggar sham yitzchak achar shillucho miggerar. veshuv ba leyadi maamar echad (Bereshit Rabba 54:2) veze leshono: "kachesed asher asiti" vegomer, ma chesed asa immo sheamar lo "hinne artzi lefanecha" vegomer vehu lo kibbel, ad kan. hare shessovrim razal shehachesed sheasa immo sheamar lo "hinne artzi lefanecha" vegomer lo kibbelo, vahagam sheomer "kachesed" hem divre atzmo veeno ken. velo chen haya beyitzchak shehoshivo beartzo veyashav sham veasa vehitzliach bechol tuv, vehu amro vaavimelech halach elav vehattaam "miggerar", perush: middin hannimshach meemtzaut gerar, ki leavraham lo hayta tovat gerar tova, shehu lo kibbel, ushevuato yeshnah behattara, uleyitzchak hayta hatava, velaze titkayyem hashshevua keshettihye bishvil hattova veeno yachol lehattir shello birtzono shel avimelech.

Veod afillu im timtza lomar ki avimelech keshehishbia avraham haya dato hefech daat rabbenu yitzchak shekkatvu haggahot mayymoniyyot, vehaya sover karambam shekkatav beferek 6 mehilchot shevuot dechol shehishbia chavero al dato, hagam shello kibbel mimmennu hanaa, en mattirin lo ella befanav, af al pi chen lo samach bedato al hashshevua, ki mode sheim diavad hittir shevuato mutteret kevan shello hayta tovat hanaa baemtza, vedin ze shavim bo kol hammorim. laze halach leyitzchak shehayta lo tovat hanaa, uvaze katvu haraavad veharashba vehaachronim shehagam shehittir diavad eno muttar. gam nitchakkem lakachat achuzzat vegomer ufichol lechazzek hashshevua kaasher avaer.
Vaachuzzat mereehu ufichol vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lakachat immo achuzzat mereehu, ma shello asa chen bime avraham?
