Achen yitbaer hainyan al pi ma shennistappek rabbenu tam (250 nedarim 65.) behannishba al daat chavero bishvil hatava, im diavad hittiruhu im muttar o lo, velo huchra. velisvara zo chash avimelech gam lishvua zo, hagam shehu bishvil tova, venitchakkem laasot chizzuk shello toil lo hahattara. vehu al derech ma sheamru begittin daf 46 machloket rabbi yehuda verabbanan, rabbi yehuda savar neder shehuddar barabbim en lo hattara kevan denadar bifne rabbim shuv eno yachol lehattir, verabbanan savre yachol lehattir. veamru baggemara daf 36 amar amemar afillu leman deamar neder shehuddar barabbim yesh lo hattara, neder shehuddar al daat rabbim en lo hattara, ad kan. vechatvu hattosafot deikka panim lomar shello dacha amemar daat rabbi yehuda sheamar neder shehuddar bifne rabbim en lo hattara. vegam middivre rav yosef (fesachim 107.) nammi muchach dahalacha kerabbi yehuda, uvemaskanat divrehem heelu dahalacha kerabbanan, vehaggeonim pasku kerabbi yehuda.

Uchefi ze nitchakkem avimelech lehavi immo rabbim, "achuzzat vegomer ufichol", kede sheyyiddor bifne rabbim. vehinne nechleku amoraim begittin (daf 46.) veze leshonam: yadu bo rabbim, kamma rabbim? rav nachman amar shelosha, rabbi yitzchak amar asara. vehitztzatzti bedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha shennechleku bivreshit rabba rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya, veze leshonam: rabbi yehuda omer achuzzat mereehu shemo, rabbi nechemya omer siat merachamohi, ad kan. veulay ki machlaktam teluya bema shennechleku haamoraim, chad amar shelosha vechad amar asara. rabbi yehuda sheamar "achuzzat shemo" sover kamma rabbim – shelosha, velaze amar "achuzzat shemo", verabbi nechemya sover asara, laze amar "siat" vegomer, shebbaze hayu asara, letachlit hakkavvana kede sheyyihye al daat rabbim sheen lo hattara, uchedaat rabbi yitzchak.

Veefshar shennitchakkem gam ledaat rabbanan sheamru sheyyeshno behattara, velaze hevi pichol, uchedivre amemar sheyyodu rabbanan beneder al daat rabbim sheen lo hattara, laze hevi pichol, veamar rabbi nechemya: "pi shekkol tzevaot" vechulei ad kan, vehishbio avimelech leyitzchak al daat kol tzivotav.

Veraiti ki rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya shennechleku beferush "achuzzat" vegomer, nechleku gam ken (Bereshit Rabba 64:9) beferush "pichol". veefshar ki taam echad lishte hammachlokot: rabbi yehuda shessover "achuzat" shemo, vesover kevan shettaam avimelech hu sheyyihye habberit bifne rabbim, verabbim hem shelosha, laze hinniach hakkatuv kifshuto – shelosha hemma rabbim: avimelech ufichol vaachuzat. verabbi nechemya shello hispik lo likrot rabbim shelosha, uferesh "achuzat" siat merachamohi, im ken pichol ze lamma hevio? vechi hevio, lamma hutzrach hakkatuv lehazekiro? ki haasara hinne hinnam bassia, sheen sia pachot measara. laze peresh "pi shekkol" vechulei, ulemidda acheret nitkavven shettihye al daat rabbim kemo shekkatavti. velo yikshe beenecha ma shepperashnu shennechleku hattannaim bema shennechleku haamoraim, kaze hem rabbim, ki lo hayu haamoraim bekiim babberaytot uvifrat baaggadot.

rashi: Paddena. kemo lefaddan:
Beta vetuel. levet betuel, kol teva shetztzericha lamed bitchillatah hetil lah hei besofah (yevamot 13):
Ben. yesh alav lechabbed av, vechen eved adonav. veattem keruyin banim vaavadim, veatta im av ani lachem ayye chevodi.
Amar Adonai tzevaot lachem. attem hakkohanim habbozim et shemi.
Vaamartem bamme vazinu. kelomar yadati shettomru li: "bamme vazinu"? hare habbizzayon.
targum: Ha al bera amir leyakara yat abba veavda lemidchal min kodam ribboneh im keav ana an deattun miyakrun kodamay veim keribbon ana an deattun dachalin min kodamay amar Adonai tzevaot lechon kahanaya dimvasrin al shemi veim temrun bema basirna al shemach:

ohc: Alay killatcha beni vegomer. taam amrah beni achar sheimmo hayta medabberet, perush, ma shehotzeta atta mippicha atta, veshiur hatteva kelala shekkillalta beni, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (makkot 11.) killat chacham afillu al tenay vegomer, velaze chashsha velavsha hi geram kelala shehotzi mippiv, veim lo [hayta] omeret "beni" haya nishma kelala sheyyekallelo aviv:

Veraiti latet taam leahavat rivka leyaakov, letzad ki ene chol eleha yatziru ki mimmenna yatza rasha hu esav, vehinne latteva haragil hachalakim yohavu chelek el chalakav, veze mehabbochan. laze gilleta datah ki lo chen hu, umaaseha mochichot ki mekorah baruch, vechelek hattov chalakeha vetivah el ahavat hattov yarutz. velaze timtza sheyyarbe hakkatuv lomar bechol poal ufaul mimmenna "yaakov benah" lelo tzorech (Bereshit 27:6,8,11,13,15,17,42), vechavvanato hi lehaggid ki mimmenna archot tzaddik visodo misodah gam ken nivna, umotzao shel esav lo mibbechinatah shel rivka chas veshalom.

Gam yesh sod baddavar kayyadua leyode chen, ki hu zuhamat hakkedushsha achar tzerufah beesh haggevura shebbivchinat yitzchak avinu, vehaven. vahagam shekkatavnu lemala (Bereshit 25:20) ki sibbato hu heyotah achot lavan, davar ze lo yihye sibba livchinat rivka ki mimmenna hu kemaaseha chas veshalom, uferat ze hu mehammusgal lehaferid hazzuhama bifne atzmah velaamod kav hattov al tillo, hu yaakov avinu sheshshufereh meen shufereh shel adam harishon (bava metzia 84.), vehu sod vehaven.

rashi: Yemushsheni. kemo memashshesh batztzohorayim:

ohc: Verivka amra. amar tosefet vav ki hiskima hi leruach hakkodesh hashsheruya aleha.

Lemor hinne vegomer. perush, shello yachshov ki kevar avar zeman aroch meet dibber yitzchak leesav, veyomar ki lo yaspik hu laasot mitzvatah shel rivka ad shekkevar esav asa maasehu, laze amra lemor hinne, perush amra lo ki beotah shaa shama veyesh zeman.
Achicha lemor. perush: lo achicha bedome lecha, ella baamira yomar elav shem "achicha", aval lo yidme choshech leor olam.

Od nitkavvena beamrah lemor, shello lehotzi devar sheker mippiha, ki lo amra haddevarim bedikduk kitziatam mippe yitzchak. laze amra "lemor havia" vegomer, perush: ma shennitkavven baamirato hu ze, vezulat "lemor" yihye nishma ki omeret devarav bedikduk.

rashi: Lama eshkal. ehye shakkula mishshenechem. hakkover et banav karuy shakkul, vechen beyaakov amar kaasher shacholti shachalti:
Gam shenechem. im yakum alecha veatta tahargennu yaamdu vanav veyahargucha; veruach hakkodesh nizreka vah venitnabbea shebbeyom 1 yamutu, kemo shemmeforash beferek hamekanne leishto:
ohc: Gam shenechem vegomer. perush, lo yihye sheyyamut gam hu, o al yadcha o al yede goale haddam, af al pi chen en marpe leshivrecha bema sheyyamut gam hu immecha beyom echad, uleolam enah makpedet ella al mitat yaakov velo al esav.

rashi: Uva chimhallech reshecha. im taase ken yavo chesroncha, vedavar sheatta rash mimmennu yavo lecha miyyad, keadam hamehallech maher; umachsorcha yavo veyitmalle:
Keish magen. habba maher lehagen al adonav. hammikraot ellu – ikkaran mashal al hammitatztzelin laasok battora:
targum: Vetete vetidroch miskenutach vechuseranach hech gavra keshera:

rashi: Tishge tamid. raiti bedivre rabbi moshe haddarshan: tishge. taasok tamid, vehu leshon aravi. vehevi reaya, kemo 'levakkesh shegiya – levakkesh esek; velo yadati efo nishnet. verabbotenu pershu (eruvin ned:): leshon 'mashge kemashmao: baavur ahavatah tihye shogeg bishar asakecha, ki hi meshammeret al shellecha. amru alav al rabbi eliezer ben pedat, shehaya doresh bashshuk hattachton, vesdino muttal bashshuk haelyon. paam achat ba adam echad umatza nachash karuch alav:
targum: Ayalleta derachamuta veditzta dechesda tadvana alaf bechol zeman uverachamutah tigras tedira:

rashi: Pitom. ufeta leshon techifa hi. velo yada et hammappala hakkerova lippol alav:
targum: Metul hechna min shilya nete tavreh umin shilya nitbar vela teheve leh asyuta:

rashi: Vayyomer Adonai lah. al yede shaliach; leshem neemar beruach hakkodesh vehu amar lah (Bereshit Rabba):
Shene goyim bevitnech. gayym ketiv; ellu antoninus verabbi, shello fasku meal shulchanam lo tzenon velo chazeret lo vimot hachamma velo vimot haggeshamim (avoda zara 11):
Ushene leummim. en leom ella malchut:
Mimmeayich yipparedu. min hammeayim hem nifradim ze lerisho veze letummo:
Milom yeematz. lo yishvu bigdulla, keshezze kam ze nofel, vechen hu omer immala hochorava (Yechezkel 26), lo nitmallea tzor ella mechurbanah shel yerushalayim:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai lah vegomer. mikra ze rabbu bo happerushim, veodennu bar netinat taam vetavlin bederech or yashar, vehu ki va lahashivah al chashashatah sheen heryonah mitkayyem lerov dachkam, vehodiah sibbat haddochak asher yidchaku ze et ze veyitatztzemu ze al ze, ki meshunne herayon ze mikkol herayon shebbaolam, ki kol herayon sheyyihye mishshenayim yihyu hashshenayim nochim vetivam shave, keamro (Shir HaShirim 7:4) "teome tzeviyya", veyaduru yachad babbeten, ma sheen ken heryonech. vehattaam hu ki shene goyim bevitnech, kol echad mehem hu bechinat goy echad, veod lahem shehem atzmam hem melachim umalchutam nimshechet leolam, vehu amro ushene leummim. vechol ze lo yesovev lehitrotzetz babbeten im hayu bemezeg echad keteva hatteomim, ella shehem meshunnim mitteva hatteomim, ki mehabbeten atzmo enam nochim ze laze umeshunne mizgam vetivam, vehu amro mimmeayich yipparedu, veamar mimmeayich velo amar bemeayich, lomar ki tamid hem meforadim vehatechalat happerud mimmeayim, uveemtzaut inyan ze hu hashshinnuy hammufla, lo letzad ki en bitnah rauy leherayon mitrotztzim habbanim.

Veamro uleom milleom vegomer. perush: od yesh lahem davar sheyyigrom harechakat hachanat hahitgorrut yachad, ki chol echad mehashshene melachim chazko veimmutzo hu milleom shekkenegdo, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Megila 6.) lo nitmallea tzor ella mechurbanah shel yerushalayim, vechevan shekkol echad mehem rotze bemappelet chavero kede sheyyigdal mimmennu, ze yarchik haachva vehatteum yachad.

Veamro verav vegomer. rabbu baze happerushim veen davar maspik baamittut hakkatuv. uledarkenu yavo al nachon, hakkavvana ba lomar ki millevad sheyyitgaddel echad bemappelet chavero gam tzarich hannofel lehishtabed lifne hammitgaddel mimmennu, velo day lo nefilato ureot tuvo beyad oyvo ella sheyyachof keagmon rosho leavdo, uvaze taflig harechakat haachva vetaatzumat hassina. veal ze neemar (ketuvot av:) en adam venachash darim bichfifa achat. vezot sibbat shinnuy haherayon. uchefi derech ze amro verav yaavod tzair en hakkavvana beamro rav vetzair beyichud al yaakov o al esav, ella al asher yihye rav bizmanno veal asher tzair bizmanno, kaftor vaferach.

rashi: Maggishim al mizbechi vegomer: vaamartem. kelomar, veim tomrun: "bamme gealnucha"? – gaalnu lecha et lechem mizbechecha. ani meshiv lachem, ki bezot gealtem oti beamrechem: "shulchan Adonai nivze hu". bozim hayu lachalok ish beachiv bammenachot uvakkodashim, veomer: meachar shehu asur lanu lachalok mincha keneged mincha vezevach keneged zevach, vetorach veamal hu lachalok kol mincha umincha bishvil kazzayit o kappol hammaggia lechol echad veechad.
targum: Mekarvin attun al madbechi karban merachek veim temrun bema merachek bidattun amrin patora dayya besir hu:

ohc: Vayyeshev yitzchak bigrar. lomar shekkiyyem maamar habbore baruch hu uvittel machshavto shekkadma lo.

rashi: Tachin bakkayitz lachmah agra vakkatzir maachalah. mezonah, kol achat veachat enah gozelet mechavertah:
targum: Metakna vekayta lachmah vegavsha vechatzda mechlah:

rashi: Hu yamut been musar. bishvil shello lakach musar:
targum: Hu yemut bela marduta uvesugee deshatyuteh nite:

rashi: Gadol shemi baggoyim. amru rabbotenu: dekaru leh elaha deelahayya. afillu mi sheyyesh lo avoda zara yodea (sheyyesh eloah) shehu al kullam. uvechol makom mitnaddevim lishmi, af haovde kochavim umazzalot. verabbotenu pershu: ellu talmide chachamim haoskim behilchot avoda bechol makom. vechen kol tefillot yisrael shemmitpallelin bechol makom, hare hen li kemincha tehora. vechen tirgem yonatan: "vechol iddan deattun avdin reuti, ani mekabbel tzelotchon, ushemi rabba mitkaddash al yedechon, utzelotchon kekarban dache kodamay". vechen perash hammikra: velamma attem mechallelin shemi? vahalo gadol hu baggoyim. vaani ahavati vechibbatti alechem, shebbechol makom sheattem mitpallelin lefanay, veaf baggola, muktar umuggash hu lishmi.
Umincha tehora. hu li, ki al yedchem shemi nora baggoyim, veattem mechallelin oti veet shemi.
targum: Are mimadnach shimsha vead maaleh rav shemi bene ammaya uvechol idan deattun avdin reuti ana akabbel tzelotchon ushemi rabba mitkadash al yedechon utzelutechon kekureban deche kodamay are rav shemi vene ammaya amar Adonai tzevaot:

rashi: Veachare chen yatza achiv vegomer. shamati mia haddorsho lefi peshuto, bedin haya ochez bo leakkevo, yaakov notzar mittippa rishona veesav min hashsheniyya; tze ulemad mishshefoferet sheppiha ketzara, ten lah shete avanim zo achar zo – hannichneset rishona tetze acharona vehannichneset acharona tetze rishona; nimtza esav hannotzar baacharona yatza rishon veyaakov shennotzar rishona yatza acharon, veyaakov ba leakkevo, sheyyehe rishon leleda kerishon litzira, veyiftor et rachmah veyittol et habbechora min haddin:
Baakev esav. siman sheen ze maspik ligmor malchuto ad shezze omed venotlah hemennu:
Vayyikra shemo yaakov. hakkabba; davar acher aviv kara lo yaakov al shem achizat heakev:

Ben shishshim shana. 10 shanim mishshennesaah ad shennaaset bat 13 shana ureuya leherayon, vey shanim hallalu tzafa vehimtin lah, kemo sheasa aviv lesara; kevan shello nitabbera, yada shehi akara, vehitpallel aleha (yevamot 64), veshifcha lo ratza lissa, lefi shennitkaddesh behar hammoriyya lihyot ola temima:
ohc: Vayyikra shemo yaakov. perush hakkadosh baruch hu, lo aviv, vehaed hanneeman amro "veyitzchak ben shishshim" vegomer, veim hu hakkore haya lo lomar "vehu ben shishshim" vegomer shebbo mishtae kera, vehaven:

rashi: Yehi mekorcha varuch usemach meeshet neurecha. hi hattora shellamadta minneurecha:
targum: Yeheve mabbuach berich vachadi min ittat talyutach:

rashi: Yihyu lecha levaddecha. atta levaddecha titkabbed bahem, velo yachalok acher immecha. lefi sheamar lemala pen yisbeu zarim kochecha, amar kan yihyu lecha levaddecha; umittoch kach:
targum: Yehevun lach lechodach venucherae la nishtattefun imach:

rashi: Vaytarevatzetzav. ad kan hammikra hazze omer darsheni, shessatam ma hi retzitza zo vechatav im ken lamma ze anochi? rabbotenu derashuhu leshon ritza; keshehayta overet al pitche tora shel shem vaever yaakov ratz umefarkes latzet, overet al petach avodat elilim, esav mefarkes latzet. davar acher mitrotztzim ze im ze umerivim benachalat shene olamot.
Vattomer im ken. gadol tzaar haibbur.
Lamma ze anochi. mitavva umitpallelet al herayon:
Vattelech lidrosh. levet midrasho shel shem:
Lidrosh et Adonai. sheyyaggid lah ma tehe besofah:
ohc: Vayyitrotztzu habbanim vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro vayyitrotztzu, gam amrah lamma ze anochi. verashi peresh: im ken gadol tzaar haibbur, lamma ze anochi mitavva umitpallelet al haherayon, ad kan. uferusho zichrono livracha en haddaat maskemet alav shettimas hatztzaddeket beherayonah letzad hatztzaar, gam bema nacha datah beemor lah haelohim "shene goyim" vegomer uvaze lo yusar tzaarah. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu derashot harebe, aval peshat hakkatuv lo noda. achen peshat hakkatuv hu vayyitrotztzu leshon ritztzutz, perush hayu nidchakim beyoter keshiur sheyyihyu mitrotztzim velo yitkayyemu bemeeha, veze yore ki heryonah eno mitkayyem. vattomer im ken lamma ze anochi perush 'ze more baetzba chozer el haherayon, lamma anochi hara larik yagati. vattelech lidrosh et Adonai perush levakkesh rachamim al kiyyum heryonah veladaat davar hassovev hefsedam, ki min hashshamayim lo yaasu nes lesheker, shettippaked bedavar sheeno mitkayyem. uleolam lo hikpida al tzaar haherayon, ki hatztzaddikim yisbelu tzaar gadol baolam hazze letachlit tov hannitzchi.

rashi: Al tered mitzrayma. shehaya dato laredet mitzrayma, kemo sheyyarad aviv bime haraav; amar lo: al tered mitzrayma, sheatta ola temima, veen chutza laaretz keday lecha:
ohc: Shechon baaretz asher vegomer. nitkavven lomar setam lekabbel alav imre kadosh el hammakom asher yomar elav, hagam sheyyihye hefech retzono, velittol sachar al haddavar, ki ratza hakkadosh baruch hu lezakkot yedidav. vechen hu omer (Bereshit 12:1) "el haaretz asher arekka", vesamuch hizkirah lo dichtiv (Bereshit 12:5) "lalechet artza kenaan".

rashi: Rao rainu. rainu veavicha, rainu vecha:
Tehi na ala benotenu vegomer. haala asher benotenu mime avicha tehi gam atta benenu uvenecha:
ohc: Vayyomru rao rainu vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar "rao" vegomer, gam shear haddikdukim?

Achen nitkavvenu lehashiv lechol ma sheyyisbol divre yitzchak beamro "maddua" vegomer, veamru letzad shekkavvanatcha kevar nishba lanu avicha "rao rainu" vegomer – shete reiyyot: haachat ki shevuat avraham en lismoch aleha mitteamim shekkatavnu lemala, od rainu ki beemtzautecha titkayyem hashshevua kiri mutzak.

Od rainu ki shevuat avicha lo dikdaknu lefiske dinim hammafsidim habberit, uchemo shekkatavnu lemala. gam im kavvanatcha lomar al asher lo halachnu leyishmael lichrot lanu berit, ki hu miyyorshe avicha vehu haggadol, rainu ki Adonai immach veze lecha haot ki havetachot avraham lecha hem netunim veatta haikkar bahem. gam im kavvanatcha likbol al asher herenu lecha sina bema sheshshillachnucha, rainu ki Adonai immach, uveerech adam kaze bechol makom sheholech shamma shamur umutzelach hu velo yishtanne lo hammakom beerko, veen kan sina.

Gam lema shettihye hahakpada al hammitgalle millevavenu ki lo nachon immach, vetomar ech tevakshu mimmenni tova, gam laze baa teshuva beamram rao rainu reiyya sichliyyit shezzulat ze lo titkayyem hashshevua benenu bechol tokef hammishpat, uchemo sheddikdeku bedivrehem kaasher avaer besamuch:

Vannomer tehi na vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro "vannomer" leshon avar. hitchilu latet taam laasher shelachuhu, ki kodem vehu immam bigrar lo tikkon hashshevua, al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha bindarim (daf 27) veze leshonam: nodrim leharagim vecharamim, uvet hillel omrim af bishvua. vechatav maharik besiman 232 veze leshono: hannoder o hannishba leannas lo have neder velo shevua vechulei vechoshev belibbo vechulei. ulefi ze kol hashshevua shettihye tachat yad annas yachol hannishba levattel belibbo, veyosef lefaro vetzidkiyyahu linvuchadnetztzar lo bittelu belibbam. vedin ze afillu kibbel hanaa mimmennu uvechol takfe chizzuke hashshevua kol sheyyad chazaka baemtza mevattel belibbo veen kan shevua, laze chashshu avimelech vechulei lichrot berit im yitzchak bigrar tachat memshalto, ki yachol yitzchak levattelah millibbo middin nishbain leannasin. laze nitchakkemu lichrot berit bammakom shehem bo atta shello hayta shelitat avimelech alav, vechen muchach middivre ramban. vehu amro tehi na perush: atta tihye haala velo bammetziut hakkodem, uvaze en lachush levittul hashshevua ballev. vetaam amram "ki atzamta mimmennu" vegomer, hu taam mushal, velo ratza legallot lo hattaam, o leval yaftzir bahem betzidde hattaam vechi yaspik bivrito sham vechaddome, gam hayu lahem teamim acherim kaasher avaer bedivrehem, laze amru lo taam muchlat.

Benotenu benenu uvenecha vegomer. taam sheheerich lomar benotenu vegomer, nitkavven lechazzek berit avraham ulehosif berit mechadash im yitzchak, vehakkavvana baze ladaat berit harishona shel avraham haim omedet lenes, veyesh baze tokef mishshevua shel yitzchak ki kevar niftar avraham veen metziut lehattaratah labbanim, ulekayyem kol davar nishba yitzchak battenaim asher yirshom. veulay ki chash avimelech gam ken sheyyitten Adonai mattana mechadash leyitzchak veyanchilenna leesav, veesav eno zaro shel avraham dichtiv (Bereshit 21:12) "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara" velo kol yitzchak, veim yitten yitzchak leesav eretz pelishtim lo yizke avimelech bedino im esav mitztzad berit avraham, ki yomar zo mattana chadasha natan Adonai leyitzchak achare mot avraham veyitzchak netanah leesav veen miyyado matztzil. laze nitchakkem lehashebia yitzchak, ushevuat yitzchak tachul gam al esav ki zaro yikkare hagam sheeno nikra zaro shel avraham. vetaam shello hizkir haddorot, kevar ramzu otam beamram benotenu vegomer ufershu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Rashi) shebbenotenu vegomer vesham neemar "li ulenini ulenechdi".

Od yirmoz beamro benotenu vegomer, perush sheyyihye habberit bifne rabbim, lo sheyyichrot berit laavimelech beno uveno, ella benehem yihyu kullam yachad, vehakkavvana baze kede sheyyihye bifne rabbim. veamru "benenu" od lirmoz shettihye hakkavvana al datam, kede sheyyihye al daat rabbim.

rashi: Chibbuk yadayim. hayyashen chovek yadav, avratzar belaaz:
targum: Kalil shinta kalil numeta kalil techabbak yedach lemadmecha:

rashi: Ki gadal meod. shehayu omrim zevel pirdotav shel yitzchak velo chaspo uzehavo shel avimelech (Bereshit Rabba):
Alechem. hakkohanim, ani metzavve hammitzva hazzot, shello takrivu elle al mizbechi.
targum: Uchean lechon tafkedta hada chahanaya:

rashi: Et birkat avraham. sheamar lo veeescha legoy gadol vehitbarchu vezaracha yihyu otan berachot amurot bishvilcha – mimmecha yetze oto haggoy veoto hazzera hamevorach:
Sittemum pelishtim. mippene sheamru takkala hem lanu mippene haggeyasot habbaot alenu, tammonun pelishtae leshon setima, uvilshon hattalmud metamtem et hallev:
ohc: Vechol habbeerot vegomer. samach hodaa zo levaykanu" vegomer, lomar ki lo yanuach shevet haresha al goral hatztzaddikim, vehodia shekkinu mimmennu, vehosif lehodia sheggam im avraham haya lahem kina vesina "vechol habbeerot asher" vegomer. veamro sittemum vaymalum afar velo hispik lomar milum afar, ulay ki achar mot avraham sittemum davka, asu avanim lefihem velo bittelum behechlet, veachar hakkina shekkinu beyitzchak vayyosifu lehareshia bekinatam vaymalum afar vehayu kelo hayu, velaze hutzrach yitzchak lachpor otam mechadash, keamro besamuch "vayyachpor et beerot" vegomer:

rashi: Vayyarach vegomer. vahalo en reach ra yoter mishshetef haizzim? ella melammed shennichnesa immo reach gan eden;
Kereach sade asher bercho Adonai. shennatan bo reach tov vezehu sede tappuchim, kach darshu razili:
ohc: Vayvarchehu vayyomer ree vegomer. amro ree lo leshon reiyya ella chashivut, vehakkavvana rauy hu reach beni vechashuv ledammoto kereach sade asher vegomer:

rashi: Vaamartem hinne mattelaa. behema kechusha, veanu aniyyim veen yecholet lehassig lemivchar nedarim. vechen tirgem yonatan: "ha deaytina meliutana".

Vehippachtem oto. zo achat mishshemone esre tevot shel tikkun sofrim. "hippachtem oto" – "oti" nichtav, ella shekkinna hakkatuv uchetavo "oto". "vehippachtem" vehidavtem – leshon "mappach nafesh" (Iyov 11:20).
Oti. veet shulchani.
targum: Veim temrun ha deaytena mileutana veshanektun yateh amar Adonai tzevaot umaytan attun daanis vedachagir vedimria umaytan attun leh bekurebana haakabbel yateh beraava miyedchon amar Adonai:

rashi: Gesha na vaamushcha. amar yitzchak belibbo en derech esav lihyot shem shamayim shagur befiv, veze amar ki hikra Adonai elohecha:
Vayyimleu yameha. aval betamar ketiv vayhi beet lidtah (Bereshit 38:27), shello malu yameha, ki lez chodashim yeladatam:
Vehinne tomim. chaser, uvetamar teomim male, lefi sheshshenehem tzaddikim; aval kan echad tzaddik veechad rasha:
Ki sifte chohen. alehem mutal lishmor daat. lamma? shehare tora yevakshu mippihu, shekkevar davar ze masur lahem: "yoru mishpatecha leyaakov" (Devarim 33:10).
Ki malach. shelucho shel hakkadosh baruch hu kemalache hashsharet, lesharet lefanav velikkanes lifnim bimchitzato.
targum: Are sifte chahen yitrun mada veoraa yivon mippumeh are meshamesh kodam Adonai tzevaot hu:

rashi: Hen gevir. beracha zo sheviit hi, vehu ose otah rishona? ella amar lo ma toelet lecha babberacha? im tikne nechasim, shello hem, shehare gevir samtiv lach, uma shekkana eved kana rabbo:
Ulecha afa ma eese. ayye efo avakkesh ma laasot lecha:
ohc: Vayyaan yitzchak. hinne adayin haya lo metziut levarcho, ella letzad shehikkir bo veyada ki hu rauy liklala veoyev leyaakov, chash levarcho ki hu hefech ma shekkadam lomar leyaakov "orrecha arur", velaze haya mitnatztzel meesav millevarcho. velaze kafal lomar hakkatuv "vayyaan vayyomer leesav", perush shemmaane ze eno ella lemor, veen ken hu haemet bedaat yitzchak.

rashi: Vayyazed. leshon bishshul, ketargumo:
Vehu ayef. birtzicha, kema detema ki ayfa nafshi lehorgim (Yirmeyahu 4) (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyazed yaakov. ulay ki letzad sheraa shehoila legimato shel esav leyitzchak, lakach gam hu derech levashshel tavshilin lekarev lev aviv elav keesav.

rashi: Hachayyim vehashshalom. shenneemar lefinchas "et beriti shalom" (Bamidbar 25:12), vehuvtach lo ulezaro acharav. hare sheyyehe zaro bachayyim.
Vaettenem lo. sheyyekabbelem bemora, vechen asa vayyiraeni.
Nichat. leshon 'chittat – nityare.
targum: Keyami hava imeh chaye ushelama veyahavat leh ulefan orayti shelim shemi dechil hu:

ohc: Vayyomer alehem yitzchak. tzarich ladaat ech yaane yitzchak lammelech vesarav "maddua batem elay", ki en ze mehammusar. veod, sof maasav hochichu hefech ze, ki karat lahem berit. od, achar sheamar "veattem senetem oti", ma makom lehaarich lomar "vatteshallechuni" vegomer. veim hochacha lassina hu omer "vatteshallechuni", haya lo lomar "ki shillachtem oti" vegomer.

Achen kavvanat yitzchak hi lema shehiskil ki en metziut sheyyitztarech avimelech leyitzchak beshum ofen, zulat beinyan pachdo al nachalato leval yishlechu yad bah letzad mattenat haadon. vedavar ze kevar nishba avraham, uchemo shehikshenu bimkomo lamma halach elav, veyitzchak haya libbo shalem leval yarea et habberit asher karat et avraham aviv, ki pasak halacha keharambam shekkol shennadar al daat chavero tzarich lehattiro befanav, perush bidiato. veavraham kevan shello hittir bifne avimelech hashshevua kiri mutzak (Iyov 37:18), sheen habbanim yecholin lehattirah od. umeatta en tzorech lahem mimmennu, uvivchina zo amar "maddua batem", ella vadday sheen bia zo ella letzarche yitzchak lehetiv libbo velahashivo el hammakom. laze amar tevat elay, perush veim habbia hi letzarki gam aleha ani dan ki zo rechoka hi mehaamin ki "attem" vegomer. dikdek lomar veattem lomar millevad kol anshe hair gam hammelech vesarav senetem oti, vesina zo enah teluya bedavar, ella letzad shekkinnetem bi velo yechaltem lehanniach oti immachem bair, vehu amro vatteshallechuni vegomer. vezo sina mechamat kina. vehinne yadua hu ki chol sina shehi teluya bedavar batel davar vechulei, aval sina mechamat kina enah betela olamit, zulat behibbatel haddavar shebbeemtzauto hayta hakkina. umeatta lo yishtanne haddaat bachem lehasir sinatchem mimmenni.

rashi: Er veone. er battalmidim, veone bachachamim. "er" – leshon 'adam charif.
Umaggish mincha. veim kohen hu, lo yihye lo ben maggish mincha.
targum: Yeshetze Adonai ligvar deyabedinah bar uvar var mikirve yaakov veim kahen hu la yehe leh makriv kurebana bevet makdesha dayya tzevaot:

rashi: Vekach li. mishshelli hem veenam gezel, shekkach katav lah yitzchak bichtubbatah littol shene gedaye izzim bechol yom (Bereshit Rabba):
Shene gedaye izzim. vechi shene gedaye izzim haya maachol shel yitzchak? ella haechad hikriv lefischo vehaechad asa matammim; befirke rabbi eliezer:
Kaasher ahev. ki taam haggedi ketaam hatztzevi:
Hael. kemo haelle:
ohc: Ki lecha ulezaracha vegomer. eretz pelishtim bichlal netinat haaretz hi, velaze gam ken hiskim ramban, veamro lecha havetacha zo ulay shehi al ma shehitzliach hu sham dichtiv (Bereshit 26:12) "vayyizra yitzchak baaretz hahi" vegomer. od nitkavven lomar lo sheyyizke hu bah lezera. veulay ki lo hechezik avraham beeretz pelishtim bachazaka harishona, laze ratza Adonai sheyyachazik yitzchak bah, vehu hechezik bah bachazaka meulla shecharash vezara, velaze dikdek Adonai bidvarav lomar "et kol haaratzot hael".

Od nitkavven lehaveticho ki en leyishmael chelek venachala behavetachot avraham, zulat leyitzchak levad, vehu amro lecha. vedikdek lomar ulezaracha lishlol chelek mibbanav, ki davka oto shennikra zaro, dichtiv (Bereshit 21:12) "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara" (nedarim lo.) velo kol yitzchak:

rashi: Vaohav et yaakov. latet lo et "eretz chemda tzevi tzivot goyim" (Yirmeyahu 3:19) – eretz shetztzavin kol tzivot haovde kochavim umazzalot bah.
targum: Rechimet yatchon amar Adonai veim temrun bema rechimtana hala ach esav leyaakov amar Adonai urechimat yat yaakov:

rashi: Vehitbarchu vezaracha. adam omer livno yehe zaracha kezaro shel yitzchak, vechen bechol hammikra, veze av lechullan becha yevarech yisrael lemor yesimcha vegomer (Bereshit 48:20); veaf leinyan hakkelala matzinu chen vehayta haishsha leala (Bamidbar Adonai), shehamekallel sono omer tehe kiflonit, vechen vehinnachtem shimchem lishvua livchiray (Yeshayahu 65), shehannishba omer ehe chifloni im asiti kach vechach:

ohc: Mot yumat. perush: "mot" bide shamayim, "yumat" bide adam. vedikdek lomar hannogea, lomar afilu bederech sheeno neherag al eshet ish divne noach, yehareg al zot, uchemo shekkatavnu bemaase sara befarashat vayyera (Bereshit 20:4).

rashi: Beni im aravta. arevut mamon kemashmao, pershu rabbotenu (bava batra 173:):
targum: Beri in arevta lechavrach ashlemta lenucheraa yedach:

rashi: Admoni. siman hu sheyyehe shofech damim (Bereshit Rabba):
Kullo keadderet sear. male sear ketallit shel tzemer hamelea sear, palevakeydea 109:
Vayyikreu shemo esav. hakkol karu lo chen, lefi shehaya naase venigmar bisaro cheven shanim harebe:
Vearoti. vekillalti et birchotechem – ma shetztzarich levarech lachem: haddagan, vehattirosh, vehayyitzhar.
Vegam arotiha. uveemet en litlot haddavar al tenay shettaliti beim lo yishma", ki yadati shello tishmeu. lefichach ani meatta arotiha.
targum: Im la tekabbelun veim la teshavun dechalti al libba lemittan yekara lishmi amar Adonai tzevaot veeshlach bechon yat meerta veelot yat birchatchon veaf alutineh are letchon meshavyan dechalti al libba:
Ulema teshargeg beri benuchereta of la techabbek uva (73 chuva) deacharayta:
Veattun setitun min orcha atkaltun sagiin beorayta chabbaltun keyama deim levi amar Adonai tzevaot:
La titten shinta leaynach venemta ligvinayich:
Veaf ana yehavet yatchon besirin vechalashin lechol ama kema deletechon natrin yat orchan detaknan kodamay venasvin appin beorayta:
Ad ma leemat ant damich ant atla uleemat kaymat min shintach:

bart: Nechasim yeduim labbaal unechasim sheen yeduim. it dimfarshim nechasim yeduim, mekarkee. vesheen yeduim, mittaltele. veit deamre, ellu vaellu yeduim hem. veellu hem sheenam yeduim, kol shehi yoshevet kan venaflu lah nechasim bimdinat hayyam. ufesak hahalacha, ben nechasim shennaflu lah ad shello titares uven shennaflu lah mishshennitarsa, im machra otam achar shennisset, habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot perot bechayyeha, veguf hakkarka leachar mitatah. vahalacha kerabbi shimon shecholek ben nechasim hayeduim labbaal linchasim sheenam yeduim:
Et sheddarko lehimmaded bedakka umedado vegassa. garsinan:
Tefela dakka laggassa. ufatur keshehu mocher begassa, velo amrinan kevan dedarko lamod baddakka chayyav af keshemmoded baggassa:
Uvelach dinar. midda sheyyesh bah ma shehu shave dinar. lefi shello hayta midda yedua lallach, shehashshaar mishtanne tamid, lechach shiaru vedamim:
Achsara. lo vemidda velo vemishkal ella lefi haomed, patur, dahave kemocher begassa. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Chenvanit. limkor veliknot bechanut:
Appotroppa. lehitassek bemamono velissa velitten:
Mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze. shevua keen shel tora al taanat shemma, veyachol legalgel aleha shello asta onaa al pilkah veal issatah:
Rabbi eliezer omer. afillu lechattechilla shello al yede gilgul yachol lehashebiah al pilkah veal issatah. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Palter. hu hallokeach min hannachtomim kikkarot harebe bevat achat umochran acher kach bashshuk echad echad:

Measser mikkol defus udefus divre rabbi meir. disvira leh lerabbi meir palter mittere telata nachtome zevan, veanu omrim defus ze kana minnachtom echad vehashsheni minnachtom acher. verabbi yehuda savar palter mechad nachtom zevan, veaf al pi shehem mishshene defusim kullan minnachtom echad hen, hilkach im kullan mishshel emesh o mishshel hayyom measser meechad al hakkol, kedin nachtom:
Manpol. kone min palterin harebe umocher laacherim, vechevan shehu ragil liknot meanashim harebe hallokeach mimmennu measser al kol echad veechad. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo timkor. yechola hi leakkev. vehilchata kevateh:
Rabbi yehuda omer lo timkor. vehilchata kevateh:
Kima. davar muat vaafillu kol shehu:

Yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol. ushevua zo keen shel tora hi, vehanne mile, shehaya hashshevach keneged hahotzaa o yoter, aval im hayta hahotzaa yetera al hashshevach yishshava shevuat hattora shehotzi keneged hashshevach, veyittol keneged hashshevach bilvad vehashshear yafsid. vechol ze kesheggershah habbaal, aval im marda hi, ben achal habbaal ben lo achal, yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol keneged hashshevach. uvenichse tzon barzel, kol hashshevach shel baal, deamrinan im hosifu hosifu lo:
Velo benichse haem. nichse melog shel haem. dichtiv (Devarim 21) ki hu reshit ono lo mishpat habbechora, mashma deaddideh kae, kelomar binchasav mishpat habbechora velo benichse ishto:

Veeno notel pi shenayim bashshevach. im hishbichu hannechasim leachar mitat haav kodem shechalku, en habbechor notel pi shenayim bashshevach. ella shamin et hannechasim ma hen shavin bishat mitat avihen, vehabbechor notel pi shenayim bahen bilvad, shenneemar (sham) bechol asher yimmatze lo, laav bishat mita:
Barauy. binchasim shello haya avihen muchzak bishat mitato aval reuyin hayu lippol lo birushsha venaflu lahen leachar zeman, en habbechor notel bahen pi shenayim:

Velo haishsha bichtubbatah. bashshevach shehishbichu. im en shavin hannechasim bishat mitat balah kede shiur ketubbatah veachar kach hishbichu, enah notelet ketubbatah ella kamma shehayu shavin. veaf al gav divalma baal chov gove hashshevach, mikkulle ketubba shanu kan. vechen enah notelet barauy kevammuchzak:

Velo habbanot. notlot mezonot leachar mitat avihen bitnay ketubba, uvenan nukevin di yehevyayn lichi minnay yehevyayn yatvan beveti umittazzenan minnichsay, lo min hashshevach shehishbichu hannechasim velo min harauy lavo leachar mita. kevan dimzonot habbanot mittenae ketubba hen kakketubba damu:

Velo hayyavam. hannotel chelek hammet sheyyibbem et ishto, eno notel chelek achiv lo min hashshevach velo min harauy lavo. may taama, divchor karye rachmana (Devarim 25), vehaya habbechor asher teled, kabbechor, ma bechor eno notel bashshevach velo barauy lavo, af yavam en notel lo bashshevach velo barauy lavo:

Vechullan enan notlin bashshevach. hadar tana leh, laatoye shevacha demimmela, kegon tevua shehayta shachat keshemmet aviv veachshav naasu shibbolim, o temarim semadar venaasu achshav temarim gedolim. dei meresha, hava amena ki en bechor notel pi shenayim bashshevach hane mille bashshevach shettarach bo achiv kegon zibbul sadot vekishkush veiddur:

Velo varauy kevammuchzak. laatoye im haya avi avihem chay bishat mitat avihem vehayu nechasim reuyim lippol lahem kesheyyamut, af al gav devadday atidim lippol lahem vaafillu yesh lo ben acher yittelu ellu chelek avihen, vesalka datach amena dichmuchzak dame, kamashma lan. dei meresha, hava amena rauy dekatane resha sheen habbechor notel bo, kegon shennaflu lahen nichse achi avihen shello hayu lo banim bishat mitat avihen, veen reuyin ella missafek deshemma lo yihye lo zera:

Hakkol maarichin. hakkol laatoye ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad velo hevi shete searot, shehu maarich. vehu mufla hassamuch leish. umufla ikkere leh lefi shebbodkim oto im yodea lehafelot ulefaresh leshem mi nadar uleshem mi hikdish. af al gav deish ki yafli chetiv (Vayikra 27), keshehu samuch lefirko karuy ish leinyan ze. vehakkol dekae nammi al neerachim, laatoye menuvval umukke shechin, sheen shavin damim, desalka datach amena neder beerkecha ketiv (sham), kol sheyyeshno vedamim yeshno vaarachin, vechol sheeno vedamim eno vaarachin, kamashma lan. vehakkol dekae al nodrim, mishshum niddarim nakat leh. veniddarim gufeh itzterich, laatoye pachut mibben chodesh shehu niddar af al pi sheeno neerach:
Maarichin. im amar al echad, erech peloni alay, noten erech oto peloni kefi shanav kemo shekkatzuv befarashat arachin, shehaerech noten lefi shanim shel neerachin:
Veneerachin. im amar acher alav erech peloni ze alay, o amar hu atzmo erki alay:
Nodrim. amar deme peloni alay, tzarich sheyyitten kemo shehu yafe limmacher bashshuk:
Veniddarin. amar acher alav deme peloni alay, o amar hu atzmo damay alay:

Kohanim uleviyyim. kohanim itztericha leh leashmeinan deneerachin, desalka datach amena hoil uchetiv (sham) veheemido lifne hakkohen veheerich oto hakkohen, yisrael lifne chohen velo chohen lifne chohen, hilkach kohen leteh baarachin, dei ani hu lo karena beh veheemido lifne hakkohen, kamashma lan dechohanim itanhu vetorat arachin. veayde ditnan kohanim, tenan leviyyim veyisreelim:
Nashim vaavadim. vehaishsha meshallemet keshettitalmen o titgaresh, vehaeved kesheyyishtachrer:
Tumtum veanderoginos nodrim veniddarim. shehare yesh lahem damim:
Umaarichin. et acherim, im amru erech peloni alay, notnim erech oto peloni:
Aval lo neerachin. im amar erki alay, o amar acher alehem erech peloni alay, lo amar kelum. dezachar unekeva amurim befarashat arachin, ad sheyyihye zachar vaddai o nekeva vaddait:
Pachut mibben chodesh niddar. im amar damav alay. shehare shave damim kol shehen:
Aval lo neerach. shello neemar erech bapparasha ella mibben chodesh vamala:
Hannachtomim. nachtom chaver shellakach tevua meam haaretz shehi demay lo chiyyevu oto chachamim lehaferish:

Ella chede terumat maaser. shehi echad mimmea, aval lo maaser sheni, mittoch sheshshotre hammelech venogsav chovtim otam bechol shaa veomrim lahem michru bezol lo hitrichu alehem chachamim bemaaser sheni shettarcho merubbe shetztzarich leachlo birushalayim. vedavka keshemmocher lechaver, shehallokeach yafrish maaser sheni, aval im mocher leam haaretz chayyav lehaferish maaser sheni kodem sheyyimkor:

Hachenvanim. shemmochrim meat meat bechanut, enan rashshain limkor et haddemay, hoil vehen mistakkerim harebe, alehem muttal letakken. i nammi mippene shergilin limkor letinokot, shello yochlu hattinokot davar sheeno metukkan:
Kol hammashpiim. shemmochrim beshefa harebe beyachad:
Bemidda gassa. lekamman mefaresh kamma hi midda gassa:

Rashshain limkor et haddemay. derech hammochrim harebe beyachad lehosif al hammidda, ulechach nikreu mashpiim, sheosin midda gedusha umosifim al hammiddot. umishshum hachi lo hittilu alehem lehaferish et haddemay, ella al hallokeach mehem:
Sitonot. hem hassocharim haggedolim hakkonim tevua mibbaale hattevua umochrim otah lachenvanim bemidda gassa:
Eno neeman. daafillu yimmatze shellakach mimmi sheeno neeman matze leishtammute velomar beenay haya neeman. aval ki amar leh meish peloni lo matze leishtamote deha eno rashshay likkach meacher:
Lihyot neeman. al hammaasrot velo yihyu perotav demay mikkan veelach:
Et shehu lokeach. al menat limkor, deillu al menat leechol ha tana resha measser et shehu ochel:
Veet shehu mocher. mipperot karkeotav:
Al atzmo eno neeman. shehare hu ochel davar sheeno metukkan keshehu mitareach etzel am haaretz. verabbi yehuda savar sheeno mafsid neemanuto bechach. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

En baarachin pachut missela. afillu ani sheheerich veen yado masseget eno niddon befachut missela, dichtiv (Vayikra 27) vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh, kol arachin sheatta maarich lo yihyu pechutim mishshekel:
Velo yoter al chamishshim. dezehu gadol shebbaarachim dichtive bapparasha:
Natan sela veheeshir. ben esrim sheerko chamishshim vehaya ani venatan sela beerko, deani niddon behassagat yado, veheeshir, patur:
Pachot missela. natan pachot missela:
Veheeshir noten chamishshim. devintina kammayta lo yatza yede erko vaadayin erko alav:
Hayu veyadav chamesh selaim. ani ben esrim sheheerich atzmo, vehayu lo chamesh selaim:
Rabbi meir omer eno noten ella echat. desavar rabbi meir o noten kol hachamishshim shealav o eno noten ella shekel:

Vachachamim omrim noten kol ma shebbeyado. dikra dichtiv vechol erkecha yihye beshekel, lappachut shebbaarachin hu daata, sheafillu ani shebbaaniyyim lo yitten pachot. umihu hecha deit leh tefe yahev, dichtiv (sham) al pi asher tassig. vahalacha kachachamim:
En petach battoa pachut mishshiva. ayde deayre veen baarachin pachut velo yoter, tana nammi lechol hanach deit behu en pachut velo yoter:

Petach. techillat niddut. sheddin nidda deorayta hu. im hitchila veraata hayyom, mona shishsha vehu. raata shenayim, mona chamishsha vehem. raata shelosha, mona arbaa vehem. [vaafillu] raata chol shiva ufaska laerev, tovelet umeshammeshet. umiyyom shevii vaelach havyan yeme ziva achad asar yom, sheim raata vahen yom echad o shenayim shomeret yom keneged yom vetovelet. veim raata vahen shelosha retzufim, haveya zava gedola shetteuna shiva nekiyyim vekarban. veim mashchu yeme ziva chodesh o shana, enah chozeret litchillat niddut ad shetteshev shiva nekiyyim. uchesheyyashva shiva nekiyyim veraata, haveya techillat nidda umona shishsha vehu, vechozeret leinyanah kechol hameforash. veim lo raata veotan achad asar yom shelosha retzufim, enah zava. ucheshettire acharehen, ben shehi roa samuch ben shehirchika reiyyatah have techillat nidda. vaafillu tire shelosha retzufim, enah mona ella arbaa vehem, sheen yeme zov ella otan achad asar yom shebben sof niddut ze litchillat niddut habba:

En petach battoa pachut mishshiva. toa [sheraata] hayyom veenah yodaat im bime niddutah omedet, o veotan achad asar yom shel yeme zov, enah chozeret lefetach niddutah befachot mishshiva nekiyyim velo yoter al shiva asar nekiyyim. ketzad, toa sheamra yom echad tame raiti hayyom, veenah yodaat im bime niddut hi utzericha limnot shishsha vehu, im beotan achad asar yom shel yeme ziva veenah tzericha lishmor, ella yom keneged yom, pitchah shiva asar, sheim lo tire ad leachar shiva asar yom levad miyyom ze, chozeret lefetach niddutah. deim yom ze sheraata techillat yeme ziva hu, kevan shekkalu achad asar shalmu yeme ziva vehirchika reiyyatah shello raata ad leachar shiva asar utechillat nidda hi. vaafillu im tomar sheyyom ze techillat nidda hu, af al pi chen yatzta mime hazzov lesof yom shiva asar levad miyyom ze. aval im tire yom shiva asar lo yatza min hassafek im yom nidda hu o yom ziva hu, deyesh lomar shemma yom ze sheraata techillat yeme nidda hava, veyom shiva asar sheraata bo, sof achad asar shebben nidda lenidda hu, o shemma yom rishon mime hazzov hu, ucheshekkalu achad asar yatzta mime hazzov, veyom shiva asar sheraata vo techillat nidda hi. vechol shekken im tire kodem yom shiva asar, shello yatza min hassafek. vechol zeman shettehe bisfekah zo, mekulkelet hi, shelleolam nachmir aleha missafek. shekkeshettire yom echad, nomar techillat nidda hi utzericha shishsha vehu. ucheshettire shelosha retzufim, nomar yeme zov hen utzericha shiva nekiyyim vekarban. aval leachar shiva asar en lehachamir, devadday techillat nidda hi, vaafillu tire shelosha yamim retzufim timne arbaa vehem vetovelet utehora:
En bannegaim pachut mishshavua echad. lehesger. deyesh benige adam shennivrarim leshavua echad im letaher im lachlot:

Velo yoter al shelosha shavuot. nige vattim. detanya vetorat kohanim, minnayin sheim amad beenav beshavua rishon uveshavua sheni shecholetz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua shelishi, talmud lomar (Vayikra 14) uva hakkohen veim bo yavo kulei:
Haishsha. ad shello titares. venitarsa:
Bet shammay omrim timkor. beodah arusa, aval mishshennisset lo:
Hoil vezacha vaishsha. shehi arusato:
Lo yizke vannechasim. bitmiha:

Al hachadashim. shennaflu lah mishshennisset anu voshin ma rau chachamim lomar im machra venatna habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot, ella sheattem megalgelim alenu nechasim shennaflu lah beodah arusa lomar sheim machra michrah batel lefi shezzacha vahem habbaal:

Ish peloni neeman hare ze neeman. af al gav delo haya rauy lehaamino kevan shehu atzmo chashud, kulla hi shehekellu beachsenay mishshum chayye nefesh. vedavka kesheen makkir adam sham aval im makkir adam sham, lo yittol ella min hammumche:

Mi kan mocher yashan. sheyyare shemma yaachiluhu chadash kodem sheyyikrav haomer. verov amme haaretz en chashudim al hechadash vahave kidmay derov amme haaretz measserim hen, hilkach lo hechmiru alehen kol kach denema shehem gomlim chesed ze laze, taid atta alay vaani aid alecha:
En tzarich likrot shem lemasar ani shel demay. delo nechshedu amme haaretz al masar ani, shehem yodim shepperot hattevulim lemasar ani hem bemita, umafrishim oto velokchim oto leatzman:
Vachachamim omrim. af al pi chen kore lo shem, shehare eno mafsid kelum baze, deeno tzarich lehaferish velitten leani mishshum deani have baze motzi mechavero vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya:
Lo yatznia ad sheyyeasser. deasur lehotzi miyyado davar sheeno metukkan:
Shello yovedu. velo nitkavven lizkot bahen:
Sheen adam rashshay lemachro demay. kegon bemidda dakka deamrinan befirkin dilel:
Lo yishlach lachavero demay. bedakka, aval sholeach lo begassa kevan sherashshay lemachro begassa:
Rabbi yose mattir. lishloach lachavero vadday afillu bedakka, uvilvad sheyyodio. umode rabbi yose shebbidmay asur bedakka. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Kimlo regel behema roa. kemo sheyyecholot lehishtammer beroe echad keshehabbehemot root mitrachakot zo mizzo. vehayenu shesh esre mil, divhachi shalta ena deroe. veim yesh lo chamesh behemot bichfar ze vechamesh bichfar acher rachok ze mizze shesh esre mil, mevian letoch dir echad umeasseran. veim rechokot yoter, peturot. deamar kera (yirmeya log) taavorna hatztzon al yede mone, mashma im yecholot lehimmanot beroe echad mikkere tzon, vetaavorna tachat hashshevet lehitasser, vei lo lo:

Sheloshim ushenayim mil enan mitztarfin. mishshum devae lematne besamuch sheim haya lo eder beemtza, otan haemtzaiyyot metzarfot et hatztzedadim, lehachi tane sheim hatztzedadim rechokot zo mizzo sheloshim ushenayim mil en haemtzai metzarfan:
Mevi umeasseran baemtza. lav [mevi] baemtza mammash kaamar:
Hayyarden mafsik. sheim hayu lo chamesh behemot mikkan vechamesh behemot mikkan veyarden beemtza, en mitztarfin ufeturot. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Mi shehaya. yorshe harishona kodmim leyorshe hashsheniyya. im metu nashav acharav ad shello hispiku ligbot:

Sheniyya veyorsheha kodmim. shehi baalat chov, veyorshe rishona baim lirash meavihen ketubbat benin dichrin, deha inun yirtun tenan, lefichach porin et hachov techilla, uma shennishar yirshu. vedavka keshennishbea hashsheniyya al ketubbatah, az hi o yorsheha notlim ketubbatah. aval im meta hi leachar shemmet balah velo nishbea al ketubbatah, en yorsheha notlim kelum mikketubbatah, dekayma lan en adam morish shevua levanav, kelomar mamon sheen adam zoche vo ella vishvua umet kodem shennishba, oto mamon en adam morisho levanav:
Halcha mikkever balah. zo sheppetarah balah min hashshevua:
Levet aviha. shello nitasseka shuv bannechasim:

En hayyorshim mashbiin otah. bema shennitasseka ben mita likvura. sheim hayu yorshim yecholim lehashebiah al kach, mittoch shehi tzericha lehavi edim bema shehi mocheret vekona letzorech kevurat hammet, yishhe hammet veyitnavvel:
Al heatid lavo. shello ikkeva veyadeha kelum min haesek shennaaset appotroppa alav leachar kevurat balah, delo mahanya veh petur dideh, shehare hannechasim shel yetomim hem:
Al sheavar. al esek shebbechayye valah:
Kol nechasav. sheyyarash meachiv, acharain lichtubbatah:
Gershah en lah ella ketubbata. aval kol zeman shello geresh hayu chol hannechasim meshubadim lah:

Hare hi kechol hannashim. shehamegaresh et ishto umachazirah, al menat ketubba harishona hechezirah. veitzterich leashmoinan ha bivama, delo tema ishto hi deihu katav lah ketubba mimmamono, aval yevimto delav ihu katav lah ella nichse valah harishon hu dahavu acharain vearvain, hecha degershah veahderah. ema ketubbatah minneh, kamashma lan:
Ledir. makom mukkaf avanim o kanim shemmachnisim bo hatztzon:
Haya lo mea venatal asara. belo shum minyan:
O asara venatal echad. belo minyan:
En ze maaser. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) haasiri yihye kodesh, veen ze asiri:

Rabbi yose verabbi yehuda omer hare ze maaser. desavar rabbi yose keshem shetteruma gedola uterumat maaser nittalim beomed uvemachashava dichtiv (Bamidbar 18), venechshav lachem terumatchem, bemachashava haveya teruma, kach maaser nittal beomed uvemachashava, demaaser teruma karye rachmana, dichtiv (sham) ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai‏ teruma. veittakkash maasar behema lemaasar dagan, ma maasar dagan nittal bammachashava, af maasar behema nittal bammachashava. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Kafatz achad min hammenuyin. shemmana asara sheyyatzu min happetach venatal haasiri venifteru hattisha, vekafatz echad min hattisha letoch haddir. kol otan shebbaddir peturim, im eno nikkar eze hu. deshemma ze yatza asiri vehu eno rauy lechach shekkevar niftar. i nammi kol echad mehen safek im hu manuy kevar veniftar, vechol sefeka lav bar issure hu:

Min hameussarim. min haasiriyyim shekkevar kadshu, kafatz echad letoch haddir, havu kullehu sefek maaser veyiru ad sheyyistaavu, dechol zeman shehen temimim asur leshachtan bachutz. uleachar sheyyistaavu yeachelu bemuman labbealim:

Hakkol nichnas laddir lehitasser. hakkol laatoye rovea venirba umuktze shehifrishuhu lehakerivo laavoda zara, veneevad sheavdu habbehema atzmah, veetnan zona umechir kelev vetumtum veanderoginos. shekkol ellu af al pi shehem pesulim lekarban nichnasin laddir lehitasser, dechevan delo hikpida tora bevaal mum legabbe maaser kedichtiv (Vayikra 27) lo yevakker ben tov lara, lo hikpida nammi bechol hanach pesulin:

Chutz min hakkilayim vehatterefa veyotze dofen kulei. detanu rabbanan, shor o chesev (sham 22), perat lechilayim, dehaynu habba mittayish verachel. o ez, perat lenidme, shebba meayil verachel vedome leez. ki yivvaled, perat leyotze dofen. vehaya shivat yamim, perat limchussar zeman. tachat immo, perat leyatom shemmeta immo kesheyyeladattu. dechol hane pesulim lakkadashim. umaasar behema yalef mikkadashim bigzera shava, neemar kan (sham 27) tachat hashshavet, veneemar lehallan tachat immo. ma lehallan perat lechol hashshemot hallalu, af kan perat lechol hashshemot hallalu. uterefa nammi enah nichneset laddir lehitasser, dichtiv (sham) kol asher yaavor, perat litrefa sheenah overet, kegon shenechtechu ragleha min haarkubba ulemala, shehi achat min hattarfuyyot, vehu haddin lechol shear mine tarfuyyot:
Vehashshelach kayyam. haor kayyam. targum vehifshit, veyashlach:

En ze yatom. lefi sheyyesh mekomot shekkeshehabbehema meta mechamat leda mafshitin otah umalbishim beora et hachayya [et] havvalad kede sheyyitchammem, umealle leh keillu hayta immo chayya. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Hotzia get veen immo chetubba. bimkom sheen kotvim ketubba vesomchim al tenay vet din:
Gova chetubbatah. ditnay chetubba maase vet din hu, vechol maase vet din keman denaket shetara dame. vedavka mane matayim hu degavya, aval tosefet en lah ad shettotzi shetar ketubba:

Perozbul. hillel tikken perozbul kede shello tashmet sheviit, shemmoser shetarotav levet din sheyyigbe min hallove chovo kol zeman sheyyitbeennu, dehashta lo karena veh lo yiggos, sheeno tovo chelum ella bet din tovin:
Hare ellu lo yippareu. chayshinan shemma kevar gavta chetubbatah, veze hishmitato sheviit:
Min hassakkana. sheggazru goyim al hammitzvot vehayu yereim lishmor gittehen, umishshekkibbelato sorafto. vechen perozbulehen:

Hallokeach min hannachtom. keshehannachtom mocher bemidda gassa hallokeach mimmennu chayyav letakken ma shehu lokeach, vehannachtom patur. veha ditnan leel beferek 2‏ shehannachtomim chayyavim lehaferish kede shiur terumat maaser vechalla, hatam mayre bemocher bemidda dakka, shemmippene shehu mistakker harebe hittilu alav leasser, i nammi mippene hattinokot shellokchim mimmi shemmocher bedakka kede shello yochlu tevalim hittilu alav letakken. midda gassa vedakka meforashim leel sof perek 2:

Notel kede terumat maaser. dehaynu echad mimmea, uchede challa echad mearbaim ushemona. velo sheyyafrisham min hakkikkar shellakach min hannachtom, ella kovea lahem makom umannicham mechubbarim bimkomam:
Echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan. mikkol ma sheyyesh kan mashma, af im kede shiur challa shehifrish, asuy maaser, venimtza mafrish maaser af min hachalla:
Ushear maaser. dehaynu od tisha samuch lo, hare kava makom lechol hammaaser, veoto haechad shekkarati lo shem maaser techilla asuy terumat maaser al hattisha hassemuchim lo:
Vehashshear challa. echad mearbaim ushemona shehifrashti challa:
Umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo. kovea lo makom veachar kach mechallelo, veeno tzarich lehosif chomesh:
Achat bikkera veachat shello vikkera vechulei. en kan lakkohen kelum. deyesh lomar hammevakkeret yalda hannekeva:
Met habben betoch sheloshim yom. abbechorot vaddain dealma kae:
Yachazir. denefel hava. velo michayyav befidyon ad leachar sheloshim yom:

Met beyom sheloshim kayyom shellefanav. veaf al pi shennatan lo yachazir. degamrinan chodesh chodesh mimmidbar, ketiv hacha (Bamidbar 18 16) ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde, uchetiv bammidbar (Bamidbar 3 40) pekod kol bechor zachar mibben chodesh vamala, demashma leachar sheloshim:

Rabbi akiva omer im natan lo yittol. mesappeka leh lerabbi akiva miditzterich lemichtav vamala gabbe arachin, velo gamrinan mimmidbar, havu lehu shene ketuvim habbaim keechad veen melammedim, hilkach im natan lo yittol, veim lo natan lo yitten, dehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vahalacha kachachamim:
Bechezkat shello nifda. dela avid eynish defarek toch sheloshim:
Leachar sheloshim bechezkat shennifda. dechohen [have motzi mechavero vehura kocho]:

Hu kodem livno. hakkol modim kol hecha delet leh ella chamesh selaim hu kodem et beno, demitzva dideh adif. ki pelige deikka chamesh selaim mimmeshabede vechamesh bene chore, rabbi yehuda savar milve hakketuva battora kichtuva bishtar damya, vechamesh selaim dideh deichayyav behu avuha azel kohen vetaref mimmeshabedi, shehare shibudo shel kohen kadem. vehayenu dekaamar shemmitzvato al aviv, kelomar shemmeaviv nishtabedu hannechasim. uvehane chamesh bene chore parek livreh miyyad, dei yehev bene chore mishshum pidyon dideh, tu lo mifrik beno, deshemma shibud hallakochot kodem leledat beno. verabbanan savre milve hakketuva battora lav kichtuva bishtar damya, vei yahev bene chore bishvil beno tu lo mifrik ihu, dechohen lo matze taref millakochot, hilkach mitzva dideh adif. vahalacha kachachamim:
Shennoldu vo mumin. mishshennesaah:
Mumin gedolim. nismet eno niktea yado nishbera raglo. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, vaafillu bemumin gedolim en kofin oto lehotzi:
Hachammarim. hammeviim tevua mimmekom hazzol limkom hayyoker:
En neemanim. devadday gomlim ze et ze umeshabbeach shel chavero beir zo kede sheyyeshabbach chavero et shello beir acheret:
Rabbi yehuda omer neemanim. hoil verov amme haaretz measserim hen, bidmay hekellu mishshum chayyehen shel bene hair, sheyyihyu mochre tevua uferot regilin lavo sham. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Hakkotev leishto din udevarim en li vinchasayich. beodah arusa kotev lah, lichshettinnasi li din udevarim en li vinchasayich. af al gav delo kanu minneh, mocheret venotenet umichrah kayyam, shennachala habbaa laadam mimmakom acher, adam matne aleha shello yirashenna. vei kanu minneh, afillu leachar shennisset michrah kayyam, aval perot ochel, veim meta yorshah, dehachi mashma, binchasayich en li din, aval beferotehen yesh li din, vechol zeman shehen nechasayich, sheat bachayyim, en li din udevarim bahem, ha leachar mita yesh li vahem din udevarim:

Rabbi yehuda omer leolam hu ochel pere ferot. baggemara mefaresh ellu hen perot veellu hen pere ferot, hichnisa lo karka veasta ferot ellu hen perot, machar ellu happerot velakach bahen karka veasta ferot hare hen pere ferot. uchesheamar lah din udevarim en li vinchasayich uveferotehen bilvad, ochel pere ferot ledivre rabbi yehuda, deha lo selik nafsheh ella min happerot bilvad. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im meta yirashenna mippene shemmatne al ma shekkatuv battora. dichtiv (Bamidbar 27) veyarash otah, mikkan shehabbaal yoresh et ishto. aval maskana demilleta, sheyyerushshat habbaal et ishto eno min hattora ella midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma. veaf al pi chen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, lo mippene shemmatne al ma shekkatuv battora, ella shechachamim asu lah chizzuk keshel tora:
Hallokeach min heani. hamechazzer al happetachim:
Pilche devela. chatichot shel devela:

Bolel venotel. dores hattemarim o haggerogarot umearvan yachad, vehen nivlalim umitarvim, venimtza mafrish min hachiyyuv, dekasavar yesh belila bedavar hayyavesh. aval perusot shel lechem ufilche devela en nivlalin, veate leafrushe min happatur al hachiyyuv:
Bizman shehammattana merubba. bizman shehakkol notnin mattana merubba, shekkol hammattanot shavot, az moelet belila:

Aval bizman shehammattana muetet. kelomar shemmattana achat meuta mechavertah, lo mehaneya belila, dedilma kol chad vechad lo mitreme dideh, vechayshinan shemma min harov mafrish al hammuat. kach nire perush mishna zo bayrushalmi:
Vitomim mevakshim ketubbat imman. shekketubba shel achat merubba mishshel chavertah, veomrim baneha ketubbat benin dichrin nittol, vechen attem, vehashshear nachalok:
Cholkim beshave. kishar kol hayerushshot, veen notlim ketubbat benin dichrin:
Im amru yetomim. bene hakketubba haggedola:
Hare anu maalin al nichse avinu. maalin demehen lekabbelam alenu beyoker, kede sheyyihye sham motar dinar veyittelu chetubbat imman:

Mi shekkara shem litrumat maaser shel demay. sheamar terumat maaser sheani chayyav lehaferish mikkeri ze yehe munnach bitzfono o vidromo, velo hifrishah. uterumat maaser shel demay denakat lefi shehayyisrael kore lah shem venotnah lakkohen velokeach hammaaser leatzmo, aval terumat maaser shel vadday en hayyisrael kore lah shem ella hu noten maaser lallevi vehallevi mafrish terumat maaser venotnah lakkohen:

Lo yittelem. kede littenam lakkohen o leani shebbechatzer veshebbammavoy, sheasur litten mattanot lakkohen veleani beshabbat. aval bilmudim leechol etzlo kelomar hargilin leechol al shulchano share, uvilvad sheyyodiem shehem shel terumat maaser o shel masar ani, sheim eno modiam vehem sevurim shemmishshello hu maachilam hava leh kemaachil orchav teruma umaasrot, shehu asur:

Hallakuach o shennittan lo mattana patur mimmasar behema. baggemara yalfinan leh middichtiv (Shemot 22) bechor banecha titten li ken taase leshorcha letzonecha, ma banecha enam belakuach umattana, delo shayyach behu lekicha umattana ella etzlo noldu, af tzoncha uvekarcha enan belakuach umattana. veaf al gav dehay kera bivchor hu dichtiv vaanan yalfinan maaser minneh, hayenu mishshum dichtiv ken taase leshorcha, vaasiyya vadday lo matzet mokmat bivchor deha merechem kadosh velo bae asiyya sheyyakdishennu haish, im eno inyan livchor tenehu inyan lemaasar behema:
Haachim hashshuttafin. haachin shechalku birushshat avihen veachar kach nishtattefu:

Keshechayyavin bakkalbon. keshemmeviin shiklehen meviin shene chatzae shekalim venotnim shene kalbonot. vehakkalbon hu leshon hechrea, shechayyavin lehacheria shiklehen. veim natnu ben shenehem shekel shalem notnim shene kalbonot, shehaya lahem lishkol lachatzain:

Ufeturim mimmasar behema. mikkol hannoladim lahem kol yeme hashshuttafut. shehashshuttafut poter mimmaasar behema, dichtiv asher yihye lecha, velo shel shuttafut. veaf al gav dehay kera bivchor hu dichtiv, im eno inyan livchor deha shaminan deiteh beshuttafut dichtiv (Devarim 12) uvechorot bekarchem vetzonchem, tenehu inyan lemaasar behema:

Ucheshechayyavin bemasar behema. kegon im lo chalku meolam, shettefusat habbayit kayyemet, dehaynu sheyyerushshat avihen omedet, chayyavin bemaasar behema leasser hannoladim lahem kol yeme shuttafutam. dehachi amrinan babberayta, yachol afillu kanu bitfusat habbayit, talmud lomar yihye, demashma mikkol makom:

Peturim min hakkalbon. legamre, sheshshoklin ben shenehem shekel shalem. shemmamon avihem bechezkato omed, vehaav sheshshokel al banav o al echad mibbene iro ufoter beshello, patur min hakkalbon. ditnan bishkalim, hashshokel bishvil heani o bishvil shecheno o bishvil ben iro patur min hakkalbon. uvanav nammi en mitzvat shiklehem alav vehave leh kishcheno uven iro:

Kanu mittefusat habbayit chayyavin. bemaasar behema. kidamrinan talmud lomar yihye demashma mikkol makom sheyyihye. uveferushe rabbotay matzati, dehay kanu lo shellakchu bemaot, ella shennaflu lahem behemot mirushshat avihem:
Chalku vechazru venishtattefu. havu keshuttafim dealma:
Ufeturim mimmasar behema. vechayyavin bakkalbon:
Hammaddir et chavero sheyyochal immo. deamar leh konam ma sheatta nehene li im en atta soed etzli:
Shabbat harishona. shel seuddat nissuin levachur shennasa vetula hittiru lo leechol immo mishshum eva:
Maachilin et haaniyyim demay. afillu hen chaverim. vetzarich lehodian, veharotze leasseran yeasseran:
Veet haachsanya. chayil shel melech yisrael haover mimmakom lemakom umuttal al bene hammakom lefarnesam, maachilin otam demay, bizman shehi overet, aval lanu sham ballayla chayyavin letakken:
Rabban gamliel haya maachil et poalav demay. aniyyim hayu. veen halacha kerabban gamliel, dechevan dechayyav bimzonotehen nimtza porea et chovo bidmay:
Veet sheeno meussar limasser. venotnin lo beyoter mikkede maasrotav, venimtzeu chol haadam ochlim metukkan. uvet shammay letaamayhu deamre en maachilin et haaniyyim demay:

Veharotze letakken yetakken. shello huttar haddemay laaniyyim ella kesheochlin achila achat etzel baal habbayit, aval happerot sheyyavou leyadam chayyavim hem leasseran demay. dayka nammi dekatane maachilin et haaniyyim demay velo tane haaniyyim ochlin demay. kach katav harambam:

Hachi garsinan yatzu shenayim keechad mone otan shenayim shenayim. menaan echad, teshii vaasiri mekulkalin. yatzu shenayim keechad ze etzel ze berochav happetach umana otan zug echad, mone kullan shenayim shenayim zug zug, vehazzug haasiri kadosh bikdushshat maaser. vehu haddin im menaan shelosha o arbaa:
Menaan echad. lashshenayim harishonim sheyyatzu mana echad, velashshelishi sheni velarvii shelishi:

Teshii vaasiri mekulkalim. lefi shehatteshii becheshbono hu asiri beemet, vaasiri becheshbono hu achad asar, umishshum hachi havu mekulkalim veyiru ad sheyyistaavu. velo damu lekara laasiri teshii uleachad asar asiri, daasiri maaser veachad asar karev shelamim, dehatam nefak echad echad vechi mate asiri vekarye teshii velaachad asar kara asiri mibberir lechulle alma shehatteshii lecheshbono hu asiri labbehemot, vehaasiri achad asar, veihu hu deshinna vetaa, hilkach haasiri maaser gamur, vehaachad asar karev shelamim miggezerat melech, kedimfaresh lekamman. aval hacha deyatzu shenayim bitchilla beyachad velo mibberir asiri, shehu kore teshii dilhave asiri, lav maaser gamur hu meelav, vechidamar ihu nammi lo have, hilkach mekulkalim:

Shelashtan mekuddashim. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) vechol masar bakar, lerabbot teshii veachad asar. yachol sheani merabbe af shemini ushevii, amart, hoil vehu kadosh vetauto mekuddeshet, ma hu eno kadosh ella besamuch lo, kelomar haasiri atzmo hassamuch etzel gufo, af tauto enah mekuddeshet ella besamuch laasiri, dehaynu teshii millefanav veachad asar meacharav:

Vechi yesh temura osa temura. savar rabbi yehuda dehay achad asar have temura, dehay dekarye asiri keman deamar tehe tachat haasiri dame, veen temura osa temura dichtiv (sham) vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh, velo temurat temurato:

Amru mishshum rabbi meir. enah temura. en haachad asar temurat haasiri, sheim haya temura lo haya karev, ditmurat maaser enah kereva, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) lo tifde kodesh hem, hem kerevin velo temuratan, uvivchor ketiv, veyalfinan maaser minneh. vahalacha sheen haachad asar ose temura:
Kol shello neekar shem asiri mimmennu. dechol hecha dekara laasiri asiri, tu lo mikdash achad asar bemay dekare leh asiri:
Shennaflu lah nechasim. mibbet aviha, beodah shomeret yavam:
Ma yaasu vichtubbatah. mane umatayim vetosefet uneduneya shehichnisa lo vekibbel alav acharayut:
Uvannechasim hannichnasin vehayyotzin. nichse melog, shekkeshehi nichneset nichnasim immah uchesheyyotzet mibbalah yotzim immah:
Bet shammay omrim yachaloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav. desafek nesua layyavam hi vezoche bachatzi yerushshatah missafek:

Nechasim bechezkatan. nichse tzon barzel bechezkatan. velo itparesh bechezkat mi, i bechezkat yorshe habbaal hoil veacharayutan alav, i bechezkat yorshe haishsha shehayu shellah. uveferek 4‏ mivamot timtza hammishna hazzot:
En pochatin mearbaa chodashim meubbarot. shel sheloshim yom leshana. delo avdinan tefe mishshemona chaserim. aval shemona chaserim avdinan:

Velo nire yoter al shemona. kelomar, velo nire lachachamim leabber beshana yoter al shemona chodashim. shechadshah shel levana esrim vetisha yom vachetzi, ushete yedot shaa, veshivim ushelosha chalakim, hare lishne chodashim chamishshim vetisha yamim, chodesh echad meesrim vetisha, vechodesh echad mishsheloshim yom. chodesh shel esrim vetisha hu chaser, vechodesh shel sheloshim karuy male o meubbar. uvedin haya sheyyihyu kol chadshe hashshana echad male veechad chaser, ella mippene yitrot hashshete yedot shaa veshivim ushelosha chalakim sheyyesh bechol chodesh vechodesh, tzerichim peamim laasot shemona chodashim mechadshe hashshana meleim vearbaa chaserim, peamim shemona chaserim vearbaa meleim:
En pachut mishshenayim. leyom sheni laafiyyatan:

Velo yoter al shelosha. veyom shelishi laafiyyatan neechalin, vetu lo. ketzad, chal yom tov shel atzeret beechad beshabbat, neefot beerev shabbat, sheen afiyyatan docha lo shabbat velo yom tov, veneechalot beyom tov leachar tenufatan, dehaynu leyom shelishi. ucheshechal atzeret bishar yeme shavua, neefot beerev yom tov veneechalot beyom tov shehu sheni laafiyyatan:

Lechem happanim neechol en pachut mittisha. shehu neefe veerev shabbat veneechol leshabbat acheret shehu yom teshii laafiyyato. chalu shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana lihyot bachamishi beshabbat veshishshi beshabbat, ofin lechem happanim birvii beshabbat, umesadderim oto al hashshulchan beshabbat, veneechol leshabbat sheniyya shehu yom achad asar laafiyyato:

Velo yater al shenem asar. ketzad, nolad ben hashshemashot shel erev shabbat, eno nimmol beshabbat, deshemma teshii hu. deven hashshemashot sefek yom sefek layla, veim yom hu nimtza shabbat yom teshii, umila shello vizmannah enah docha lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. veim chalu shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana achar otah shabbat, eno nimmol ad yom shelishi shehu shenem asar leledato:
Veyalda shene zecharim noten chamesh selaim. deechad mehen bechor:

Haav patur. dematze lememar habbechor met. ucheshemmet habben kodem sheloshim eno chayyav befidyon, veachshav shehaddavar safek shemma habbechor met ufatur, shemma ze shennishar hu habbechor vechayyav, have hakkohen motzi mechavero, vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vehu haddin shehabben hannishar patur millifdot et atzmo kesheyyihye gadol:
Met haav. leachar sheloshim:

Veim lav peturim. desavar rabbi meir haachin shechalku benichse avihen din lakochot yesh lahen, lefi sheen berera lechol echad al yerushshato, ella hare hen keillu kanu ze mizze kol echad chelko, veellu hechamesh selaim haya chov al avihen kemilve al pe, umilve al pe enah gova min hallakochot, hilkach im chalku ad shello natnu peturim:
Rabbi yehuda omer nitchayyevu hannechasim. kasavar haachim shechalku yorshim hen, deyesh berera lomar kol echad zacha bechelko, umilve al pe gove min hayyorshim. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Zachar unekeva en kan lakkohen kelum. deamar leh hannekeva yatza rishona, vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya:
Hayu sham nechasim barauy. kegon iska shebbeyad acherim o halevaa:
Enan kevammuchzak. enan nechshavim lihyot keillu hen muchzakim beyado veyesh kan motar dinar:
Sheen lahem acharayut. mittaltelim:
Sheyyesh lahem acharayut. karkaot. vahalacha kerabbi shimon. veaf bazzeman hazze dinhige demittaltele deyatme meshabede levaal chov, en ketubbat benin dichrin noheget bemittaltelin ella vekarkaot:
Siton. socher hallokeach tevua mibbaale vattim harebe beyachad umocher laacherim bemidda gassa:
Lo yeasser mizze al ze. deshemma ma shellakach mimmennu bashsheniyya meadam acher kenao, veate leafrushe min happatur al hachiyyuv:
Vaafillu meoto hassug. kelomar meotah kuppa. vedome lo bemassechet kelim (perek 16 mishna 3) hassugim haggedolim:
Vaafillu meoto hammin. dishnehem shechamtit o shenehem levana. veim amar hassiton demeadam echad kana, neeman:

Shalosh geranot lemasar behema. bishlosha perakim bashshana habbehemot mitasserot. uleshon geranot, kitvuat goren shehi tevula lemaaser veen ochlim mimmennu ad sheyyeasseru, kach bishlosha perakim hallalu en ochlim min habbehemot velo mochrim mehen ad sheyyeasseru otan:

Peros happesach. chamishsha asar yom kodem happesach dehaynu yom acharon shel adar. uleshon peros, palga, chatzi hazzeman sheshshoalin behilchot happesach, detanya shoalin behilchot happesach kodem lappesach sheloshim yom. vechen peros atzeret chamishsha asar yom kodem. vechen peros hechag dehaynu yom acharon shel elul. vekavu hanach telata zimne sheyyihyu kovot lemaasar behema, kede sheyyihyu behemot metzuyot leole regalim, deaf al gav ditnan bematnitin shead shello higgia zeman haggoren muttar limkor velishchot, degoren hu hakkovea lammaaser, afillu hachi lo shachate lehu eynashe ad shemmeasserin, denicha leh leeynash likyyume mitzva bemamoneh bedavar sheen chaser bo kelum, kegon maasar behema shehu atzmo makriv maaser veochlo shelamim, veim lo hayu measserim bishlosha perakim hallalu hayu harebe nimnaim limkor lefi shello isseru, velo hayu behemot metzuyot leole regalim:

Ben azzay omer betisha veesrim baadar. dehaynu chamishsha asar yamim kodem happesach. ella derabbi akiva savar adar hassamuch lenisan peamim chaser peamim male, vachamishsha asar yom kodem happesach peamim matchilim betisha veesrim baadar peamim bishloshim baadar, hilkach lo kava leh zeman. uven azzay savar adar hassamuch lenisan leolam chaser, utechillat peros happesach have leolam becht baadar:

Beechad besivan. mittoch shemmiut behemot yoldot minnisan vead atzeret, i makdim umeasser lehu chamishsha asar yom kodem atzeret kullan yihyu neechalin kodem atzeret velo tehe behema metzuya leole regalim:

Beesrim vetisha veav. ben azzay letaameh, deamar lekamman haeluliyyin mitasserin bifne atzman veen mitztarfin im otan shennoldu kodem elul, deshemma beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemaasar behema vahavu lehu chadash veyashan, umesappeka leh emat have rosh hashshana, o elul o tishre, hilkach lo kava zeman garnan shel kayte becht beelul, delo lete letzarofe hannoladim beelul bahadayhu:

Beechad benisan. savre kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar shoalim behilchot happesach kodem lappesach shete shabbatot, vehayenu nammi behilchot happesach dimasserinan labbehemot ki hechi delitchazu baregel:
Beechad besivan. kedaamaran taama deven azzay, lefi shemmiut behemot yoldot minnisan vead atzeret:
Velo amru beechad betishre. veaf al gav dehu yom shete shabbatot:

Mippene shehu yom tov. chada veod kaamar, chada mishshum devae hekkera bechadash veyashan, deechad betishre hu rosh hashshana lemaaser, veaf al gav delo ate letzarofe detishre bahadayhu deha akkatti lo nolad shum tale hayyom, vei nolad mechussar zeman hu, afillu hachi lo measserinan hahu yoma mishshum devainan lemeevad hekkera ben chadash leyashan deledu eynashe delo litztarfu hechadash im hayyashan. veod, mippene shehu yom tov, mishshum sikkarta tzeva adom shetztzovea bo haasiri kede sheyyehe nikkar, veasur litzboa beyom tov:

Haeluliyyin mitasserin bifne atzman. kidfareshna leel dimsappeka leh i have rosh hashshana lemaasar behema echad beelul o echad betishre, hilkach en mitasserin haeluliyyin im hannoladim mittishre vaelach, mishshum delo litztarfu yashan bechadash:

Haav tzarich lehavi reaya. im ba litboa ketubbatah min haerusin mizze shemmemaen lekachtah, tzarich sheyyavi reaya shelleachar shennitarsa hayu vah mumin hallalu. veaf al pi sheyyesh laishsha chazaka degufah, hoil venimtzeu hammumin birshut haav veikka lememar kan hayu kodem erusin, ulefichach im lo hevi reaya, baal meheman:

Nichnesa lirshut habbaal. nissea, veatta ba lehotziah belo ketubba al mumin shebbah, alav lehavi reaya shekkodem shennitarsa hayu vah mumin hallalu. dechevan delo nimtzeu mumin hallalu ella virshuto, omrim kan nimtzeu kan hayu uleachar shennisset bau lah venistachafa sadehu:
Eno yachol liton. deyada venitpayyes:
Mearvin bo. eruve techumin vachatzerot:
Umishtattefin bo. shittufe mevoot, veaf al gav delo chaze leh, miggo dei bae mafkir lenichseh have ani vechaze leh, deha tenan maachilin et haaniyyim demay, hasheta nammi chaze leh:
Umevarchin alav. birkat hammazon:
Umezammenin alav. veaf al gav deachal baavera, delav ani hu, miggo dei bae mafkir lenichseh vahave ani vechaze leh:

Umafrishin oto arom. keshebba lehaferish mimmennu terumat maaser umaaser sheni yachol lehaferish vehu arom, delo bae beruche, deillu bae beruche ha bainan vehaya machanecha kadosh (Devarim 23) velekka:
Ben hashshemashot. shel erev shabbat, desafek chashecha measserin et haddemay veen measserin et havvadday:

Veim hikdim maaser sheni larishon. shehifrish maaser sheni shel demay kodem shehifrish maaser rishon kede littol terumat maaser shebbo, en bechach kelum. ma sheen ken bevadday, ditnan kechol mitzvatcha asher tzivvitani (sham 26), ha im hikdim maaser sheni larishon eno yachol lehitvaddot:
Haggardi. haoreg:
Chayyav bidmay. sheal gufo hu notno, vesicha kishtiyya:
Veshehassorek. hatztzemer bammasrek noten al hatztzemer have keshemen lasuch bo et hakkelim ufatur min haddemay:

Lihyot chaver. leinyan tohorot, dehaynu parush, veyihyu vegadav umashkim shello tehorim. vaafillu talmid chacham eno neeman leinyan tohorot ad sheyyekabbel alav divre chaverut, ella im ken haya zaken veyoshev bishiva. vehamekabbel alav divre chaverut tzarich leharegil atzmo sheloshim yom veachar kach yihyu begadav umashkim shello tehorim. veen kabbalat divre chaverut befachot mishshelosha chaverim, ella im ken haya hamekabbel talmid chacham sheen tzarich bifne shelosha, velo od ella sheacherim mekabbelim lefanav:
Lach veyavesh. deen mosrim tohorot leam haaretz, sheasur ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael:

Veen lokeach mimmennu lach. aval yavesh lokeach mimmennu, shello huchshar lekabbel tuma kol zeman shello va alav mashke. veneeman am haaretz lomar happerot hallalu lo huchsheru, aval eno neeman lomar huchsheru aval lo nitmeu:
Velo yitareach etzel am haaretz. shello yittamme veyavo vitamme tohorot:
Velo mearcho. leam haaretz:

Etzlo bichsuto. dichsut am haaretz tumato chamura mittumat am haaretz atzmo, dechayshinan shemma yashva alehen ishto nidda, uvigde am haaretz midras lapperushim. i nammi lechach amru lo mearcho etzlo bichsuto, demimmagga atzmo yachol lizzaher tefe mimmagga kesuto:
Af lo yegaddel behema dakka. sheasur legaddel behema [dakka] beeretz yisrael, shello yiru bisdot acherim:
Velo yehe farutz bindarim. shessofo lavo lide chillul:
Velo yehe farutz bischok. dischok vekallut rosh margilin et haadam leerva:
Umeshammesh. talmide chachamim bevet hammidrash:
Lo vau ellu lakkelal. deen inyanam nogea letohorot. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shete nashim. shel ish echad, veyaldu shene zecharim bemachavo, shennitarvu:
Im lechohen echad natan. pidyon shenehem, yachazir lo hakkohen chamesh selaim, hoil umet betoch sheloshim veiggallay milleta denefel hu veshello kaddin shakal:
En yachol lehotzi miyyadam. dechol chad vechad maddeche leh veomer hareni machazik bam bishvil pidyon hachay:
O shene zecharim unekeva. yaldu hannashim shello bemachavo:

Noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. demimma nafshach chad have bechor, im haachat yalda shene zecharim haechad bechor, veim haachat yalda zachar unekeva, nimtza shechavertah yalda zachar levaddo vehu bechor, veoto sheim hannekeva patur shemma nekeva yatza rishon:
En lakkohen kelum. deikka lememar hannekevot yatzu techilla veen kan bechor:
Haav patur. dematze lememar ben hammevakkeret met:
Natnu ad shello chalku kulei. kidfareshna leel. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Zachar unekeva. yesh lomar otah shello bikkera yalda hannekeva veen kan bechor:

Kol hakkodem bah zacha. kadmu yorshim, zachu veen motziin miyyadam, demittaltele deyatme lo mishtabede levaal chov velichtubba. kadam echad mehem haishsha o hammalve, zacha hu, derabbi tarfon it leh tefisa dilachar mita mahanya:
Zachta ishsha yoter al ketubbatah. im kadma vetafsa veyesh yoter min hakketubba, o kadam baal chov vetafas veyesh yoter al chovo:

Hammotar kulei‏ yinnatnu lakkoshel. ze baal hashshetar sheyyado al hattachtona. veim yavou leyad hayetomim shuv lo yotziu mehem lo ishsha velo vaal chov. vehaidna dinhige bechol batte dinim shebbeyisrael demittaltele deyatme mishshabede levaal chov, mi shemmet vehinniach mittaltelin vehaya alav baal chov uchetubbat ishsha, kol hakkodem zacha, ben baal chov mukdam ben baal chov meuchar, sheen din kedima bemittaltelin. veim lo kadam echad mehem, yechalleku hammittaltelin benehem, kidamrinan lekamman beferek mi shehaya nasuy:
Lachazom. lichrot ulechattech. veen lo dome bammishna:
Lehakel mimmassao. shello yichbad alav:
Lo yashlich ad sheyyeasser. shemma yimtzaem am haaretz veyochal otam kesheenam metukkanim, venimtza noten michshol. vehanne mile beyarak hanneegad, dei beshello neegad akkatti lo itchayyev bemaaser:
Hallokeach yarak min hashshuk. venatal aguddot yarak beyado sheshshumatan yedua kach vechach aguddot bifruta, uleachar shennetalan nimlach alehen lehachaziran lammocher:
Lo yachazir ad sheyyeasser. veyitten lo deme hammaaser shehu mafrish, dimchi agbehinhu naasu shello venitchayyev alehen leasseran:
Sheeno meussar ella minyan. hay meussar have perusha mechussar, kelomar kevar kana otam behagebaha velo haya mechussar ella limnotan, shekkevar haya yadua kach vechach aguddot bifruta:
Haya omed velokeach. velo netalam beyado velo higbiham:
Toan acher. masseoy acher shel yerakot:

Habbechora. enah chozeret bayyovel dichtiv (Devarim 21) pi shenayim, mekish shene chalakav ze laze, ma chelek peshituto eno chozeret bayyovel dirushsha hi kedichtiv (sham) vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav, af chelek bechorato yerushsha:
Vehayyoresh et ishto. dehay tanna savar deorayta hi, lishero hakkarov elav mimmishpachto veyarash otah (Bamidbar 27), mikkan shehabbaal yoresh et ishto:
Vehameyabbem et eshet achiv. venatal chelek achiv, yerushsha gemura hi veeno machazir lishar echav bayyovel. divchor karye rachmana, vehaya habbechor, vehabbechora enah chozeret bayyovel kidyalfinan:
Vehammattana kedivre rabbi meir. demecher hu deamar rachmana lehdar bayyovel, yerushsha umattana lo:

Vachachamim omrim mattana kemecher. kedichtiv (Vayikra 25) bishnat hayyovel hazzot tashuvu ish el achuzzato, ukera yetera hu deha kevar neemar (sham) veshavtem ish el achuzzato, ella lerabbot et hammattana hu deata:

Rabbi eliezer omer kullan chozrin bayyovel. savar la kerabbanan deamre tashuvu lerabbot et hammattana, vehane kullehu mattana ninhu. bechor latet lo pi shenayim mattana karye rachmana. vehayyoresh et ishto, yerushshat habbaal derabbanan. vehameyabbem et eshet achiv, bechor karye rachmana, ma bechora chozeret af yavam chozer:

Hayyoresh et ishto yachazir livne mishpacha. rabbi yochanan ben beroka sevira leh yerushshat habbaal et ishto deorayta hi, vehacha bemay askinan kegon shehorishato ishto bet hakkevarot. umishshum pegam mishpacha amru rabbanan lishkol deme velihaddar hakkevarot livne mishpacha:

Vinakke lahem min haddamim. deme kever ishto. dehu mihat chayyav bikvuratah. vahalacha kachachamim demattana kemecher, ucherabbi yochanan ben beroka devaal shehorishato ishto bet hakkevarot shakel deme umahdar bet hakkevarot livne mishpacha, umenakke lahem min haddamim deme kever ishto:

En mamtinin lah ad shetteled. demahu detema veladot mamona devaal hen kedichtiv (Shemot 21) kaasher yashit alav baal haishsha, velo nafsedinhu minneh, kamashma lan dichtiv (Devarim 22) umetu gam shenehem, gam lerabbot et havvalad:
Yashva al hammashber. mekom moshav haishsha hayyoledet karuy mashber:
Mamtinin lah ad shetteled. dechevan deneekar latzet, gufa acharina hu veeno cheguf immo:

Nehenin bisarah. lav searah mammash kaamar, ella pea shehayta lah missear ishsha acheret keshura lisarah. vedavka kesheamra tenu otah levitti o liflonit, dechevan deamra tenu galya datah delo nicha la deteheve chegufa leittesore, vechintula mechayyim damya. aval beinyan acher asur, shennoye hammet asurim bahanaa:
Behema shenneherga asura vahanaa. afillu searah:
