Chamesh selaim shel ben. hassela haamur bammishna hu hashshekel haamur battora bechol makom. ufeamim nikra battora kesef, chamishshim kesef, mea kesef. vehu haya bime moshe mishkal shelosh meot veesrim gargire seora, uvevayit sheni hosifu alav veheeluhu lemishkal shelosh meot ushemonim vearba seora. vechen monim hayyom lechamesh selaim shel ben. venimtzeu chamesh selaim mishkal elef utesha meot veesrim seorot benoniyyot shel kesef mezukkak:

Bemane tzori. hayyotze bimdinat tzor. vechol kesef shel tora, kegon chameshet selaim shel ben, sheloshim shel eved, vachamishshim shel ones umefatte, umea shel motzi shem ra, kullam bemane tzori shehu kesef mezukkak. vechol kesef shehu middivrehem kegon hakkenasot uchetubbat ishsha ledivre rambam kullam kesef medina, sheechad mishshemona chalakim shebbahem kesef veshiva chalakim nechoshet. aval rabbotay horu shekketubbat betula yesh lah din kesef shel tora, shekken katuv kemohar habbetulot, umatan zuze hen shel kesef naki. umishkal kol zuz tishim veshesh seorot:

Vechullan nifdin. hachi kaamar, vechol hannifdim nifdin bechesef uveshave kesef, chutz min hashshekalim. kol hannifdin kegon bechor adam vehekdeshot, nifdin ben bechesef ben beshave kesef, chutz min hashshekalim, shehabba lishkol machatzit hashshekel tzarich sheyyitten oto mikkesef naki matbea metzuyyar velo shave kesef. umaaser sheni nammi en nifde ella bematbea shel kesef sheyyesh alav tzura velo beshave kesef, dichtiv (Devarim 14) vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha, kesef sheyyesh alav tzura:

En pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamevukkarim. hay tanna savar dichvasim shel temidin teunim bikkur mimmum arbaa yamim kodem shechitatan, dumeya defesach mitzrayim shehaya mikkacho mibbeasor ushechitato bearbaa asar, deyalef moado haamur battemidim (Bamidbar 28) tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado, mimmoado haamur bappesach (sham 9) et happesach bemoado. hilkach, kodem yom chinnuch arbaa yamim mevakkerin shemona telaim venotnin belishkat hattelaim, uveyom chinnuch notlim shenayim litmidin venisharu sham shishsha mevukkarim, uleachar ken kodem hallayla mevakkerim shenayim venotnim sham. umishshum dehanach letanhu akkatti bishat netilat hashshenayim, la chashiv lehu. vechen leolam notlin shenayim venotnim shenayim. veellu hashshenayim shennotnim notlim otam lachamishi shel yom netinatan:

Kede lashshabbat velishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana. simana vealma nakat, dechi hechi dei mikkale shabbat ushene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana bahade hadade haya tzarich lehakedim ulevakker hahu dishlishi beshabbat meerev shabbat, deha lo matze kodem hayyom lelech ulevakkesh tale ulevakker, vehaveya lekicha arbaa yamim kodem shechita, hachi nammi leolam bainan arbaa yamim kodem shechita:
Umosifin ad leolam. im ratzu lehosif telaim mevukkarim belishkat hattelaim, mosifim kemo sheyyirtzu:
Mishshete chatzotzrot. keshettokin bachatzotzrot en pochatim mishshetayim:
Umosifin ad leolam. baggemara mefaresh ad mea veesrim. shenneemar (divrei hayamim 2 5) veimmahem hakkohanim lemea veesrim mechatztzerim bachatzotzrot:

Vehatztziltzal levad. tziltzal echad haya sham velo yoter. deamar kera (divrei hayamim 1 16) veasaf bammetziltayim lehashemia. veaf al gav dimtziltayim ketiv leshon rabbim, mippene shehen shete chatichot rechavot shel mattechet shemmakkin zo al zo, umihu chada avidta avid, sheen echad mehem moil belo chavero, vechad gavra avid behu:
Mukke shechin. metzora:
Baal polippos. reach hachotem:
Vehamekammetz. mekabbetz tzoat kelavim:
Vehametzaref nechoshet. hamechattech nechoshet mimmekom motzao min haaretz, umasriach hu:
Vehabbursi. meabbed orot:
Mippene shemmemikkato. memasmasto. leshon hamek besaro (Zecharya 14). vahalacha kachachamim:

Yillakach bahen karka. lefi shekketubbatah al nichse valah harishon, lefichach nichse hammet acharain lichtubbatah, ella shehayyavam ochel perot im meyabbem otah, vesavar mittaltele mishtabede lakketubba:
Shamin otam. dechol ma sheggadel birshut hammet acharain lakketubba:
Vachachamim omrim perot hamechubbarim lakkarka shello. baggemara parech, veha kol nechasav acharain vearvain lakketubba, umeshane, tane shellah:

Kol hakkodem zacha. kasavre mittaltele lakketubba lo mishtabede ella im ken tafsa. umechayyim devaal bainan tefisa. vehu haddin nammi diflige akkesafim, demay shena kesafim mipperot telushin. vahalacha kachachamim:

Hare hi cheishto. shemmegarshah beget, umachazirah. velo amrinan veyibbemah amar rachamana vaadayin yibbumin rishonim aleha velo tisge lah beget. vehachi nammi kesheggershah hava amina mitzva deramya rachamana aleha ha kaavda, veteku aleh beissur eshet ach velo matze lehachazirah, ka mashma lan deamar rachamana (Devarim 25) ulekachah lo leishsha, kevan shellekachah hare hi cheishto:

Masar behema. kol asher yaavor tachat hashshevet haasiri yihye kodesh. umakrivim chelbo vedamo, ushear habbasar neechol labbealim tehorim birushalayim kedin shelamim. veim baal mum hu, ochlim oto betuma bechol makom:

Bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit. vehaidna ammur rabbanan delo lifreshu maasar behema, mishshum takkala, deen lanu bayit lehakerivah vetzarich leshahoya ad shettippol bah mum veate bah lide takkala degizza vaavoda, o shemma yishchatenna belo mum:
Aval lo vemukdashin. kegon kadashim kallim, deikka leman deamar mamon bealim ninhu, salka datach amena liassar, ka mashma lan vehaya kodesh amar rachmana, velo shekkevar kadosh:
Bakkevasim veizzim. kelomar venoheg bakkevasim uvaizzim:
Umitasserin mizze al ze. midderabbe rachmana vatzon, demashma kol tzon min echad chashiv leh leinyan maaser:
Bechadash. shennoldu leachar rosh chodesh elul shehu rosh hashshana lemaasar behema:
Uvayyashan. shennoldu kodem elul:

Veen mitasserin mizze al ze. min hechadash al hayyashan umin hayyashan al hechadash. dichtiv asser teasser, bishte maasrot hakkatuv medabber, echad maasar behema veechad maasar dagan, ma maasar dagan mechadash al hayyashan lo deha ketiv (Devarim 14) shana shana, demashma velo mishshana zo al shana acheret, af maasar behema mechadash al hayyashan lo:
En podin. bechor adam:
Lo vaavadim. af al gav daamaran leel bechesef uveshave kesef, en podin lo baavadim:
Velo vishtarot. sheim yesh lo shetar al chavero bechamesh selaim unetano lakkohen sheyyigbe oto chov befidyon beno, en beno paduy:
Velo vehekdeshot. kelomar, velo hahekdeshot nammi en podin otan lo baavadim velo bishtarot velo bekarkaot:
Katav lakkohen shehu chayyav lo chamesh selaim. mishshum pidyon beno:
Chayyav litten lo uveno eno faduy. devar tora beno paduy lichsheyyitten. uma taam amru yitten uveno eno paduy, gezera shemma yomru podin bishtarot:
Lefichach. deamrinan shechayyav litten lo chamesh selaim acherim lefidyon beno:

Im ratza hakkohen. lehachaziram velittenam lo bemattana: rashshay. aval takkana acheret lekka. veaf al pi shehakkohen rashshay lehachazir velitten hechamesh selaim bemattana laavi habbechor, im daat avi habben somechet bevadday sheyyachazir lo hakkohen hechamesh selaim, en habben paduy, ben hechezir hakkohen ben lo hechezir. kach nire min haggemara:
Shenneemar yihye lach ufado tifde. kesheyyihye lecha happidyon az beno paduy. vehay kera leaharon neemar:
Hallokeach perot. beshabbat yochal al piv. deemat shabbat alav, shemmityarim laavor avera uleshakker beshabbat yoter mibbechol:

Terumat maaser shel demay. lehachi nakat terumat maaser, deamme haaretz nechshedu aleha desavre enah bemita kol zeman shello hufrash maaser rishon, aval teruma gedola lo nechshedu aleha. uterumat maaser haveya echad mimmea, ucheshechazra limkomah lefachot mimmea chazra umedammaat:
Shoalo veochel al piv. demeachar shennikra lah shem teruma emat dimmua al am haaretz veyare leshakker. vahalacha kerabbi shimon shezuri:

Hannachri rabbi meir omer neerach. tere kerae chetive befarashat arachin, chad ribbuy vechad miut. bene yisrael, miet et hannachrim. ish ki yafli, ribba chol ish vaafillu nachri bemashma. rabbi meir savar nachri neerach velo maarich, shekken matzinu sheribba hakkatuv banneerachim yoter mibbammaarichim, shehare cheresh shote vekatan neerachin, aval lo maarichin, hilkach shede miuta lammaarich veribbuya lanneerach:

Rabbi yehuda omer nachri maarich velo neerach. shekken matzinu tumtum veanderoginos maarichim velo neerachim. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda. hilkach nachri sheamar erech yisrael peloni alay, chayyav litten kefi shanav haerech hakkatzuv bapparasha. veyisrael sheamar erech nachri peloni alay, o nachri sheamar erki alay, lo amar kelum:
Met achad. min havveladot:

Yachazir lahem chamesh selaim. veyachaloku shene haavot. vehane mille keshekkatav echad mehen hareshaa lachavero, aval im lo katav echad mehen hareshaa lachavero, ki azel chad minnayhu legabbe kohen dache leh lomar bincha hachay, vechi azel idach dache leh lomar bincha hachay:
Zachar unekeva haavot peturim. dechol chad vechad amar leh lakkohen hannekeva shelli hi:
Vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo. demikkol makom bechor hu:
Shete nekevot vezachar. yesh lomar haachat yalda nekeva vehaacheret zachar unekeva vehannekeva yatza techilla, hilkach en kan lakkohen kelum. vechen shene zecharim ushene nekevot:
Veellu devarim. bechol makom. afillu mikkeziv ulehallan im lekachan meam haaretz, divyadua shemmeeretz yisrael bau deminkere, sheen dugmatan ella beeretz yisrael:

Vehaorez shebbechutza laaretz kol hammishtammesh mimmennu patur. afillu beeretz yisrael, deminkar tefe velo ate leachlufe beorez shel eretz yisrael. aval shear devarim hannizkarim bematnitin ikka minnayhu beeretz yisrael dedamu leotan shebbechutza laaretz, ella dehanhu dachashive shedderech lenasam mittoch chashivutan limkomot sheen kayyotze vahen, bau issure, divyadua shemmeeretz yisrael hen:

Shamin otan. dekasavar ma sheggadel birshuto havu perot uma shello gadel birshuto have keren. ulefichach ma sheddeme hakkarka yekarim achshav bishvil tevua zo, have keren, vetzarich litten lah damim veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel peroteha:
Vachachamim omrim. af ellu shello gadlu virshuto torat perot natnu vahem, hoil vehakkarka kayma lah. vahalacha kachachamim:
Shel zo mane veshel zo matayim kulei. ushelashtan nechtemu beyom echad. dei bitlata yome, hakkodemet bashshetar kodemet baggibbuy. o shello hinniach ella mittaltelin, sheen din kedima bemittaltelin:
Cholkot beshave. shehare koach shelashtan shave beshibud mane, divchullehu ikka mane:
Hayu sham matayim. en levaalat mane shibud ella bemane, aval bemane sheni en shibud lashshetar shel baalat mane:

Shel mane notelet chamishshim. baggemara parech, shelishit mane haya rauy shettittol, veheach notelet chamishshim shehu chatzi mane. umeshane, dematnitin ayre deamra lah baalat matayim levaalat mane, din udevarim en li immach bammane hameshubad lach velo yitmaet chelkech bishvili, hilkach hi uvaalat shelosh meot cholkot oto. umippene shello natna baalat hammatayim levaalat hammane chelkah bemattana ella amra lah shello tariv immah uvishvilah lo yitmaet chelkah, leachar shellakcha baalat hammane chamishshim nishar zechut baalat hammatayim shave im zechut baalat hashshelosh meot bammane vachetzi hannishar, vechol achat mehen notelet shelosha dinre zahav shehen shivim vachamishsha dinarim shel kesef, shekkol dinar zahav hu esrim vachamishsha dinarim shel kesef:
Hayu sham shelosh meot. mane rishon meshubad lechullam, vehashsheni levaalat matayim ulevaalat shelosh meot, vehashshelishi levaalat shelosh meot bilvad:

Shel mane notelet chamishshim veshel matayim mane. kegon deamra lehu baalat shelosh meot levaalat mane ulevaalat matayim, din udevarim en li immachem bammane, hilkach mane harishon cholkot baalat matayim uvaalat mane, nimtzet baalat mane notelet chamishshim, umane hashsheni cholkot baalat matayim uvaalat shelosh meot, nimtzet baalat matayim notelet mane, chamishshim shechalka mehammane harishon im baalat hammane, vachamishshim mehammane hashsheni shechalka im baalat hashshelosh meot. vehammane hashshelishi notelet kullo baalat hashshelosh meot, nimtzet notelet shishsha dinre zahav shehem mane umechetza, hammane hashshelishi kullo shennishar lah vachatzi hammane shechalka im baalat hammatayim. uvaggemara massik dematnitin rabbi natan hi veenah halacha, deamar rabbi en ani roe devarav shel rabbi natan baze, ella cholkot beshave, dehoil vechol nechasav acharain lakketubba, kol sheloshet hammanim meshubadim levaalat hammane kishar chavroteha, ad shettigbe kol ketubbatah, hilkach cholkot beshave, vechach notelet baalat hammane kemo vaalat hammatayim ushelosh meot. aval bishlosha shehittilu maot lakkis ze mane veze matayim veze shelosh meot, dehatam shevach shehishbichu meotehen ka shakle, dina hu shekkol echad yittol lefi meotav. vedavka keshehishbichu mechamat hammaot atzman, kegon shennishtanna hammatbea o hosifu alav o fichatu, az cholkim hashshevach vehahefsed lefi hammamon. aval im kanu sechora min hammaot shehittilu lakkis vehirvichu vassechora o hifsidu, en mechallekim harevach vehahefsed ella lefi mispar hashshuttafin velo lefi hammamon, vechach notel bahefsed uvashshevach mi shennoten bakkis maot muatim kemo oto shennatan maot merubbim, im lo hitnu techilla sheyyechalleku lefi mamon. vechen danim bechol batte dinim:
Pundakit. shomeret happundak veholche derachim mitachsenim etzlah:
Measser et shehu noten lah. deen chaver motzi mittachat yado davar sheeno metukkan:

Veet shehu notel mimmenna. deaf al gav deam haaretz eno chashud lehachelif kidamran leel, happundakit chashuda lehachelif shehi mitkavvenet letova venotenet mishshellah shehu yoter yafe lechaver, veomeret belibbah rauy sheaachil mishshelli shehu cham veyafe lechaver vaani ettol et shello hakkar vehaggarua:

En anu acharain larammaim. kelomar en achrayut harammaim alenu leshamram shello yochlu davar sheeno meussar. lefichach eno measser ma shehu noten lah, veim tikkachennu happundakit leatzmah vetochlennu kesheeno metukkan en lechaver mizze kelum, veeno measser ella ma shehu notel bilvad. verabbi yose savar deligzol hi mitkavvenet, veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Bitziatah. im ba legarshah:

Perot hamechubbarim lakkarka, bichnisatah shello. kelomar bishat nefilatan shello, kedivre chachamim. veikka ben chachamim lerabbi shimon perot hamechubbarin bishat yetzia, delo ayre behu chachamim, velet lehu ha deamar rabbi shimon bitziatah shellah, dekasavre ma sheggadel birshuto shello. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Kol hannoladim. hach setama kerabbi eliezer verabbi shimon:
Chamishsha lifne rosh hashshana. aggav devae lemitne chamishsha lifne haggoren vachamishsha leachar haggoren mitztarfin, tana nammi hay:
Lo yishchot. shehaggoren kovo lemaaser midderabbanan:
Veim shachat patur. uvehema sharya baachila. delo ashkechan betevel demaasar behema lo lav velo mita:

Rabbi shimon. kae leel arabbanan deamre hammoshiv et ishto chenvanit o appotroppa mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze, veim katav lah neder ushevua en li velo leyorshay alayich en yorshin mashbiin otah, vaata hu leafloge veamar dechol zeman shehi tovaat ketubbatah yorshin mashbiin otah vaafillu katav lah neder ushevua en li velo leyorshay alayich. veim enah tovaat ketubbatah en yorshin mashbiin otah al appotroppa shebbechayye valah, vaafillu lo fetarah min hashshevua, delet leh derabbi eliezer umachalukto deamre leel bematnitin mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Lo tippara ella vishvua. hannifra mechavero eno medakdek lasum lev al kol ma shepperao, vezo hoil venifrea bemiktzat efshar shennifrea hakkol, veramu rabbanan shevua alah ki hechi detidok:

Ed echad meid shehi ferua lo tippara ella vishvua. takkanat chachamim hi, kede lehafis dato shel baal. ushevuot hallalu af al pi shettakkanat chachamim hen, enan ella keen shel tora binkitat chefetz, shekkol shevuot shettikkenu bammishna keen shel tora hen:

Minnechasim meshubadim. mishshum dei hava gave min hallove gufeh vahava taen love ishtabba li delo feraticha, mashbeinan leh, vaanan taaninan bishvil lakochot dilma i hava gavit min hallove hava taen lach, ishtabba li delo feraticha, uvaet ishtabboe, hasheta nammi ishtabba:
Hammitkalkel. pat o tavshil shennitkalkel:

Amar rabbi yehuda. bayrushalmi mefaresh dekamayta nammi milleteh derabbi yehuda hi. vehachi kaamar mippene shehi chashuda lehachelif et hammitkalkel, divre rabbi yehuda, sherabbi yehuda omer rotza hi betakkanat bittah vechulei:
Benoten lachamoto sheviit. benoten lah leefot ulevashshel bashshana hashsheviit:
Sheenah chashuda lehaachil et bittah sheviit. dachamira lehu sheviit vaafillu im yitkalkel lo tachlifennu beferot sheviit. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Sheen aleha nedarim venimtzeu aleha nedarim. beelu nedarim amru, shello tochal basar velo tishte yayin velo titkashshet bevigde tzivonim. aval bishar nedarim, mekuddeshet:

Kol hammumin happoslin bakkohanim. bivchorot ka mane lehu. vehosifu alehen bannashim zea. vereach happe o reach ra bemakom acher begufah. veshuma sheyyesh bah sear, ben ketanna ben gedola keshehi keneged paneha, uchegon shehi tachat kippa shebberoshah, dezimnin mitchazya vezimnin delo mitchazya, sheim hi bemakom hamegulle tamid hare raa venitpayyes, veim hashshuma en bah sear enah mum ad shettehe gedola keisar. vekolah ave umeshunne mikkol shear hannashim. uneshachah kelev venaasa bimkom hanneshicha tzalleket, kelomar kiuutz kemo michvat esh. vedaddeha gassim mechavroteha tefach. vesheddaddeha rechokim ze mizze ad sheyyesh tefach ben dad ledad. ellu mumin bannashim, veaf al pi sheenam mumin bakkohanim:

Umin hatztzonenet al hachamma. af al pi shehu measser min hara al hayyafe, savar la kerabbi illaiy deamar (kiddushin 46:) hattorem min hara al hayyafe terumato teruma, uvidmay hittiru afillu lechattechilla:

Vaafillu middefusim harebe. velo chayshinan shemma etmol kana hannachtom tevua mimmi shehu measser vehayyom mimmi sheeno measser venimtza mafrish min happatur al hachiyyuv, denachtom mechad gavra zevin, af al pi shehu ose middefusim harebe:

Rabbi yehuda oser. kesheshshenehem shel emesh o shenehem shel hayyom mode rabbi yehuda lerabbi meir daafillu middefusim harebe share, delo chayyesh lidfusim. aval echad shel emesh veechad shel hayyom afillu middefus echad asar, sheani omer vechulei:

Rabbi shimon oser bitrumat maaser. daafillu shenehem shel hayyom o shel emesh, kevan devishne defusim hu amrinan mittere gavre zevan et hattevua, veshemma haechad isser vehaechad lo, venimtza mafrish min happatur al hachiyyuv:

Umattir bechalla. divchalla kulle alma modu afillu shel emesh beshel hayyom vaafillu mishshene defusim, dei nammi mittere gavre zevan lo chayshinan, shehare etzel hannachtom mitchayyeva bechalla, shehu gilgel et haissa. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:

Yinnatnu lakkoshel shebbahen. it dimfarshe, lemi sheshshetaro meuchar, shehu koshel vechallash shebbechullan, sheeno yachol litrof lakochot hakkodmim lo. veit dimfarshe, lichtubbat ishsha, vehi keruya koshel sheen darkah lachazor achar nichse hammet ulevakkesh hechan yesh lo karka kemo haish. veaf al gav demittaltele deyatme lo mishtabede levaal chov velo lichtubbat ishsha, hacha delav birshutayhu manche, sevira lerabbi tarfon demotziin miyyad hallove o miyyad shehappikkadon etzlo venotnin levaal chov velichtubba:
Yinnatnu layyorshim. velo mahanya tefisa:

Shekkullan tzerichin shevua. shehabba lippara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua, vechol zeman shello nishbeu en anu yodim im yesh lahem alav kelum, hilkach mishshemmet hammet zachu vahen hayyorshim uvirshutan hen:
Maachilato sheeno meussar. velo noda lo ella achar sheachalo, kegon deamra leh peloni kohen tikken li et hakkeri, veazal shayyleh veishtakkach shikra:
Umeshammashto nidda. kegon shehuchzeka nidda bishchenoteha sherauha loveshet bigde niddut, ulevalah amra tehora ani:
Velo kotza lah challa. deamra leh peloni tikken li et haissa, veazal shayyleh veishtakkach shikra:
Vetova vashshuk. umara zerooteha livne adam:
Umedabberet im bene adam. mesacheket im habbachurim:
Umekallelet yoldav befanav. mekallelet umecharefet avi valah bifne valah:

Hakkolanit. tovaat tashmish bekol ram ad sheshshechenoteha shomot otah. vechol hanne tzerichot edim vehateraa lehafesidan ketubbatan. veen lahen lo ketubba velo tosefet, veenan notlot ella belaotehen hakkayyamim bilvad:
Letochen kuti. lechuti shettochen hattevua:
Hare hen bechezkatan. delo chashide shemma hechlifu ellu hametukkanim baacherim sheenan metukkanin:
Letochen oved kochavim demay. deoved kochavim chashud lehachelif. ulevatar deashkechu yona berosh har gerizim lakkutim shehayu ovdim otah, kuti hare hu keoved kochavim:

Etzel haoved kochavim keferotav. uferot shel oved kochavim peturim min hammaaser. veresha mippene shedderech bene adam leholich kuppot rabbot shel chittim ulehannichan etzel hattochen chayshinan shemma nitchallefa kuppa zo bekuppot acherot shel yisrael shehen demay, aval perot lekka lememar shemma hechlifan beferot shel yisrael ella shemma hechlifan haoved kochavim beferotav, lefichach hare hen keferotav shel oved kochavim. verabbi shimon savar deaf beferot chayshinan shemma nitchallefu bevet haoved kochavim beferot shel yisrael acher, shekkeshem sheyyisrael ze hifkid perotav beyad haoved kochavim kach yesh lachush shemma yisrael acher min hachashudim al hammaasrot hifkid gam ken beyado venitchallefu ellu vaellu. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Veavde kohanim hayu. otan hammakkim bechalil. disvira leh lerabbi meir en maalim min hadduchan leyochasim velo lemaasrot, hilkach lo ichpat lan im hayu avadim:
Bet happegarim uvet tzefarya. shem mishpachot meyuchasot:
Umeemmaom. shem makom:

Massiin lakkehunna. kohanim hayu nosim et benotehen, shemmishpachot meyuchasot shebbeyisrael hayu. verabbi yose savar demaalin min hadduchan leyochasim, hilkach i lav dimyuchasin hayu lo hinnichum lenaggen al hadduchan:

Rabbi chananya ben antignos omer leviyyim hayu. rabbi chananya ben antignos savar maalin min hadduchan lemaasrot, hilkach leviyyim hayu. velo felige ella vimnaggenim bichle zemer, aval beshir shebbappe chulle alma modu deen omrim shir bappe al hakkarban ella leviyyim, dichtiv gabbe leviyyim (Devarim 18) vesheret beshem Adonai‏ elohav, ezehu sherut shehu beshem Adonai, heve omer ze hashshir. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

En pochatin meesrim veachat tekiot bammikdash. bemassechet sukka perek hechalil [daf 53] hen meforashim. veha ditnan velo mosifin al arbaim ushemone, lav davka, dezimnin demosifin ad shiva vachamishshim tekiot, keshechal erev pesach lihyot beshabbat, umishshum delo shechiach kulle hay la chashiv leh:
Shene nevalim. lishne leviyyim:
Velo mosifim al shishsha. lo itparesh taama:
Chalilin. min keli zemer shekkolo nishma lemerachok. 510 belaaz, uvaaravi 298:

Velo mosifin al shenem asar. keneged shenem asar yom bashshana shehechalil makke vahen lifne hammizbeach. uleshon makke nofel bechalil, lefi shehu asuy nekavim umakke veetzbao al hannekavim lehaneim hakkol:
Bishchitat happesach. bearbaa asar benisan shehayu korin hahallel baazara bishat shechita, kidamar beferek tamid nishchat [daf sad]:
Abbuv. hakkane haddak shebberosh hechalil. uvaggemara muchach dechalil gufeh karuy abbuv:

Shekkolo arev. keshehu shel kane, yoter mishshel nechoshet. vedavka chalil shemmakke lifne hammizbeach al hakkarban hu sheddoche et hashshabbat vechol shekken yom tov. aval chalil shel bet hashshoeva lo haya doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov, kidmuchach besukka perek hechalil:

Lo haya machalik ella beabbuv yechidi. keshehaya maggia lesayyem hanneima haya echad min hachalilim maarich leachar shessiyyemu haacherim, shezzehu chilluk yafe yoter mishsheillu yesayyemu shenehem keechad. vechilluk hayenu siyyum hashemaat kol hanneima. uvishat hahakrava haya shir ze, vehayu haleviyyim meshorrim bappe et hahallel beotan shenem asar yamim, vehachalilim hayu mechallelim. aval bishar yamim hayu mehallelim betziltzal vechinnorot. vehashshir haya hashshir shehayu haleviyyim omrim bevet hammikdash, barishon hayu omrim laAdonai‏ haaretz umeloah vechol hammizmor, bashsheni gadol Adonai‏ umehullal meod vegomer, vechen kullam:
Haggoses. lo niddar, delav bar damim hu, dilmita hu omed:
Velo neerach. dichtiv veheemido veheericho, vehay lav bar haamada vehaaracha hu:
Vehayyotze lehareg. shennigmar dino bevet din shel yisrael. aval yotze lehareg al pi hammalchut, lo shena malchut yisrael, velo shena malchut shel nachrim, divre hakkol maarich veneerach:
Lo niddar. delav bar damim hu:
Velo neerach. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) kol cherem asher yochoram min haadam lo yippade. verabbi chanina ben akavya deamar neerach, moke lehay kera dechol cherem asher yochoram lidrasha achariti:

Rabbi yose omer kulei. rabbi yose vetanna kamma lo felige venoder umaarich umakdish. ki felige veim hizzik. tanna kamma savar, im hizzik patur min hattashlumim. veaf al pi shehammazzik chayyav betashlumin min hattora, milva hakketuva battora lav kichtuva vishtar damya, ella chemilva al pe, umilva al pe eno gove min hayyorshim. verabbi yose savar, milva hakketuva battora kemilva hakketuva vishtar damya, vegove min hayyorshim. vahalacha chetanna kamma. aval leachar shettikkenu demilva al pe gove min hayyorshim, bet din govin mimmamono umeshallemim ma shehizzik:
Measser mizze al ze. dechullo meussar o kullo eno meussar. uvilvad sheyyihye mimmin echad uvetoch shenato, sheen tormin mishshel shana zo al [shel] shana acheret:
Umiggannot acherot measser mikkol achat veachat. devaale haggannot shemma ze isser veze lo isser:

Notel echad mishsheloshim veshalosh ushelish. hayenu shelish mimmea. usea shennotel yesh bah shelosha shelishim, shenayim mehen litruma shehi tere mimmea veechad litrumat maaser shehi echad mimmea. veomer al otah sea shennatal, echad mimmea sheyyesh kan ben hakkol, dehaynu shelish otah sea:
Hare hu betzad ze chullin. perush yishshaer chullin kemo shehu atta betivlo betzad shene shelishim sheimmo, vehashshear dehaynu shene shelishim yihyu teruma al hakkol:
Mehachullin sheyyesh kan. dehaynu hashshelish sheamarti alav sheyyishshaer chullin. hare ze betzad ze maaser:
Ushear maaser. dehaynu od tisha samuch lishlish ze, otam asara shelishim yihyu maaser al hammea shelishim. velav davka asara ella meat pachut kefi hammaggia lishnayim shel teruma:

Ze sheasiti maaser. hayenu hashshelish shekkara alav shem maaser techilla asuy terumat maaser al tisha hashshelishim. velo shelish shalem ella chaser davar muat, ulehachi kaamar mehachullin sheyyesh kan demashma velo chol hachullin. umatnitin atya keabba elazar ben gomel deamar besof perek kol hagget (gittin lo.) keshem sheyyesh lo levaal habbayit reshut litrom teruma gedola kach yesh lo reshut litrom terumat maaser. veihu nammi share lehaferish terumat maaser beomed beayin yafa beferek kol hammenachot baot matztza (menachot daf ned: noah.). hilkach oto shelish shehu mafrish mishshalem, af al pi shehaya rauy lihyot chaser meat, beayin yafa hu mafrish veshare:

Mashbia hu et yorsheha. im gershah umeta veyorsheha tovin hemennu ketubbatah, nishbaim shevuat hayyorshim shello fekadtanu bishat mita velo amra lanu kodem lachen velo matzinu ben shetaroteha sheshshetar ketubbatah parua:
Veet habbaim birshutah. im machra chetubbatah laacherim venitgarsha umeta vehallakochot tovim ketubbatah, nishbaim af hen shevuat hayyorshim:
Aval yorshav mashbiin otah. im nitalmena vehi o yorsheha nifrain min hayetomim, tzerichim shevua, shehare lo fetaran ella mimmennu im tigbe chetubbatah bechayyav:
Labbain birshuti. im emkor nechasay veat baa lippara min hallakochot:
